bing-45462.jpg.copyright: © Yva Momatiuk and John Eastcott/Minden Picture

bing-45474.jpg.title: Last rays of sun on a group of dunes, Sahara, Algeria
bing-45474.jpg.headline: Each day a different dune. Sand dunes in the Sahara, Algeria
bing-45474.jpg.description: The Sahara spans over 3 million square miles of North Africa, covering large parts of various countries including Algeria, Egypt, Morocco, Sudan, and Tunisia. Vast sand dunes, rocky plateaus, and occasional oases create a landscape like no other. Although it is the largest hot desert in the world, the Sahara supports drought-resistant plants like acacia and palm trees, and hardy animals such as camels and fennec foxes. Intriguing features include its shifting sand dunes, pictured in today's image, some of which are over 500 feet high. Ancient rock art and fossils have also been discovered here, providing insights into early civilizations and prehistoric creatures. Sandstorms are common, shaping the ever-changing scenery and adding to the mystique of this natural wonder.

bing-45486.jpg.title: Winter at Huangshan, China
bing-45486.jpg.headline: Care for a peak?. International Mountain Day
bing-45486.jpg.description: Happy International Mountain Day!  In celebration of highlands, we're visiting the dramatic landscape of Huangshan—the Yellow Mountains—of eastern China's Anhui province. A UNESCO World Heritage Site, Huangshan has been described as 'the loveliest mountain of China' and has inspired artists and writers throughout history. Composed of granite that formed 140 million years ago, its peaks emerge from seas of clouds, rising to 6,115 feet at its highest point, Lotus Peak. Visitors come here to experience breathtaking rock formations, pine trees, hot springs, and captivating winter landscapes. So, let's climb high, dream big, and protect our mountains!

bing-45495.jpg.title: Reed bunting, Newport Wetlands, Wales
bing-45495.jpg.headline: Look no 'feather'. Reed bunting
bing-45495.jpg.description: Brown, sleek, sharp and always dressed to impress—say hello to the reed bunting! With their jet-black heads, white collars and dapper 'moustache,' males cut quite the figure. Despite their name, reed buntings can also be found on farmland and in wetlands across Europe. Their melodious tunes aren't just for show—they're part of an elaborate courtship display. Monogamy with biparental care is the main mating system for the species. While these birds may seem common and they are listed as 'least concern' by the International Union for Conservation of Nature, their population is shown to be declining. Next time you're out birdwatching, keep an eye—and ear—out for them.
bing-45495.jpg.copyright: © Chris Howes/Wild Places Photography/Alamy Stock Phot

bing-45498.jpg.title: Poinsettias
bing-45498.jpg.headline: Holiday hues. Poinsettia Day
bing-45498.jpg.description: During the holiday season, poinsettias brighten up homes in suitably festive coloring, serving as symbols of goodwill. December 12 marks National Poinsettia Day, a special occasion to celebrate this holiday favorite. The plant was introduced to the US by Joel Roberts Poinsett, a botanist and former minister to Mexico who died on this day in 1851. Poinsettias can be found growing in the wild from Mexico to Guatemala. The ancestors of the modern, commercially available version have been traced to the Mexican state of Guerrero. The crimson-leaved plant was used by the Aztecs as a red dye and as a fever-reducing medicine.

bing-45510.jpg.title: Traditional rorbu houses, Svolvaer, Lofoten Islands, Norway
bing-45510.jpg.headline: All is calm. Svolvaer, Lofoten Islands, Norway
bing-45510.jpg.description: Housed in the Arctic Circle, Norway's Lofoten Islands are a crossroads of traditional life and modern industry. One of two towns in Lofoten, Svolvaer boasts a long history as a fishing village. Before it became a town of its own, it was part of the town of Vågan, where people have lived for over 1,000 years. Beyond fishing, it also serves as a sanctuary for travelers looking for a peaceful getaway, with as many as 200,000 visitors in a single year. The traditional rorbu houses, built on poles over water, add a distinctive layer of charm to the town. These cabins were once made for traveling fishermen and have now been refurbished to meet contemporary tastes.

bing-45522.jpg.title: Boreal owl, Saskatchewan, Canada
bing-45522.jpg.headline: Owl eyes on you. Christmas Bird Count
bing-45522.jpg.description:
In the world of birdwatching, the Christmas Bird Count, first held back in 1900, is a highlight of the year. The original bird count involved just 27 people spread over 25 locations in the US and Canada. Since then, the annual bird census has grown exponentially, with participants in more than 2,360 locations across various countries.

In North America's coniferous forests lives a tiny bird of prey—the boreal owl. The small brown and white-flecked raptor is shy and keeps well hidden from our view. Despite its compact size, it is a formidable hunter, feeding on small mammals, voles, and birds. With dark plumage and expressive eyes, it strikes a captivating figure in the moonlit canopy, intriguing bird enthusiasts and researchers. Any birder would be fortunate to spot one during their Christmas Bird Count.

bing-45534.jpg.title: SantaPark in Rovaniemi, Lapland, Finland
bing-45534.jpg.headline: Santa's playground. SantaPark, Lapland, Finland
bing-45534.jpg.description: Deep in the snowy landscape of Finnish Lapland is a city that claims to be the official hometown of Santa Claus. Rovaniemi is a gateway to the Arctic Circle and a destination where reality and folklore merge. Visitors can watch the Northern Lights, explore the Arctic wilderness, and experience the magic of Christmas at various Santa-themed attractions, including SantaPark, an underground theme park designed to emulate the cavern home of the man himself, and the Santa Claus Village. The entrance to SantaPark, lit by glowing lights, is pictured on our homepage today. Other attractions in Rovaniemi include a hotel built from snow and ice, a popular ski resort, and horse sleigh rides around a vast frozen lake.

bing-45540.jpg.title: Festlich beleuchtete Marktkirche, Hannover, Niedersachsen
bing-45540.jpg.headline: Sternen-Gewölbe. Festlich beleuchtete Marktkirche, Hannover, Niedersachsen
bing-45540.jpg.description:
Die Marktkirche in Hannover erstrahlt zur Weihnachtszeit in zauberhaftem Lichterglanz. Die gotische Kirche, ein Wahrzeichen der Stadt, wurde im 14. Jahrhundert erbaut, obwohl bereits im 12. Jahrhundert Vorgängerbauten existierten, und ist ein faszinierendes Beispiel mittelalterlicher Baukunst. Ihre imposanten Türme ragen in den Winterhimmel und bilden eine eindrucksvolle Kulisse für das festliche Treiben auf dem Weihnachtsmarkt, der sich rund um die Kirche erstreckt.

In der Adventszeit wird dieser Ort zum Anziehungspunkt für Einheimische und Touristen. Der Weihnachtsschmuck betont die gotischen Details der Kirche und die festliche Beleuchtung taucht den Platz in eine warme, einladende Atmosphäre. Hier finden auch stimmungsvolle Weihnachtskonzerte und Gottesdienste statt, die in der Adventszeit die Herzen erwärmen.

Besuchen Sie den Weihnachtsmarkt mit seinen festlich geschmückten Ständen und genießen Sie weihnachtlichen Leckereien und das Kunsthandwerk. Verzaubert Sie der Duft von Zimt und Glühwein nicht auch? Uns schon, und um wenigstens ein bisschen in diese magische Stimmung einzutauchen, setzen wir gleich Wasser auf, um einen heißen Tee zu genießen und uns auf die Festtage vorzubereiten.

bing-45546.jpg.title: Guild houses of Grand-Place, Brussels, Belgium
bing-45546.jpg.headline: A cheerful case of the blues. Guild houses of Grand-Place, Brussels, Belgium
bing-45546.jpg.description:
In the heart of Belgium, Brussels is a vibrant capital city that combines history with a modern, cosmopolitan feel. Famous for its architecture and listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, the Grand-Place of Brussels exudes an air of grandeur with its ornate guildhalls and centuries-old buildings.

Most of this central square was destroyed by French troops in 1695, during the Nine Years' War. Thanks to reconstructions in the following decades, the square today is a harmonious blend of Gothic, Baroque, and Louis XIV architectural styles. Charming in every season, the Grand-Place hosts a bustling flower market in the summer and transforms into a magical winter wonderland during the holidays.

bing-45558.jpg.title: Bohemian waxwings perched on a branch, Canada
bing-45558.jpg.headline: Feathered fashionistas. Bohemian waxwings in Canada
bing-45558.jpg.description: Among their feathered friends, Bohemian waxwings cut striking figures with their pointed crests, 'blushing' faces, and velvety gray plumage with splashes of color. Large groups wander across the northern US and Canada in search of food, swooping on trees and shrubs to find fruit. In winter, they feast upon cotoneaster, juniper, and rowan berries. As spring casts its spell, these nomads settle down for the breeding season. The female waxwings craft the nests, laying two to six bluish-gray eggs, and hatchlings are fed a diet of insects and fruits by both parents. One can easily spot these sociable birds, as they often gather in chirpy flocks in North America and Eurasia.

bing-45565.jpg.title: Stambecco sotto una forte nevicata, Alpi, Italia
bing-45565.jpg.headline: Che grandi corna congelate!
bing-45565.jpg.description:
Nelle maestose Alpi italiane, regna lo stambecco, una capra selvatica dalle corna imponenti. Questi abili arrampicatori sfidano le vette più vertiginose con un’agilità sorprendente. La loro pelliccia spessa costituisce la difesa contro il freddo intenso e li aiuta a mimetizzarsi con il paesaggio alpino. Nel corso dei secoli, questo animale è stato estirpato, fino a quando non è iniziato un programma di reintroduzione in alcune aree del loro habitat naturale, come nel Parco Nazionale del Gran Paradiso, tra il Piemonte e la Valle d’Aosta. Oggi, fortunatamente, grazie a queste iniziative, l'Unione Internazionale per la Conservazione della Natura (IUCN) non lo considera più un animale a rischio di estinzione.

Se siete amanti della natura e vi piace fare lunghe passeggiate tra le montagne, non temete gli incontri con gli stambecchi. Nonostante le loro imponenti dimensioni, sono animali socievoli e non rappresentano un rischio significativo per gli esseri umani. Continuiamo con impegno il ripopolamento dei boschi, garantendo un ambiente ricco di flora e fauna per le generazioni future, affinché possano godere della stessa varietà animale e vegetale che possiamo apprezzare oggi.

bing-45566.jpg.title: Station de ski du col des Saisies à l'aube, Beaufortain, Savoie, France
bing-45566.jpg.headline: Un petit coin de paradis savoyard !. Col des Saisies, Beaufortain
bing-45566.jpg.description:
Connaissez-vous le Beaufortain ? Ce lieu magnifique est un véritable petit coin de paradis. Nichée autour de la charmante commune de Beaufort, cette pépite naturelle des Alpes occidentales vous séduira à coup sûr. Entre ses lacs de barrage, sources d'une énergie hydroélectrique verte, et ses pistes enneigées à souhait, le Beaufortain a tout pour plaire.

Mais ce n'est pas tout ! C'est aussi le royaume incontesté du fromage de Beaufort, une pépite de notre gastronomie, créée à partir de lait de vache. Savoureux et empreint d'une tradition vieille de plusieurs siècles, ce fromage bénéficie même d'une appellation d'origine protégée depuis 1968.

Et pour les amateurs de glisse, direction Les Saisies, en photo aujourd’hui. Perchée à 1650 mètres d'altitude, cette station de ski offre une vue à couper le souffle sur le Mont-Blanc. Elle a accueilli les exploits des Jeux Olympiques d'hiver de 1992. Alors, prêt à plonger dans le Beaufortain pour ces fêtes de fin d’année ?

bing-45570.jpg.title: Capitol Reef National Park, Utah
bing-45570.jpg.headline: Snow, snow on the range. Capitol Reef National Park, Utah
bing-45570.jpg.description: Carved by time, wind, and water, Capitol Reef National Park showcases rust-hued cliffs and the natural beauty of the American West. The park was named after a series of Navajo sandstone domes said to resemble the US Capitol Building and the Waterpocket Fold, a huge ridge in the Earth's crust, which was referred to as a reef by prospectors. This 100-mile-long monocline—a step-like fold—is thought to have formed around 50 to 70 million years ago, and is home to towering cliffs, narrow canyons, and colorful rock formations. Capitol Reef was established as a national monument in 1937 and was designated a national park on December 18, 1971.

bing-45582.jpg.title: Christmas tree in Castle Square, Old Town, Warsaw, Poland
bing-45582.jpg.headline: Santa's Polish rest stop. Castle Square, Old Town, Warsaw, Poland
bing-45582.jpg.description: From early December, the streets and squares of Warsaw, Poland's capital city, are dressed for the festive season. Christmas decorations light up the Royal Route, which extends south from the Royal Castle on Castle Square, where a nearly 30-foot-tall Christmas tree is installed for the holiday season, to Wilanów Palace. Bundled patrons wander through Warsaw's Christmas Market, browsing through seasonal souvenirs while savoring a warm beverage. The Royal Castle and surrounding Old Town have been recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1980.

bing-45583.jpg.title: Cachoeira da Fumacinha, Chapada Diamantina, Bahia, Brazil
bing-45583.jpg.headline: Cachoeira da Fumacinha, Bahia, Brazil
bing-45583.jpg.description: In Brazil's Chapada Diamantina National Park lies the impressive Fumaça Waterfall that astounds visitors with its sheer power and beauty. This waterfall is also renowned for its free fall, which is approximately 340 metres, making it one of the highest in  the country. Fumaça means smoke, which is appropriate as the cloud created by water droplets gives the impression of a hazy veil. A grueling trail leads to the top of the waterfall, where visitors can see stunning views of Chapada Diamantina. This park is both a visual marvel and an example of Brazil's natural beauty.

bing-45590.jpg.title: Barcelonnette aux portes des Hautes Vallées de l'Ubay, Alpes-de-Haute-Provence, France
bing-45590.jpg.headline: Une veillée de Noël provençale. Tradition des 13 desserts de Noël
bing-45590.jpg.description:
Située à 1 135 mètres d'altitude au cœur des Alpes-de-Haute-Provence, Barcelonnette offre un cadre exceptionnel pour les amateurs d'activités de plein air tels que la randonnée, le ski et le VTT. La ville, également riche en patrimoine culturel, abrite des musées dont le Musée de la Vallée, dédié à l'histoire et la culture de la région de l'Ubaye.

À l'approche du réveillon, Barcelonnette s'inscrit dans la tradition des 13 desserts provençaux, une coutume remontant au XVIIe siècle. Ces délices, composés de fruits secs, de pâtisseries et de nougats, incarnent l'essence du Noël provençal. Les listes de ces 13 desserts divergent en Provence d'une ville à l'autre. Mais il y a une base commune, à savoir les quatre mythiques mendiants, les deux nougats et la pompe à l'huile. Cette année, célébrez ces festivités en découvrant cette tradition et en explorant la magie de Noël au cœur de la Provence !

bing-45594.jpg.title: Village in Val Gardena at Christmas, Dolomites, Italy
bing-45594.jpg.headline: Lights of the Dolomites. Val Gardena, South Tyrol, Dolomites, Italy
bing-45594.jpg.description: Val Gardena in Northern Italy is a popular destination for skiing, rock climbing, and woodcarving enthusiasts, which transforms into Christmas Valley at this time of year. Wooden huts open their doors to visitors, and a nostalgic cable car ride, each cabin adorned with twinkling fairy lights, travels above snow-covered slopes. During the 18th century, the valley became famous for its production of intricately carved wooden figurines, initially made to decorate Catholic churches. Among those creations, the peg wooden doll emerged as one of Val Gardena's best-known products and is still being produced today.

bing-45606.jpg.title: Avenue of birch trees near Uffing am Staffelsee, Bavaria, Germany
bing-45606.jpg.headline: The veil of winter. Winter solstice
bing-45606.jpg.description: Frost-covered birch trees add a graceful touch to this winter landscape in the German state of Bavaria. This region is home to the villages of Uffing and Schöffau, on the shores of Staffelsee lake, and is often covered in mist and snow, creating an ethereal ambience. A winter chill is to be expected today, on the shortest day of the year. Typically falling on December 21, the solstice marks the beginning of winter in the Northern Hemisphere. While we're wrapping up warm, the Southern Hemisphere is celebrating the start of summer on their longest day of the year.

bing-45609.jpg.title: 天鹅泉湿地公园，伊犁，新疆，中国
bing-45609.jpg.headline: 冬季仙境中的精灵
bing-45609.jpg.description: 冬至这一天，让我们一起走进天鹅泉湿地公园。天鹅泉湿地公园又名英塔木天鹅栖息地保护区，位于英塔木乡下赫勒克村伊犁河北岸。该地有个“天鹅湖”，这个湖最初是由几处长流不息的地下温泉眼汇聚而成一条小溪，后来经过人工规划形成了湖泊。湖里生长了茂密的水草，泉水温度较高，即使在最寒冷的季节也不会封冻，天鹅们十分喜欢在这里越冬，休养生息。

bing-45610.jpg.title: Red Fort Delhi historic monument at sunrise with flying pigeons
bing-45610.jpg.headline: Through the gateways of history. Red Fort, Delhi
bing-45610.jpg.description:
The towering Red Fort, housed amidst the bustling streets of Old Delhi, echoes the grandeur of India's rich history. Commissioned by the Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan in the mid-17th century, it is named for its red sandstone walls, boasting a harmonious blend of Persian, Timurid and Indian architectural styles. From the majestic Lahori Gate to the intricate designs of the Diwan-i-Khas, each alcove tells a story.

The fort is a protagonist in the narrative of India's struggle for independence. The echoes of speeches from the iconic ramparts, where the tricolour flag unfurls proudly every Independence Day, reverberate through time. Exploring the Red Fort is like turning the pages of a historical novel; the chapters unfold with every step, revealing a story of power, culture and the enduring spirit of a nation.

bing-45611.jpg.title: Riaño, León, Castilla y León, España
bing-45611.jpg.headline: ¡Un blanco y corto día!. Riaño, León, Castilla y León, España
bing-45611.jpg.description:
El solsticio de invierno, un evento astronómico que ha fascinado a la humanidad a lo largo de los siglos, señala el día más corto y la noche más larga del año. En Riaño, un paraíso de unos 475 habitantes, escondido en el corazón de Castilla y León, España, este fenómeno se vive de una manera especial.

¿Sabías que, durante el solsticio, el pueblo de Riaño se convierte en un espejo de estrellas? La ausencia de contaminación lumínica revela un cielo estrellado que ha fascinado desde tiempos antiguos. Este fenómeno ha marcado la vida cultural y agrícola de la región, dictando el ritmo de siembras y cosechas.

Celebrar el solsticio de invierno aquí es redescubrir una tradición ancestral, donde la naturaleza y la historia se unen en un perfecto compás de paz y belleza.

bing-45615.jpg.title: Castlerigg Stone Circle, Lake District National Park, England
bing-45615.jpg.headline: Bring on the light. December solstice
bing-45615.jpg.description:
Here's to a great night out or a cosy night in on the longest night of the year! On this day, the Northern Hemisphere, where the United Kingdom is located, is tilted the farthest from the sun, resulting in the earliest sunset and the shortest day of the year. Called the December solstice, it marks the official beginning of winter and longer days ahead, giving a nice boost to the festive mood.

Archaeologists believe that ancient civilisations arranged stone circles to align with lunar and solar positions and used them to celebrate events like the solstice. Pictured here is one such site—Castlerigg Stone Circle, located in the Lake District, North West England. With 40 stones arranged in a circular pattern, this Neolithic monument dates back to 3000 BCE. While some aspects of Castlerigg's solar alignments remain a mystery, the allure of its ancient charm has magnetically drawn visitors throughout the centuries.

bing-45616.jpg.title: Silhueta de Árvores contra o Céu Alaranjado, Jericoacoara, Ceará
bing-45616.jpg.headline: Energia e Alegria
bing-45616.jpg.description: O solstício de verão, também conhecido como solstício estival ou solstício de verão, ocorre quando um dos polos da Terra tem sua inclinação máxima em direção ao sol. Isso acontece duas vezes por ano, uma vez em cada hemisfério (norte e sul). O solstício de verão é quando o Sol atinge sua posição mais alta no céu e é o dia com o maior período de luz do dia. Esse fenômeno ocorre durante o verão, ou seja, em dezembro no hemisfério sul. O solstício é derivado das palavras latinas sol (sol) e sistere (ficar parado). Aproveite esse dia para apreciar o sol até mais tarde e se divertir ao ar livre!

bing-45618.jpg.title: Ljubljana, Slovenia
bing-45618.jpg.headline: Holiday cheer, Slovenian style. Ljubljana, Slovenia
bing-45618.jpg.description: What a lovely city! The Slavic word 'ljub' means 'to love,' and it's right there in the name of Slovenia's capital city, Ljubljana, and the Ljubljanica River that runs through it. This relatively small capital, with a population of just under 300,000, grew up on a trade route connecting the northern Adriatic Sea and the Danube region. While modern buildings skirt the city's periphery, its core preserves historic structures, some of which date back to ancient Rome. The Ljubljana Castle, pictured in the center of today's homepage image, has towered over the city for 900 years. Other sights include the Triple Bridge, the Dragon Bridge, and the historic Old Town. Keep an eye out while you stroll around; you might encounter the city's symbol, the Ljubljana Dragon.

bing-45630.jpg.title: Chinstrap penguins, South Sandwich Islands, South Atlantic Ocean
bing-45630.jpg.headline: They've got some things to say. Festivus
bing-45630.jpg.description: Family time during the holidays isn't always harmonious. Sometimes you might be tempted to channel this chinstrap penguin and give your nearest and dearest an earful. If you need a break from all the seasonal joy, Festivus might be the holiday for you. The idea was popularized in a 'Seinfeld' episode, which detailed the Costanza family's December 23 traditions, including putting up an unadorned aluminum Festivus pole and airing their year-end personal grievances. Since the episode debuted in 1997, Festivus has taken on a life of its own both among fans and people looking for an alternative way to celebrate the season. While most embrace the trappings of the holiday season, Festivus is for the rest of us.

bing-45635.jpg.title: XII Carrera Solidaria de Papá Noel en Madrid, España
bing-45635.jpg.headline: ¡Un día lleno de magia y diversión!. XII Carrera Solidaria de Papá Noel en Madrid, España
bing-45635.jpg.description:
¿Escuchas el “¡Ho, ho, ho!”? Puede que sea por una combinación de cansancio y de miles de Santa Claus corriendo por una especial razón. ¡Hoy celebramos la Navidad al ritmo de solidaridad! la ciudad de Madrid se viste de rojo con la emotiva Carrera Solidaria de Papá Noel, una iniciativa que lleva más de tres décadas transformando vidas y que une deporte, fiesta y corazón. Miles de "Papás Noeles" recorren las calles madrileñas, ejemplificando el espíritu navideño y la ayuda al prójimo, todo en apoyo al notable proyecto de Formación Laboral para Jóvenes de la Cruz Roja.

Este año, al ponerte tu barba blanca y tu traje rojo, estarás contribuyendo a cambiar la vida de jóvenes en riesgo de exclusión social, ofreciéndoles una oportunidad de forjar un futuro prometedor a través de una formación personalizada y de calidad. Esta carrera no solo pinta la ciudad de alegría, sino que también dibuja sonrisas en el camino de muchos jóvenes que buscan superar obstáculos y alcanzar sus sueños.

No lo olvides, ¡tu participación hace la diferencia! Corre con el corazón y forma parte de una marea roja de esperanza y cambio. ¡Nos vemos en la meta!
bing-45635.jpg.copyright: © Marcos del Mazo/Alamy Foto de stoc

bing-45637.jpg.title: Albero di Natale in Piazza del Duomo, Milano
bing-45637.jpg.headline: Una meraviglia di luci e colori
bing-45637.jpg.description: La bellissima Piazza del Duomo a Milano si illumina di festa durante il periodo natalizio, con la maestosa cattedrale a fare da sfondo a un mercatino ricco di tradizioni. Tra le luci scintillanti e l’atmosfera festosa, la piazza diventa il cuore pulsante della magia natalizia, accogliendo visitatori da ogni angolo del mondo. È un luogo dove la bellezza e la storia si fondono in un’esperienza indimenticabile, che ti lascerà a bocca aperta. Guarda il maestoso albero addobbato con luci e colori scintillanti che rendono l'atmosfera calda, sebbene sia il periodo più freddo dell'anno. Buon Natale a tutti!

bing-45642.jpg.title: Town Hall Square, Tartu, Estonia
bing-45642.jpg.headline: How lovely are your branches. Christmas Eve
bing-45642.jpg.description: There's a certain magic in knowing that, around the world, shops are closing, streets are emptying, and friends and families are gathering to celebrate Christmas Eve. We each have our own traditions, from filling stockings to hosting parties and playing festive music. Today's twilight homepage shows the gleaming lights and Christmas trees of Town Hall Square in Tartu, Estonia's second-largest city. Tartu's Christmas fair has a merry atmosphere, featuring sleigh rides, fire kettles, and wooden animal carousels, while serving up smoked meats, hot drinks, and gingerbread. Whether you're partying or cozying up with a cup of hot cocoa, embrace the Christmas spirit on this peaceful night—and don't forget the milk and cookies!

bing-45653.jpg.title: Toronto Christmas market at the Distillery District
bing-45653.jpg.headline: Merry Christmas!. Christmas Day
bing-45653.jpg.description: Somebody play 'Jingle Bells' because Christmas is here! The season begins with the lighting of Christmas trees in town squares and homes, spreading a festive glow. Get your boots on and enjoy winter activities such as skating,  skiing, and sledding to welcome the holiday atmosphere. Families gather for wholesome feasts on Christmas Day, often featuring a succulent turkey at the centre of the table. Festive decorations adorn homes, and cities host vibrant parades, events and set up local markets.  Additionally, multicultural influences enrich the celebration, with various communities incorporating their customs. We hope that Santa Claus stopped by and left your presents under the tree. From our family to yours, Merry Christmas!

bing-45654.jpg.title: Caribou running in snow, Alaska
bing-45654.jpg.headline: Merry Christmas, deer friends!. Merry Christmas!
bing-45654.jpg.description: Dashing through the snow on our homepage today, reindeer, or caribou as they are known here in North America, have been synonymous with Christmas for two centuries. American writer Clement Clarke Moore is credited with popularizing them as Santa's helpers in the poem 'A Visit from St. Nicholas,' first published in 1823. And no wonder Santa picked them. With two layers of fur and eyes that adapt to the Arctic's shifting light levels, reindeer are very versatile. You likely won't see them fly, but you might find a herd migrating from tundra to forest in the North Polar Region, North America, Northern Europe, or Siberia. Their hooves can expand or shrink according to ground conditions, keeping their heavy frame stable on soft ground in summer, ice in winter, and steep rooftops at Christmas. If you're celebrating Christmas today, we wish you a merry one.

bing-45658.jpg.title: Carved stories of King Ashoka on gate of Sanchi Stupa, Madhya Pradesh, India
bing-45658.jpg.headline: A timeless beacon of heritage. Sanchi Stupa, Madhya Pradesh, India
bing-45658.jpg.description: Stories from centuries ago come alive on the surface of the Great Stupa at Sanchi, gracing a hilltop in the Raisen district of Madhya Pradesh. Also known as Sanchi Stupa, the monument was commissioned by Ashoka the Great in the 3rd century BCE and is the oldest stone structure in India. Sanchi's massive hemispherical dome, crowned by an elegant harmika and a central pillar, beckons visitors into a sacred realm. The intricately carved gateways, or toranas, tell stories of Buddha's life, enlightenment and the flourishing of Buddhism under Ashoka's patronage. If you're truly intrigued by the intricate narrative of the stone-carved stories, we recommend finding a tour guide to reveal the secrets behind every uncanny detail.

bing-45663.jpg.title: Princes Street, Edinburgh
bing-45663.jpg.headline: Happy Boxing Day!
bing-45663.jpg.description: The flurry of wrapping paper has settled, and the feast-induced food coma is slowly wearing off, but it turns out the holiday season isn't quite over! December 26 marks Boxing Day—an opportunity to keep the festive spirit going or to conquer the Boxing Day sales during a walk through Princes Street in Edinburgh, Scotland, seen here. This day is observed by the United Kingdom and several Commonwealth members, including Canada and Australia. The origin of the day is thought to come from the old tradition of giving 'boxes' filled with presents to people in need on the day after Christmas. Although this holiday is still associated with giving gifts, it also has various customs. For example, horse racing events are held across the United Kingdom, including the historic King George VI Chase at Kempton Park racecourse. Whether you're enjoying leftover mince pie or unboxing a shiny new purchase, just make sure to enjoy it!

bing-45665.jpg.title: Christmas lights on trees at dusk, Vancouver, Canada
bing-45665.jpg.headline: Happy Boxing Day!
bing-45665.jpg.description: The holiday season isn't quite over yet! December 26 marks Boxing Day—an opportunity to keep the festive spirit going or to enjoy a wintry walk through the local markets while sipping hot chocolate. The origin of the day is thought to come from the old British tradition of giving 'boxes' filled with presents to people in need on the day after Christmas; modern Boxing Day is celebrated here in Canada and several other Commonwealth countries. Although this holiday is still associated with giving gifts, it also has other customs. Various events are held across Canada: ice hockey fans gather to cheer on their favourite teams and people gather to enjoy a festive meal and spend time with their families. Just like winter sunshine, the holiday season ends sooner than you think, so make the most of it!

bing-45666.jpg.title: Winter sunrise in Dedham, Colchester, England
bing-45666.jpg.headline: Happy Boxing Day!
bing-45666.jpg.description:
The holiday season isn't quite over! December 26 marks Boxing Day—a popular day to get outside and enjoy a walk after a day of indulgence. Our homepage image shows a wintry sunrise over fields near the village of Dedham, in Colchester, England¬—perfect walking country.

Boxing Day is observed in the UK and some other countries including Canada and Australia. It's thought to have originated from the old British tradition of giving boxes filled with presents to servants on the day after Christmas. These days, Boxing Day is often associated with sporting events. It’s a big day for soccer in the UK and horse races are held across the country, including the historic King George VI Chase at Kempton Park Racecourse. Meanwhile in Canada, ice hockey fans gather to cheer on their favorite teams. Just like winter sunshine, the holiday season ends sooner than you think, so make the most of it!

bing-45678.jpg.title: Kirkjufell, Snæfellsnes peninsula, Iceland
bing-45678.jpg.headline: The land of ice and fire. Kirkjufell, Iceland
bing-45678.jpg.description: From glaciers and waterfalls to volcanoes and black sand beaches, Iceland's Snæfellsnes peninsula has 'GoT' it all. Pictured here is the 1,519-foot-high Kirkjufell, a hill often called 'Church Mountain,' as it is said to resemble a steeple. In fact, it is a nunatak, a rock formation that protrudes through an ice sheet or glacier. You might recognize it from the 'Game of Thrones' series, where it featured in a scene set north of the colossal ice wall. When it's not starring on TV, it is popular with photographers thanks to its unusual shape, coastal location, and colors that shift with the seasons. And if you're lucky, and the weather conditions align, Kirkjufell offers a magnificent view of the northern lights.

bing-45690.jpg.title: Humpback whale, Disko Bay, Greenland
bing-45690.jpg.headline: Jumping off the endangered list. 50 years of the Endangered Species Act
bing-45690.jpg.description: Today is a special milestone for our furry, scaly, and feathered friends: the Endangered Species Act is turning 50. This landmark legislation, signed into law in 1973, has been helping species on the brink for half a century. Who's that in the spotlight? A humpback whale! Known for their haunting songs and acrobatic breaches, these gentle giants are a success story of the ESA. They were once on the edge of extinction, largely due to commercial whaling, but thanks to conservation efforts, their population has bounced back from around 5,000 in 1966 to an estimated 135,000 today. However, our work isn't over. Challenges persist, from habitat loss to poaching. So, what can we do? Spread the word, support conservation efforts, participate in local initiatives, and be eco-friendly.

bing-45699.jpg.title: Hogmanay firework display, Edinburgh, Scotland
bing-45699.jpg.headline: Lang may yer lum reek. Happy Hogmanay!
bing-45699.jpg.description: As the clock ticks down to 2023, Scotland is all set for a belter of a Hogmanay! That's right, the Scottish way to say cheerio to the old year and a big hello to the new one, and this time it's kicking off a wee bit early. Starting today, Edinburgh will come alive with a torchlight procession, creating a sea of sparkling lights through the streets. Let's not forget, Hogmanay isn't just a one-night affair—it starts early and runs long past New Year's Eve midnight, with some even carrying on until January 2. From taking a dip in the local loch for the 'Loony Dook' event to some first-footing luck at your pal's place to belting out 'Auld Lang Syne,'—penned by the country's own Robert Burns—when the clock strikes twelve, there are many fun traditions to take you through to New Year's Day. Whether you're a seasoned Hogmanay enthusiast or a newcomer eager to experience the revelry, get ready to ring in the new year with proper Scottish flair.

bing-45702.jpg.title: Oud-West, Amsterdam, Netherlands
bing-45702.jpg.headline: Oud-West side story. Oud-West, Amsterdam, Netherlands
bing-45702.jpg.description: Welcome to Amsterdam! The capital of the Netherlands charms visitors with its historic canals, versatile architecture, and laid-back vibe. The city's history can be traced back to the 12th century when it was a fishing village on the banks of the Amstel River. Institutions like the Van Gogh Museum, the Eye Film Museum, and the National Maritime Museum offer insights into its history and arts legacy. Amsterdam's canal ring area, built at the turn of the 17th century, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The city is also home to its fair share of restaurants, vintage shops, and outdoor markets in neighborhoods like Oud-West, pictured in today's image. Get ready to pedal because Amsterdam's cycling culture is ubiquitous. With approximately 320 miles of bike lanes, it's one of the most bike-friendly cities in the world.

bing-45714.jpg.title: Daiichi Tadami River Bridge, Fukushima prefecture, Japan
bing-45714.jpg.headline: All aboard the ice train. Daiichi Tadami River Bridge, Fukushima, Japan
bing-45714.jpg.description: The Tadami Line is one of the most scenic railway lines in Japan. It winds through beautiful landscapes over 84 miles from Aizu-Wakamatsu, Fukushima prefecture, to Uonuma, Niigata prefecture. As travelers cross the Daiichi Tadami River Bridge, pictured in today's image, they are treated to gorgeous vistas of the river below and the forests that blanket the area. After a snowfall, the icy blue water of the Tadami River cuts a bold streak through the forest, providing a welcome splash of color in a blanket of white.

bing-45716.jpg.title: 増上寺の梵鐘, 東京
bing-45716.jpg.headline: 今日は大晦日
bing-45716.jpg.description:
今日 12 月 31 日は大晦日。大晦日といえば除夜の鐘ですね。東京の増上寺では、元日の午前 0 時に、御法主台下のお撞きになる 1 番鐘から始まり、108 つの鐘が鳴らされます。その音は、夜空に響き渡り、新しい年への期待や祈りを伝えます…

増上寺の梵鐘は、1673 年に鋳造された東日本で最大級の鐘で、寛永寺、浅草寺と並ぶ江戸三大名鐘に数えられています。現在の鐘楼堂は、戦災で焼失したものを再建したものですが、梵鐘は無事に残りました。

bing-45719.jpg.title: Año Nuevo en la Puerta del Sol, Madrid, España
bing-45719.jpg.headline: ¡Espera, son los cuartos!. Año Nuevo en Puerta del Sol, Madrid, España
bing-45719.jpg.description:
A medida que el último sol de diciembre se pone, la expectación se suma al frío del invierno en la vibrante Puerta del Sol de Madrid. Aquí, una tradición centenaria reúne a toda España: las campanadas que anuncian el Año Nuevo. Cada nochevieja, familias, amigos y visitantes de todos los rincones se agolpan en esta icónica plaza para recibir las doce campanadas que, como un latido colectivo, darán paso al nuevo año.

Con uvas en mano, o alguna golosina, cumplen el ritual de comerse una por cada campanada, invocando la suerte para los meses venideros. La alegre multitud, bajo el resplandeciente árbol de Navidad decorado con luces azules y los edificios iluminados, se convierte en un mar de esperanzas y deseos. Es un instante mágico donde el reloj de la Real Casa de Correos se convierte en el protagonista y las risas y abrazos se entrelazan con los fuegos artificiales que iluminan el cielo madrileño. La Puerta del Sol es más que un punto de encuentro, es el corazón donde late el espíritu festivo y unificador de toda España al son de la esperanza de año nuevo.

bing-45721.jpg.title: Fuochi artificiali di Venezia, Italia
bing-45721.jpg.headline: Anno nuovo vita nuova!
bing-45721.jpg.description:
Anno nuovo vita nuova! Stanotte festeggiamo il capodanno con spumante e pandoro e, per l’occasione, vi proponiamo sullo sfondo odierno l’immagine dello spettacolo pirotecnico di Venezia, con vista sulla Basilica di Santa Maria della Salute.

La notte di San Silvestro di Venezia è un'esperienza magica e unica nel suo genere, avvolta nell'atmosfera incantevole della città lagunare. Mentre il mondo si prepara a festeggiare l'arrivo del nuovo anno, Venezia si trasforma in uno spettacolo di luci, colori e festeggiamenti. La Basilica di Santa Maria si illumina di luci scintillanti, creando uno scenario spettacolare mentre la gente si raduna per festeggiare in un'atmosfera vibrante e festosa. I canali diventano una cornice suggestiva per i fuochi d'artificio che illuminano il cielo notturno, riflettendosi sull'acqua. Le gondole, elegantemente illuminate, attraversano le vie d'acqua, trasportando coppie e festeggiati in un'atmosfera di euforia e romanticismo.

Cogliamo l’occasione per ringraziare tutti i nostri lettori di essere stati con noi durante quest’anno e augurarvi uno splendido 2024 coronato da gioia e successi. Buon anno a tutti!

bing-45724.jpg.title: Fogos de artifício na festa de Ano Novo na praia de Copacabana
bing-45724.jpg.headline: Até o próximo ano!
bing-45724.jpg.description: O Réveillon no Rio de Janeiro é uma celebração icônica que atrai milhões de pessoas de todo o mundo. A história dessa festividade remonta a tradições culturais brasileiras e à fusão de diversas influências. As praias, especialmente Copacabana, tornam-se palco de eventos grandiosos, apresentações musicais e espetáculos de fogos de artifício deslumbrantes à meia-noite. As atividades incluem rituais de boa sorte, como pular ondas, vestir branco para simbolizar paz e oferecer flores ao mar. A energia vibrante e a alegria contagiante caracterizam esse momento especial, marcando o início do ano novo de maneira única e inesquecível.

bing-45726.jpg.title: Fireworks over Phra Nakhon Khiri, Phetchaburi, Thailand
bing-45726.jpg.headline: See you next year!. Happy New Year's Eve!
bing-45726.jpg.description: It's the final countdown! Tonight is New Year's Eve, time to see out the old year and welcome the new. But how you celebrate depends which country you're in. If you're not in the US watching the Times Square Ball Drop, you might smash crockery in Denmark, eat 12 grapes as the clock strikes midnight in Spain, or hang onions outside your door in Greece. In Thailand, you might watch the fireworks illuminating Phra Nakhon Khiri, or 'holy city hill,' a historical park spread over three peaks overlooking the city of Phetchaburi. Wherever you celebrate, have a great one. See you next year!

bing-45728.jpg.title: 本栖湖から見る富士山の日の出, 山梨県
bing-45728.jpg.headline: 今日は元日
bing-45728.jpg.description:
明けましておめでとうございます。今年も Bing をよろしくお願いします。今年最初の Bing は、本栖湖から見る富士山の日の出をお届けします。美しいピンクとオレンジの色に染まる空を背景に、湖の水面に静かに映り込む富士山が、平和な光景を作り出しています…

富士山の北西山麓にある本栖湖は、富士五湖の中で最も深い湖です。湖から富士山を望む絶景ポイントは、多くの人々を魅了しています。晴れた冬の早朝、風が弱く、空気が澄んでいるときには、湖面に映る富士山の姿、「逆さ富士」を見ることができるかもしれません。

bing-45738.jpg.title: Red fox sleeping in the snow, Abruzzo, Italy
bing-45738.jpg.headline: Wake up, it's 2024!. Happy New Year!
bing-45738.jpg.description: Welcome to 2024! Did you stay up late to ring in the new year? If so, we wouldn't blame you for sleeping in like this red fox in Abruzzo, Italy. Whenever you wake up, New Year's Day is a great opportunity for reflection, planning, and a sense of renewal for the year ahead. January 1 has been a big day since the Julian calendar was widely adopted in 45 BCE—modified in 1582 by the Gregorian calendar to better calculate for leap years. Whether you're watching a parade, attending a sports game, taking a chilly dip, or writing resolutions, we hope it's the beginning of a great year to come.

bing-45750.jpg.title: Prayer flags in Phobjikha Valley, Bhutan
bing-45750.jpg.headline: Make your own rainbow. Prayer flags in Phobjikha Valley, Bhutan
bing-45750.jpg.description: This kaleidoscopic column is made up of prayer flags, blowing in the breeze in the Phobjikha Valley, Bhutan. Prayer flags come in five repeating colors representing different elements in nature, blue for the sky, white for air, red for fire, green for water, and yellow for earth. The fluttering fabrics, inscribed with spiritual scripts, are usually raised during times of prosperity, such as on Bhutan's Nyinlong, their traditional day of solstice, which takes place today. As the flags fade over time, adherents believe this signifies that the prayers have been heard and are being carried away by the wind, infusing the surrounding area with positivity and spirituality.

bing-45751.jpg.title: Jaswant Thada and Mehrangarh Fort, Jodhpur, Rajasthan, India
bing-45751.jpg.headline: Jaswant Thada and Mehrangarh Fort, India
bing-45751.jpg.description:
As the sun sets, a warm glow envelops the city of Jodhpur in Rajasthan, India, creating a captivating picture. Within this scene stands the Mehrangarh Fort, which served as the seat of power for the Rathore dynasty and witnessed both victory and challenges. Over the course of 500 years, the fort underwent several architectural changes, beginning with its foundation in 1459 by then-ruler Rao Jodha.

This fort is not just an ancient landscape but a significant part of Rajasthan's culture. Within its meandering depths lie a string of palaces and chambers that bring the secrets of the past to life: Moti Mahal, Sheesha Mahal, Sileh Khana, Phool Mahal and Daulat Khana. The fort's museum showcases royal palanquins, ornate howdahs and musical instruments.

bing-45754.jpg.title: Virupaksha temple in the ancient city of Vijayanagar at Hampi, Karnataka, India.
bing-45754.jpg.headline: A celestial saga. Virupaksha temple, Hampi, Karnataka
bing-45754.jpg.description: In the heart of Hampi, on the bank of the Tungabhadra River, the Virupaksha Temple is a stunning stone-crafted structure and the centerpiece of Vijayanagara, India. The temple is a complex combination of intricate Dravidian and Vijayanagara architectural styles, showcasing finely carved pillars, ornate mandapas and a towering gopuram. The superstructure was constructed from brick and mortar, with numerous captivating stucco figures adorning the exterior of the first tier. While there is intricate detail up close, a bit of distance showcases the full spectacle of the building. A highlight of the temple is the Hampi Bazaar—a street market that leads to the temple's entrance. This lively place is lined with various stalls reminiscent of the historic trade and commerce that flourished in the area.

bing-45758.jpg.title: Coucher de soleil sur les lacs des Chéserys, Chamonix-Mont Blanc, France
bing-45758.jpg.headline: Un panorama unique sur le Mont-Blanc. Lacs des Chéserys, Chamonix-Mont Blanc
bing-45758.jpg.description: Les lacs des Chéserys à Chamonix-Mont-Blanc sont un véritable trésor alpin, à plus de 2 000 m d'altitude, au cœur du massif des Aiguilles Rouges. Imaginez-vous entouré de cinq lacs avec le Mont-Blanc en toile de fond, chacun offrant sa propre sérénité. Les sommets majestueux peignent le paysage, créant une atmosphère unique. C'est une aventure en altitude qui vous permet de vous échapper et de vous connecter à la nature. Les Chéserys sont plus qu'une simple étendue d'eau, ils sont une invitation à explorer la beauté simple des montagnes. Une escapade tranquille qui mérite d'être vécue et racontée. Prêt à vivre ce moment ?

bing-45762.jpg.title: Bodleian Library, University of Oxford, England
bing-45762.jpg.headline: One library to rule them all. J.R.R. Tolkien Day
bing-45762.jpg.description: It's time to bust out the furry feet and pointed ears because today is J.R.R. Tolkien Day, celebrating the literary legend behind 'The Lord of the Rings' and 'The Hobbit.' On January 3, the Tolkien Society toasts 'the professor' on his birthday, echoing Frodo's annual toasts to Bilbo on his birthday each year. Tolkien's roots run through Oxford, where he studied English language and literature and later became a professor. Since 1979, Oxford's Bodleian Library has been home to the Tolkien Archive, a collection of manuscripts, artwork, and even a Middle-earth map with Tolkien's handwritten notes. His legacy is one of timeless fantastical tales that have delighted generations of readers since they were written more than 70 years ago. His stories encourage us to seize each day and make the most of the time that is given to us.

bing-45763.jpg.title: Lake Minnewanka, Alberta, Canada
bing-45763.jpg.headline: Lake Minnewanka, Alberta, Canada
bing-45763.jpg.description: For centuries, humans have gazed up at the sight of stars above Lake Minnewanka. The Nakoda residents, who revered the lake for the spirits that they believed reside within it, fished and hunted along its shores with respect. The name Minnewanka comes from 'Minn-waki', which translates to 'Lake of the Spirits.' As tourism began to develop in the Canadian Rockies, a settlement was built on the lakeshore.  As the lake was dammed twice, first in 1895 and then in 1912 to reserve water for a hydroelectric plant downstream, the Minnewanka Landing settlement was submerged by the rising water levels. This glacial lake, which is only accessible by scuba diving, is the second-largest in Banff National Park, stretching approximately 21 kilometres in length.

bing-45768.jpg.title: Klosterkirche St. Peter auf dem Schwarzwald, Südschwarzwald, Baden-Württemberg
bing-45768.jpg.headline: Schnee, Schwarzwald und ein Kloster, welch schönes Poster!. Klosterkirche St. Peter auf dem Schwarzwald, Südschwarzwald, Baden-Württemberg
bing-45768.jpg.description:
Majestätisch erhebt sich die Klosterkirche über den sanften Hügeln des zauberhaften Schwarzwaldes. Unglaublich, wenn man bedenkt, dass dieses Kloster fast ein Jahrtausend alt ist. Im Jahre 1093 wurde es vom Zähringer Herzog Bertold II. gegründet. Im Laufe seiner Geschichte wurde St. Peter viermal niedergebrannt, aber wie Sie sehen können, ist die Pracht dieses Klosters noch immer ungebrochen. Das romanische Bauwerk mit seinem markanten Turm zeugt von der tiefen Religiosität und kulturellen Bedeutung, die es über die Jahrhunderte bewahrt hat.

1806 wurde das Kloster im Zuge der Säkularisation aufgelöst und dem Großherzogtum Baden übereignet. Noch heute kommen Pilger und Touristen, um die stille Atmosphäre zu genießen und die geschichtsträchtige Anlage zu besichtigen. Die Klosterkirche im Schwarzwald ist nicht nur ein architektonisches Kleinod, sondern auch ein Ort der Besinnung, der die reiche Geschichte und spirituelle Tradition der Region verkörpert. Im Inneren der Kirche kann man sowohl prächtige gotische Fresken und eine beeindruckende barocke Ausstattung bewundern als auch die Rokokobibliothek.

Falls Sie klassische Musik mögen, werden hier regelmäßig Konzerte veranstaltet. Erst vor wenigen Tagen fand hier das Neujahrskonzert statt. Wenn Sie es verpasst haben, besuchen Sie eines der nächsten Konzerte oder erkunden Sie einfach diesen magischen Ort und genießen Sie die herrliche Landschaft.

bing-45774.jpg.title: Golden Gate Bridge, San Francisco, California
bing-45774.jpg.headline: On cloud forty-nine. Golden Gate Bridge, San Francisco, California
bing-45774.jpg.description: An iconic feat of engineering, the Golden Gate Bridge stands like a sentinel at the entrance to San Francisco Bay. Pictured here blanketed by fog above the waters of the Golden Gate Strait, its towers, adorned with Art Deco elements, reach a height of 746 feet. The bridge opened in 1937, thanks to the efforts of engineer Joseph Strauss, architect Irving Morrow, and others who wanted to connect San Francisco to Marin County. It wasn't an easy vision to accomplish during the Great Depression, but the investment paid off as its construction created thousands of jobs and boosted growth. It was Morrow who picked the striking color, International Orange, an unusual choice at the time when many bridges were gray or black. He felt it would contrast well with the surrounding hills, sky, ocean, and fog. The Golden Gate Bridge, a testament to human innovation, is a timeless masterpiece blending functionality with beauty.

bing-45779.jpg.title: Mercadillo navideño en la Plaza Mayor, Madrid, España
bing-45779.jpg.headline: ¡Vienen los reyes cargados de magia!. Mercadillo navideño en la Plaza Mayor, Madrid, España
bing-45779.jpg.description:
El Día de Reyes es una tradición milenaria que enciende la ilusión de grandes y pequeños. La llegada de Melchor, Gaspar y Baltasar es uno de los momentos más esperados, donde las calles se visten de alegría y los dulces típicos como el Roscón de Reyes, adquieren protagonismo en cada hogar. Los Reyes Magos no solo traen regalos, también son símbolo de la solidaridad y la ilusión que caracteriza estas fechas.

Uno de los escenarios más emblemáticos para vivir esta tradición es el Mercadillo navideño en la Plaza Mayor de Madrid. Aquí, la decoración es un verdadero espectáculo visual. Curiosamente, el mercado navideño de la Plaza Mayor data del siglo XVII y cada año se transforma en un punto de encuentro para quienes buscan figuras para sus belenes, adornos y regalos únicos.

¡Ven y déjate llevar por el espíritu de la Navidad y la llegada de sus majestades los Reyes de Oriente!

bing-45784.jpg.title: Um belo pôr do sol no Pantanal do Brasil
bing-45784.jpg.headline: Maravilha natural no coração da América do Sul
bing-45784.jpg.description:
O Parque Nacional do Pantanal Matogrossense, localizado no coração do Brasil, foi criado em 14 de setembro de 1981, tornando-se um marco na preservação da rica biodiversidade e história da região. Este vasto ecossistema de pântanos e savanas, conhecido por sua rica diversidade biológica, desempenhou um papel crucial durante os períodos colonial e imperial brasileiro, servindo como um importante ponto de passagem para exploradores e bandeirantes. Suas planícies alagadas e vastas extensões de vegetação abrigam uma variedade impressionante de vida selvagem, incluindo jacarés, capivaras, aves exóticas e a emblemática onça-pintada. Além de sua importância histórica, o parque desempenha um papel vital na conservação da natureza, preservando ecossistemas únicos e fornecendo um habitat essencial para inúmeras espécies.

Com suas paisagens deslumbrantes e rica herança histórica, o Parque Nacional do Pantanal Matogrossense é um tesouro nacional que celebra a interconexão entre história, geografia e a extraordinária diversidade natural do Brasil. Durante o pôr do sol, que testemunhou inúmeras mudanças ao longo dos anos, as águas calmas do Pantanal ecoam histórias de resistência e coexistência. Esta cena deslumbrante serve como um lembrete visual das muitas eras que moldaram essa maravilha natural, fundindo passado e presente em um espetáculo cativante.

bing-45786.jpg.title: International Ice and Snow Sculpture Festival, Harbin, China
bing-45786.jpg.headline: Chisels and chills. International Ice and Snow Sculpture Festival, Harbin, China
bing-45786.jpg.description:
Sculptors from around the world head to the Chinese city of Harbin at this time of year for the world's largest ice and snow festival. From the frozen waters of the Songhua River, they carve more than 2,000 towering ice sculptures including castles, temples, animals, mythical figures, and massive ice slides. The stunning ice creations are illuminated at night in many colors, adding a new dimension to the spectacle.

The Harbin International Ice and Snow Sculpture Festival, in China's northernmost province Heilongjiang, began as a garden party with ice lanterns in 1963. Today it attracts millions of visitors each year. In 2007, a team of 600 sculptors created the world's largest snow sculpture here, an Olympic-themed landscape measuring 115 feet in height and 656 feet in length.

bing-45787.jpg.title: Bavarian Alps, Germany
bing-45787.jpg.headline: Bavarian Alps, Germany
bing-45787.jpg.description: The crisp winter air settles above the snow-covered mountain landscape of the Bavarian Alps, located in Germany's southern region and continuing across the border into Austria. Its snowy peaks are reflected in the smooth mirror of the frozen lake, giving the impression of harmonious silence and tranquility—which might be interrupted by the soft crunch of the snow under the footsteps of hikers or travellers. Today, Southern Bavaria has become a well-known destination for skiing and snowboarding enthusiasts.

bing-45793.jpg.title: Artigianato natalizio a Piazza Navona, Roma
bing-45793.jpg.headline: L'Epifania, tutte le feste porta via!
bing-45793.jpg.description:
In Italia, il 6 gennaio è una data speciale che racchiude due significati diversi ma complementari. Da un lato, si celebra l'Epifania, una solenne festa cristiana che ricorda la visita dei tre Re Magi, guidati dalla stella cometa, alla grotta di Betlemme dove nacque Gesù. Questo evento simboleggia la rivelazione di Gesù come Figlio di Dio a tutte le genti. Dall'altro lato, si festeggia la Befana, una simpatica tradizione popolare che vede una vecchia signora volare sulla sua scopa per portare doni ai bambini, riempiendo le loro calze di dolciumi o carbone a seconda del loro comportamento. L'Epifania, che in molte culture si festeggia il 6 gennaio, segna anche la fine del periodo natalizio e l'inizio di un nuovo anno.

Si racconta che questa figura folkloristica, una vecchia strega benevola montata su una scopa, visiti le case per riempire le calze dei bambini con dolci e piccoli regali. La Befana rappresenta il simbolo della generosità e della condivisione durante la festa dell'Epifania, portando gioia soprattutto ai più piccoli.

bing-45794.jpg.title: Antilles françaises, Guadeloupe, brume sur le volcan de la Soufrière
bing-45794.jpg.headline: Que la fête commence !. Carnaval de Guadeloupe
bing-45794.jpg.description:
Explorez les mystères de « vyé madanm là » en Guadeloupe, mieux connue sous le nom de La Soufrière ! Ce volcan actif, niché dans le superbe parc national de la Guadeloupe, se dresse fièrement dans le sud de l'île de Basse-Terre. À une petite dizaine de kilomètres au sud-ouest, la charmante commune de Basse-Terre offre une vue imprenable, tandis que les chutes du Carbet ajoutent une touche magique à son flanc est.

Saviez-vous que ce volcan n’est pas le seul à s’agiter sur l’île ! Cette journée marque le début du carnaval de Guadeloupe, une célébration explosive qui bat son plein jusqu’au mercredi des cendres. Les rues s'animent de déguisements éblouissants, de danses endiablées et de mélodies entraînantes. Le carnaval ne se limite pas à la fête ; c'est une tribune pour exprimer des messages, qu'ils soient politiques, sociaux ou simplement plein d'humour. Alors, prêt à plonger dans l'aventure guadeloupéenne ?

bing-45797.jpg.title: Vermilion Lakes, Banff, Canada
bing-45797.jpg.headline: The sky isn't always blue. Vermilion Lakes, Banff
bing-45797.jpg.description: A journey across the Trans-Canada Highway will take you through Banff National Park and right by the Vermilion Lakes. The trio of interconnected lakes sparkles against the backdrop of the Canadian Rockies and the striking Mount Rundle. These lakes, formed in the Bow River valley, are simply named First, Second and Third. History buffs might appreciate the fact that archaeological evidence found nearby, like obsidian tools and campsites, indicate that people have lived in the area for approximately 11,000 years. While here, you can jump into activities like paddleboarding, kayaking, photography, hiking, canoeing and enjoying the natural hot springs near Third Lake.

bing-45798.jpg.title: Male chaffinch perched on a crab apple tree in winter
bing-45798.jpg.headline: Crab an apple!. Apple Tree Day
bing-45798.jpg.description: Apple Tree Day is a nationwide ode to the art of apple cultivation and the health benefits this beloved fruit brings to our lives. Apples made their way to North America with European colonists in the 17th century. In 1625, the first apple orchard in North America was planted in Boston by William Blaxton. Today, from Red Delicious to Honeycrisp to Pink Lady, some 200 varieties are grown in the US. The chaffinch on our homepage today is pictured amid tiny crab apples. Sure, they can be a bit tart, but they make for a lovely display in winter and some birds depend on them when other food is scarce. Sliced, baked, in a salad, or as cider, how do you like them apples?

bing-45807.jpg.title: Great Staple Tor, Dartmoor National Park
bing-45807.jpg.headline: Nature's balancing act. Great Staple Tor, Dartmoor National Park
bing-45807.jpg.description: With its rolling hills, craggy tors and misty moors, Dartmoor, England is the stuff of legends—literally! From Bronze Age stone circles to tales of old smugglers' paths, this national park is steeped in history. Pictured here is Great Staple Tor, with its stacks of weathered granite, one of the many tors that dot the Dartmoor landscape. Getting up to the Great Staple Tor is a bit like a choose-your-own-adventure book. There are various routes to the top, each with its own quirks and surprises. You might encounter Dartmoor ponies grazing lazily, marvel at the ancient stone rows or navigate through the infamous Dartmoor fog. Did you know that it has over 450 miles of public rights of way? That's loads of exploring. Before you head off, remember it's important to stay on the paths and keep this protected landscape as untouched as possible.

bing-45810.jpg.title: Karlu Karlu/Devils Marbles Conservation Reserve, Australia
bing-45810.jpg.headline: Nature's balancing act. Old Rock Day
bing-45810.jpg.description:
These aren't your ordinary rocks! One of the oldest-known religious locations, the Devils Marbles Conservation Reserve is a sacred site to Aboriginal Australians. The site, also called Karlu Karlu, in Australia’s Northern Territory, is home to a collection of giant, gravity-defying boulders. These rocks are composed of granite, and their peculiar shape is the result of millions of years of weathering and erosion.

And what better occasion than Old Rock Day, to appreciate such geological wonders? Did you know that the Earth's oldest rock is truly out of this world? Lunar sample 14321, or 'Big Bertha,' is approximately 4.46 billion years old—just a smidge younger than the Earth itself—and was recovered from the moon during the Apollo 14 mission. Scientists believe that the rock was a meteorite from Earth that hit the moon, only to be brought back home, millions of years later. Whether you're a geology nerd or just a nature lover, today's the day to rock on!
bing-45810.jpg.copyright: © Yva Momatiuk and John Eastcott/Minden Picture

bing-45822.jpg.title: Skier at Bernina Pass, Graubünden, Switzerland
bing-45822.jpg.headline: Alpine twists and turns. Bernina Pass, Graubünden, Switzerland
bing-45822.jpg.description: This awesome white winter expanse is found in the Alps of eastern Switzerland. The famous Bernina Pass stands tall at an elevation of 7,638 feet and attracts winter sports enthusiasts from all over the world. Fun fact: Evidence of the oldest wooden skis, dating back to around 6000 BCE, was found in Russia. Boasting excellent snow conditions from November to March, the Bernina Pass is a must-visit spot on every skier's bucket list.

bing-45826.jpg.title: Gayathri Reservoir, near Chitradurga, Karnataka, India.
bing-45826.jpg.headline: Water, water everywhere!. Gayathri Reservoir, Karnataka, India
bing-45826.jpg.description: Known for its diverse landscapes, Karnataka is home to several vital water reservoirs that play an important role in sustaining agriculture, providing drinking water, and contributing to overall economic growth. Gayathri Reservoir, nestled in the Hiriyur taluk of Chitradurga, is among the smaller water reservoirs in the area, but the sight of its waters spilling over in times of abundance still draws crowds of spectators. The reservoir was constructed across the Suvarnamukhi River in 1963 and is surrounded by hills and greenery. The shimmering blue waters held within create a serene ambiance, offering a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of urban life.

bing-45834.jpg.title: Hot air balloons over the Rio Grande, Albuquerque, New Mexico
bing-45834.jpg.headline: Coming in hot. Balloon Ascension Day
bing-45834.jpg.description: Up, up, and away! Today is Balloon Ascension Day, celebrating the anniversary of the first manned balloon flight in North America. French aeronaut Jean-Pierre Blanchard's flight took him from Philadelphia to Deptford, New Jersey, back in 1793. Interest in ballooning took off from there and today, hot air balloon festivals take place across the country, including Albuquerque, where today's sunrise image was taken. Every year, hundreds of thousands of people attend the nine-day Albuquerque International Balloon Fiesta—the largest hot air balloon festival in the world—to see skilled pilots expertly maneuver their baskets through balloon-filled skies.

bing-45846.jpg.title: Stairs on the shoreline at Mylopotamos Beach, Thessaly, Greece
bing-45846.jpg.headline: Step up to the challenge!. Take the Stairs Day
bing-45846.jpg.description:
It's time to step up! Today is Take the Stairs Day, an initiative by the American Lung Association aimed at encouraging us to make small changes that can have a big impact on our well-being.

To mark the day, we're admiring the snake-like steps to Mylopotamos Beach on the mountainous Pelion peninsula, in northern Greece. The sinuous path to this secluded beach winds beneath the cool shade of pine trees. Enough steps for today? Don't worry, there's a beach bar along the way.

bing-45852.jpg.title: Früchte-im-Frost-und-Eis-versteckt,-Göttingen
bing-45852.jpg.headline: Ein Apfel heute, ein Apfel Morgen, und Sie sind frei von allen Sorgen!. Tag des deutschen Apfels
bing-45852.jpg.description:
Heute, am 11. Januar, feiern wir in Deutschland seit 2010 den „Tag des deutschen Apfels“. Dieser wurde von der Bundesvereinigung der Erzeugerorganisationen Obst und Gemüse (BVEO) ins Leben gerufen. Vielleicht wissen Sie nicht, dass es in Deutschland über 2.000 Apfelsorten und- varietäten gibt. Außerdem gehört diese besondere Frucht zu den am meisten verzehrten Obstsorten unseres Landes.

Das Max-Planck-Institut hat durch archäologische Funde nachgewiesen, dass es die verbotene Frucht schon seit Jahrmillionen gibt und die Menschen, vor allem in Europa und Teilen Asiens, sie seit Jahrtausenden essen. Kein Wunder, denn die Frucht ist nicht nur lecker, sondern auch gesund, da sie reich an Vitaminen, Ballaststoffen und Antioxidantien ist und somit das Immunsystem stärkt.

Wie schon erwähnt, gibt es bei uns in Deutschland viele Apfelsorten, ob süß, sauer, knackig oder zart. „Elstar“, „Janagold“ und „Braeburn“ gehören zu den beliebtesten Sorten. Wenn Sie diesen Tag feiern möchten, besuchen Sie doch einen Bauernmarkt in Ihrer Nähe. Sie tun damit den traditionellen Märkten etwas Gutes, kaufen regional ein und nicht zuletzt gönnen Sie Ihrem Körper eine gesunde und nahrhafte Frucht. Beißen Sie rein!

bing-45858.jpg.title: Eurasian lynx in the snow
bing-45858.jpg.headline: A whiskered wanderer. Eurasian lynx
bing-45858.jpg.description: Ready for a next-level staring contest? Don’t worry, you're unlikely to come face to face with a Eurasian lynx like this one, padding through the snow on our homepage. This elusive predator prowls around the forests of northern Europe and Siberia and the hills and mountains of Central Asia, often unnoticed by humans. Their low calls can be heard by other lynx, and they are primarily active at night, dawn, and dusk, although they can hunt by day if needed. These solitary hunters have keen senses and remarkable agility, able to climb trees and jump more than 6 feet straight up to catch prey. In temperate forests, they mainly dine out on rabbits, hares, marmots, and other small mammals, although they can take on prey as large as deer.

bing-45863.jpg.title: Imagen aérea de La Sargrada Familia, Barcelona, España
bing-45863.jpg.headline: ¡La mayor fiesta está ahí!. La Sargrada Familia, Barcelona, España
bing-45863.jpg.description:
Barcelona se engalana cada enero con la Festa Major de Sant Antoni, un despliegue de tradición y color que invita a vecinos y visitantes a celebrar la diversidad cultural de la ciudad. La fiesta honra a San Antonio Abad, patrón de los animales, y todavía hoy, la "bendición de los animales" es uno de sus actos más entrañables. ¿Sabías que durante estos días las calles se transforman en un escenario de historia viva? Es la ocasión perfecta para disfrutar de los "Tres Tombs", una marcha de caballos y carruajes, sin duda, un evento que evoca recuerdos de infancia y espíritu comunitario.

La feria de Sant Antoni, con sus paradas de libros y coleccionables, es un paraíso para aquellos en busca de tesoros ocultos. Mientras recorres, no puedes perderte las "correfocs", donde dragones y seres de fuego danzantes iluminan la noche. No faltarán tampoco los "castellers", esos valientes constructores de torres humanas que desafían la gravedad y la multitud se congregan, expectante y admirada.

Sin olvidar el emblemático "Mercat de Sant Antoni", cuya estructura de hierro, una joya arquitectónica del siglo XIX se engalana para la ocasión. Aquí los amantes del paladar tendrán el mejor escaparate de sabores locales con delicias como la "escudella i carn d'olla", un guiso que calienta el alma. O si eres más de dulces, la “coca de llardons” será tu mayor aliado. ¿Te atreves a vivir lo que Barcelona tiene para ofrecer?

bing-45870.jpg.title: Bukhansan National Park, South Korea
bing-45870.jpg.headline: Beautiful Bukhansan. Bukhansan National Park, South Korea
bing-45870.jpg.description: Just a few miles north of South Korea's capital city of Seoul, Bukhansan National Park is a retreat for city dwellers and international visitors. Forests and ancient temples sit side-by-side in the park, beneath the three granite peaks of Bukhan Mountain, or Bukhansan. Among the park's ridges and valleys, water deer, wild boar, chipmunks, and squirrels roam freely. A careful ear might pick out the rat-a-tat of woodpeckers or the chirpy melody of songbirds perched in the trees. The park also boasts Bukhansanseong Fortress, whose current structure was completed in 1711.

bing-45872.jpg.title: 勝尾寺の勝ちダルマ, 大阪府 箕面市
bing-45872.jpg.headline: 今日から大学入学共通テスト
bing-45872.jpg.description:
今日から大学入学共通テストが始まります。合格祈願のため、受験生のみなさんに勝尾寺の「勝ちダルマ」をお届けします。だるまは、インドから中国に仏教を伝えた僧侶・達磨の坐禅姿を模した置物で、開運の縁起物として親しまれています…

勝尾寺は歴史的に多くの武将が勝運祈願に訪れた寺で、境内に数百個のだるまが並び、「勝ちダルマ」の寺として知られています。しかし現在は、「勝つ」とは他者を打ち負かすことではなく、「自分と向き合い、自分の弱い心に打ち勝つ」という意味に捉えられています。今年も勝尾寺のだるまは、受験生を見守っていることでしょう。

bing-45877.jpg.title: Taibor Agordino, Belluno
bing-45877.jpg.headline: Un quadro di ghiaccioli!
bing-45877.jpg.description:
La Cascata dell'Inferno, situata nel pittoresco comune di Taibon Agordino, si trasforma in un'incantevole meraviglia invernale durante la stagione più fredda. Le acque tumultuose che caratterizzano questa cascata assumono una nuova dimensione quando la temperatura si abbassa, trasformandosi in un'opera d'arte ghiacciata. Le cascate congelate e i pilastri di ghiaccio creano uno scenario surreale, dando vita a una vista spettacolare che riflette la maestosità della natura invernale. L'atmosfera silenziosa e la tranquillità del paesaggio innevato aggiungono un tocco di magia, trasformando la Cascata dell'Inferno in una destinazione unica per chi cerca la bellezza invernale.

In questo periodo dell'anno, Taibon Agordino si rivela come un tesoro nascosto per gli amanti della stagione bianca, offrendo un connubio perfetto tra la magnificenza della cascata e l'incantevole paesaggio invernale circostante. I sentieri innevati che conducono alla Cascata dell'Inferno si trasformano in percorsi suggestivi, offrendo agli escursionisti e agli amanti della natura un'esperienza indimenticabile in un contesto invernale di rara bellezza.

bing-45882.jpg.title: Road to Hana, Maui, Hawaii
bing-45882.jpg.headline: Slow down and enjoy the journey!. Road to Hana, Maui, Hawaii
bing-45882.jpg.description: With more than 600 curves and numerous one-lane bridges, it's best not to relax too much while navigating Hawaii's famous Road to Hana. It's hard to stay focused though, as the road winds its way through lush surroundings over 64 miles along the northern coast of Maui, from Kahului to Hana. Make a few stops along the way to get the best views of the rainforests and waterfalls that line the route. Popular attractions include the Waikamoi Ridge Trail, the easily accessible Twin Falls, and the black sands of Wai'ānapanapa State Park.

bing-45894.jpg.title: Whooper swans in Lake Kussharo, Japan
bing-45894.jpg.headline: A feathered symphony in white. Whooper swans in Lake Kussharo, Japan
bing-45894.jpg.description: An elegant creature for a majestic setting. These whooper swans, gliding on the mirror-like surface of Japan's Lake Kussharo, are close relatives of North America's trumpeter swans. Named for their loud call, whooper swans are one of the world's heaviest flying birds, weighing up to around 30 pounds and boasting wingspans of between 7 and 9 feet. Whooper swans are found across Eurasia and are Finland's national bird, spending their breeding season there before migrating to warmer areas for winter. All that travel doesn't ruin their relationships—these waterfowl form strong, monogamous pairs that can last for life.

bing-45898.jpg.title: Kite flying in Ahmedabad during the last hour of Uttarayan
bing-45898.jpg.headline: Up for a kite-flying contest?. Makar Sankranti
bing-45898.jpg.description: Observed on January 14—or January 15 on a leap year—the festival of Makar Sankranti marks the entry of the sun into the Capricorn zodiac as well as the end of winter and the return of longer days. The festival, celebrated differently depending on the state, is known by many names, such as Lohri in Punjab, Uttarayana in Gujarat and Pongal in Tamil Nadu. Although it holds regional variations, it is predominantly celebrated by flying kites, symbolic of the sun's transition. As part of the observance, communities come together to express gratitude for a bountiful harvest. Makar Sankranti is also marked by various fairs across India. Among them is the renowned Kumbha Mela, which occurs every 12 years in holy locations like Haridwar, Prayag, Ujjain and Nashik. Additionally, the Magha Mela, a mini-Kumbh Mela, takes place annually in Prayagraj, while the Gangasagar Mela occurs on the Ganges River.

bing-45902.jpg.title: Chevaux comtois, Jura, Bourgogne-Franche-Comté, France
bing-45902.jpg.headline: Des chevaux et des hommes. Cheval comtois
bing-45902.jpg.description: Bienvenue dans le monde passionnant des chevaux comtois, qui mêle élégance et tradition. Ces majestueux ambassadeurs du patrimoine régional, possèdent une robe baie, une crinière claire et mesurent entre 1,50 et 1,65 mètre, pour un poids allant de 650 à 800 kg. Doté d'une puissance impressionnante, le cheval comtois est réputé pour sa force de traction exceptionnelle et son tempérament doux et docile.  Autrefois utilisé dans les travaux agricoles, il a su s'adapter aux évolutions de la société moderne tout en préservant son héritage ancestral. Aujourd'hui, il est également apprécié dans le monde de l'attelage et de la traction légère, en participant à des concours où son allure majestueuse et sa démarche assurée impressionnent les spectateurs. Au-delà de ses performances physiques, le cheval de race comtoise incarne un lien profond entre l'homme et la nature.

bing-45905.jpg.title: Geomagnetic storm at night, Penticton, British Columbia, Canada
bing-45905.jpg.headline: Chasing the Northern Lights. Northern Lights
bing-45905.jpg.description: Embark on a celestial journey as the night skies over Penticton, British Columbia, are transformed into an enchanting canvas of light. The Northern Lights, also known as the Aurora Borealis, are a spectacular, luminous display dictated by the whims of a geomagnetic storm. This phenomenon unfolds when charged particles from the sun travel to Earth, colliding with atoms in our atmosphere at high altitudes. The excited atoms emit energy in the form of light, painting the night sky with vibrant hues of green, blue, purple and pink. Penticton's northern geographical latitude allows for residents to witness its ethereal glory when the aurora dips low enough. Imagine snowshoeing into a snowy clearing and being met with this gorgeous light show!

bing-45906.jpg.title: Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial, Washington, DC
bing-45906.jpg.headline: A day on, not a day off. Martin Luther King Jr. Day
bing-45906.jpg.description:
Martin Luther King Jr. Day serves as a reminder not only of the man, but also of his mission. He stood for advances in civil rights, nonviolent resistance, and a dream of racial harmony. In 1983, the third Monday of January was made a federal holiday to mark his birthday, which was on January 15. It's the only federal holiday that's designated as a national day of service and the 'day on, not a day off' continues to inspire unity, progress, and the ongoing struggle for equality.

The Stone of Hope statue stands tall at the Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial, next to the National Mall in Washington, DC. It was created by the sculptor Lei Yixin and Dr. King's words are displayed around the memorial, urging us to continue the journey toward a better, more equitable tomorrow. The statue itself was inspired by a line from Dr. King's 1963 'I Have a Dream' speech: 'With this faith, we will be able to hew out of the mountain of despair a stone of hope.'

bing-45907.jpg.title: The Eiskapelle (Ice Chapel) at the foot of Watzmann mountain, Bavaria, Germany
bing-45907.jpg.headline: The Eiskapelle, Bavaria, Germany
bing-45907.jpg.description: The Eiskapelle, or Ice Chapel, is a natural cave tucked in the impressive Bavarian Alps around the Königssee—a lake located in southeastern Germany. The Eiskapelle's formation is attributed to the melting of the glacier that surrounds the Watzmann mountain and is particularly attractive due to its natural icicles and ice formations. Over the years, the site has undergone significant transformations due to environmental changes and temperature fluctuation. Despite the threat of global warming, scientists remain optimistic about this landscape's preservation. The reason? Avalanches that descend from the Alps each winter provide new sources of snow and ice that should keep the cave sustained for years to come.

bing-45918.jpg.title: Lake Louise, Banff National Park, Alberta, Canada
bing-45918.jpg.headline: A little Canadian rest and relaxation. Lake Louise, Banff National Park, Alberta
bing-45918.jpg.description:
Glimmering in aquamarine tones, Lake Louise rests amid the Canadian Rockies in Alberta's Banff National Park. The Indigenous Nakoda people refer to the lake as Ho-run-num-nay, meaning 'lake of the little fishes.' It was later renamed by settlers, inspired by Britain's Princess Louise, whose husband was governor general of Canada between 1878 and 1883. The adjoining hamlet is also called Lake Louise and, at an elevation of almost 5,200 feet, is Canada's highest community.

This glacial lake is accessible throughout the year via the Trans-Canada Highway, and visitors enjoy hiking in the summer, skiing in the winter, and incredible mountain views at any time of the year.

bing-45930.jpg.title: Sleeping wolf in Bavarian Forest National Park, Germany
bing-45930.jpg.headline: Wake me when it warms up. Bavarian Forest National Park, Germany
bing-45930.jpg.description: This Eurasian wolf, curled up for a winter nap in the Bavarian Forest National Park, can rest easy knowing it is an apex predator around these parts. This park covers 93 square miles of the wider forest, where it sits on Germany's border with Czechia. The softly rolling mountains Great Rachel, Little Rachel, and Little Arber pose modest challenges for hikers as they wander through stands of Norway spruce. The forest teems with life, including lynxes, bears, pygmy owls, and Eurasian wolves, like our sleepy homepage friend. These wolves form a close-knit pack led by an alpha pair and have been spotted in the park after decades of being hunted out of Western Europe.

bing-45937.jpg.title: Exploradores en un lago helado, Estany de Colomina, Lérida, Cataluña, España
bing-45937.jpg.headline: ¡Un lago realmente invernal!. Exploradores en un lago helado, Estany de Colomina, Lérida, Cataluña, España
bing-45937.jpg.description:
Enclavado a más de 2.400 metros de altitud, este lago de origen glaciar es parte del espectacular Parque Nacional de Aigüestortes i Estany de Sant Maurici, donde cada año más de medio millón de personas se asoman para respirar la pureza y el misterio de su fauna y flora. Rodeado por cumbres imponentes como el Tuc de Saburó y el Pic de la Mainera, este tesoro glacial es solo uno de los veintiséis lagos entrelazados de la Vall Fosca.

Imagina caminar sobre el hielo, donde el agua baila entre meandros y fluye de un lago a otro en un ciclo sin fin. Pero la magia de Colomina no acaba en sus aguas, el parque, con sus más de 40.000 hectáreas, se convierte en santuario para ciervos, marmotas y águilas reales, mientras que los pinos negros y abetos roban el aliento a lo largo de los senderos.

Aquí, donde la travesía se transforma en cada época, las temperaturas pueden caer implacables y el viento perfila la nieve en obras de arte efímeras, la aventura está garantizada. ¡Visitar el Estany de Colomina es sumergirse en la majestuosidad intacta de la naturaleza y redescubrir los sentidos!

bing-45939.jpg.title: Ashdown Forest Landscape, East Sussex, UK
