bing-47802.jpg.description: Today is about honoring the tallest creatures on Earth and highlighting the importance of conservation efforts. Giraffes have fascinated travelers from around the world for a long time. These animals were once viewed as status symbols and were treasured as pets among royalty.

bing-47814.jpg.title: Amazon rainforest, Brazil
bing-47814.jpg.headline: Getting lost in the mist. World Rainforest Day
bing-47814.jpg.description: Fresh air, rustling leaves, and thousands of wildlife species—welcome to the Amazon rainforest. Covering more than 2,100,000 square miles, this South America treasure extends its branches across nine nations—Brazil, Peru, Colombia, Bolivia, Ecuador, French Guiana, Guyana, Suriname, and Venezuela. Today, the Amazon is home to more than 30 million people, but it also carries secrets of lost civilizations. Archaeologists recently discovered a network of cities here dating back 2,500 years.

bing-47816.jpg.title: 湖畔に咲き誇るラベンダーと富士山, 河口湖
bing-47816.jpg.headline: ラベンダーのシーズン
bing-47816.jpg.description:
河口湖の夏と言えばラベンダー。 毎年、6 月中旬から 7 月中旬にかけて、約 20 種類、約 10 万株ものラベンダーが咲き誇ります。紫の絨毯と雄大な富士山が織りなす絶景は、訪れる人々を魅了しています…

また、同時期には河口湖畔に面した大石公園と八木崎公園で「河口湖ハーブフェスティバル」が開催されます。各種イベントや特産品の販売が行われ、ハーブを使ったジュース、ソフトクリーム、料理などを楽しむことができます。

bing-47819.jpg.title: Cala Macarelleta, Menorca, Islas Baleares, España
bing-47819.jpg.headline: Noche de San Juan. San Juan
bing-47819.jpg.description:
La Fiesta de San Juan tiene un origen religioso y se celebra el 24 de junio coincidiendo con el solsticio de verano. Marca la tradición que, si se pide un deseo al saltar el fuego en la playa, éste se cumplirá. Se complementa con saltos a las olas en la orilla del mar justo cuando se alcanza la medianoche del 23 al 24 de junio. En Menorca, Islas Baleares, se preparan hogueras, bailes y conciertos por las calles del casco antiguo de Ciutadella. Además, se realizan juegos, torneos medievales y actuaciones musicales.

La Fiesta de San Juan no solo se celebra en España, sino en todo el mundo con tradiciones similares, con hogueras, fuegos artificiales y comidas tradicionales. ¡Disfruta de la mezcla de tradición, música y alegría!

bing-47826.jpg.title: Aerial view of an intersection in Dhaka, Bangladesh
bing-47826.jpg.headline: Dark night, city lights. Dhaka, Bangladesh
bing-47826.jpg.description: Welcome to Dhaka, capital of Bangladesh. This South Asian megacity on the Ganges Delta, home to over 10.2 million people, is one of the world's most densely populated cities. Dhaka has been nicknamed 'City of Mosques' because of the hundreds of elegant minarets that dot the city. Here, the cheers from football and cricket stadiums fill the air, and colorfully decorated rickshaws, recognized by UNESCO as an important example of cultural heritage, meander through the streets. Even by rickshaw, it might take you a while to reach your destination: Dhaka has been recognized as the world's slowest city. So, whether you're weaving through its alleys or sampling its spicy street foods, take the time to savor everything Dhaka has to offer.

bing-47836.jpg.title: Rua em Salvador decorada com bandeiras coloridas entre prédios
bing-47836.jpg.headline: Olha a cobra!
bing-47836.jpg.description: Chegou a época da festa caipira mais querida do Brasil! Com comidas típicas, danças, decoração própria, música e brincadeiras tradicionais dessa época, as festas juninas celebram três santos da igreja católica: Santo Antônio, São Pedro e São João. O primeiro é conhecido como o santo casamenteiro e ajudante na hora de encontrar objetos perdidos. Mas a tradição parece vir bem antes das tradições católicas! As festas juninas coincidem com o solstício de verão na Europa e coincidem com a época de colheita do milho, por exemplo, que é a base de muitos pratos típicos dessa época. As celebrações do solstício de verão foram trazidas ao Brasil pelos portugueses durante o período colonial, mas hoje conta com várias influências culturais e folclóricas locais, que variam em diferentes regiões do Brasil. Seja com quadrilhas, fogueiras ou pescaria, o importante é se divertir!

bing-47838.jpg.title: Volcanic crater lakes on Kelimutu, Flores, Indonesia
bing-47838.jpg.headline: The sacred lakes of Kelimutu. Kelimutu, Flores, Indonesia
bing-47838.jpg.description: Atop Kelimutu, a volcano on the Indonesian island of Flores, sit three lakes, each with its own hue and folklore. Volcanic vents deep within the Earth release steam and gas that alter the lakes' mineral compositions, creating different colors, which can change independently. The westernmost lake, Tiwu Ata Bupu (Lake of Old People), not pictured, normally has a dark blue hue. Meanwhile, Tiwu Ko'o Fai Nuwa Muri (Lake of Young Men and Maidens), tends to be light green or light blue and Tiwu Ata Polo (Bewitched or Enchanted Lake) can be red, dark green, blue or brown. The local Lio people revere these lakes, believing them to be the resting place of souls.

bing-47850.jpg.title: Fire Wave, a rock formation in Valley of Fire State Park, Nevada
bing-47850.jpg.headline: Flowing through Valley of Fire. Valley of Fire State Park, Nevada
bing-47850.jpg.description: Amid the arid expanse of the Mojave Desert in Nevada lies Valley of Fire State Park. Named after its red Aztec Sandstone, an Early Jurassic formation made from ancient sand dunes, the park stretches across 46,000 acres. Featured on our homepage is one of its highlights, Fire Wave, a geological marvel that appears like a frozen wave with its red, pink, and white stripes.

bing-47862.jpg.title: Juvenile Banggai cardinalfish with sea anemone, Lembeh Strait, North Sulawesi, Indonesia
bing-47862.jpg.headline: Stripe-tacular!. Banggai cardinalfish with sea anemone
bing-47862.jpg.description: Dive deep beneath the waves surrounding the Banggai Islands in Indonesia and meet the Banggai cardinalfish. Cardinalfish have tiny, shimmery bodies with black vertical stripes and white-edged fins, which help to disguise them. Unlike some finned creatures that migrate long distances, these pint-sized fish inhabit a small world, rarely straying far from their local reefs.

bing-47864.jpg.title: 菖蒲, 山形県 長井市
bing-47864.jpg.headline: 紫や白の花を咲かせる多年草
bing-47864.jpg.description:
春から夏にかけて、山形県長井市では、名物である菖蒲が見頃を迎えます。そして「長井あやめ公園」は、約 500 種類もの菖蒲が咲き誇り、日本有数の菖蒲公園として知られています。この時期に「あやめまつり」も開催され、多くの観光客や地元の人々で賑わいます…

この公園内に咲いているのは花菖蒲で、その中には市の天然記念物に指定されている「長井古種」と呼ばれる長井固有の品種も存在します。昭和 37 年に日本花菖蒲協会によって発見されたこの古種は、江戸系、伊勢系、肥後系の三大系統とは異なり、原種のノハナショウブの特徴を色濃く残しています。

bing-47874.jpg.title: Duomo Santa Maria del Fiore at dusk, Florence, Italy
bing-47874.jpg.headline: Dome sweet dome. Duomo Santa Maria del Fiore, Florence
bing-47874.jpg.description: Welcome to Florence, the cradle of the Renaissance. Let the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore transport you through time. More than just a church, this Gothic structure, with its red-tiled dome, is steeped in centuries of history. Built over an older cathedral, construction began in 1296 under the supervision of architect Arnolfo di Cambio. Italian architect Filippo Brunelleschi engineered its dome, the largest brick dome ever constructed. Its completion in 1436 was the final stage of the cathedral's construction. It's not just the outside that dazzles; inside there are artistic treasures to discover, from Giorgio Vasari's fresco 'The Last Judgment' to Paolo Uccello's intricate clock face. The cathedral complex is also home to the Baptistery, a small basilica, and Giotto's Campanile, a free-standing bell tower.

bing-47876.jpg.title: クリストファー・パークに掲げられたプライドフラッグ, 米国 ニューヨーク州
bing-47876.jpg.headline: 「ストーンウォールの反乱」から 55 年
bing-47876.jpg.description:
1969 年 6 月 28 日、ニューヨークのストーンウォール・インというゲイバーで、LGBTQIA+ 当事者たちが警察による突然の踏み込み捜査に対して激しく抵抗し、暴動を起こしました。その後この出来事は、LGBTQIA+ の権利獲得運動の転換点となりました…

55 年が経過した今、6 月 28 日は世界プライドデーとして祝われ、世界各地で多くのイベントやパレードが開催されています。ストーンウォール・インとクリストファー・ストリートを含む周辺道路、そして画像のクリストファー・パークは、現在米国の国定文化遺産保護地域に指定されています。

bing-47879.jpg.title: Brazos agitando la bandera LGBTQIA en la Plaza de Cibeles en Madrid, España
bing-47879.jpg.headline: Madrid, destino de la diversidad. Madrid, España
bing-47879.jpg.description:
Hoy se cumplen 46 años del nacimiento del movimiento revolucionario en Madrid. El 25 de junio de 1978 marcó un hito en la historia del Orgullo en Madrid, con la participación de 7.000 valientes en la primera manifestación, también conocida como MADO. Estas fiestas comienzan en la plaza de Chueca y culminan con la manifestación y el desfile de las carrozas.

Actualmente, se celebra del 28 de junio al 7 de julio. MADO es la gran fiesta del Orgullo que llena las calles con diversas expresiones artísticas para destacar la diversidad, culminado con el acto central de la Manifestación Estatal del Orgullo LGBTIQ+ el 6 de julio, la cual congrega de manera recurrente a unos 2 millones de personas. Comparte el amor, la alegría y la diversidad en MADO. ¡Te esperamos!

bing-47880.jpg.title: Die Allianz Arena in Regenbogenfarben beleuchtet, München, Deutschland
bing-47880.jpg.headline: Liebe ist Liebe. Christopher Street Day
bing-47880.jpg.description:
Heute vor fünfundfünfzig Jahren wurde eine Bewegung geboren. In den frühen Morgenstunden des 28. Juni 1969 führte die Polizei von New York City, USA, eine Razzia in der Stonewall Inn durch, einer Schwulenbar im Stadtteil Greenwich Village. Zu dieser Zeit war Homosexualität illegal, und Razzien gegen LGBTQIA+-Einrichtungen waren an der Tagesordnung. In dieser Nacht hatten die Gäste des Stonewall Inn die ständige Unterdrückung jedoch satt und beschlossen, sich zu wehren. Die Gewalt eskalierte und führte zu Zusammenstößen zwischen Demonstranten und der Polizei.

Am 28. Juni des darauffolgenden Jahres fanden in New York City, Los Angeles und Chicago anlässlich des Jahrestages der Ausschreitungen Protestmärsche für Homosexuelle statt. Schon bald wurden ähnliche Märsche jährlich in Hunderten von Orten auf der ganzen Welt abgehalten. Der 28. Juni wird heute als Christopher Street Day international gefeiert. In Deutschland fand der erste CSD 1979 in Berlin und Bremen statt. Seitdem hat sich der CSD in vielen deutschen Städten etabliert und ist zu einem Großereignis geworden, wie auf unserem heutigen Bild zu sehen ist. Zur Feier des CSD erstrahlt die Allianz Arena in München in Regenbogenfarben.

bing-47882.jpg.title: Drapeau arc-en-ciel brandi devant la tour Eiffel lors de la marche des fiertés
bing-47882.jpg.headline: Célébrons l’amour et la diversité. Marche des Fiertès
bing-47882.jpg.description:
Chaque année, la Marche des Fiertés attire une foule diversifiée, allant des militants aux familles et aux alliés de la communauté, tous unis dans un esprit de solidarité et de célébration. Cet événement met en lumière l'histoire, la culture et les combats de la communauté LGBTQIA+, rappelant à chacun l'importance de l'acceptation et de l'amour dans notre société.

La Marche des Fiertés en France, célébrée pour la première fois en 1977, s’inspire des émeutes de Stonewall de 1969. Ce rendez-vous annuel est devenu un symbole de la lutte pour l’égalité et la reconnaissance des droits LGBTQIA+. Aujourd’hui, ces marches se tiennent dans plusieurs villes françaises, dont Paris, et sont l’occasion de promouvoir la diversité, l’acceptation, l’égalité des droits, tout en continuant le combat contre l’homophobie et la transphobie.

bing-47884.jpg.title: Foliões enchem as ruas segurando uma bandeira gigante do arco-íris durante a parada anual do orgulho LGBT na avenida Paulista
bing-47884.jpg.headline: Dia de celebrar a diversidade
bing-47884.jpg.description:
Feliz Dia do Orgulho LGBT! A sigla que agrupa Lésbicas, Gays, Bissexuais e Transexuais já é conhecida por muitos, assim como o arco-íris, que se tornou símbolo dessa comunidade. O arco-íris foi adotado como uma bandeira de representação e orgulho do movimento LGBT no final dos anos 70 graças ao artista americano Gilbert Bake, que buscava representar a diversidade presente na comunidade, assim como potenciar uma mensagem positiva e de esperança.

Na foto de hoje vemos uma longa bandeira de arco-íris sendo carregada pelos participantes da Parada do Orgulho LGBT em São Paulo. O evento é celebrado no Brasil desde 1997. A primeira edição contou com cerca de 2 mil participantes e cresceu tanto, que chegou a conquistar um lugar no Guiness Book como a maior Parada do Orgulho LGBT do mundo. A última edição foi celebrada no começo de junho e contou com cerca de 73 mil participantes: desde sua criação, estima-se que aproximadamente 4 milhões de pessoas já tenham participado do evento paulistano.

bing-47886.jpg.title: Pride flags at Christopher Park, Stonewall National Monument, New York City
bing-47886.jpg.headline: The pride of New York City. Pride 2024
bing-47886.jpg.description: Fifty-five years ago today, an act of resistance marked a turning point in the fight for LGBTQIA+ rights. In the early hours of June 28, 1969, New York City Police raided the Stonewall Inn, a gay bar in Greenwich Village. At the time, homosexuality was illegal, and such raids were common. However, that night, the patrons of the Stonewall Inn, fed up with the continued harassment, stood their ground. Violence escalated, leading to clashes between protesters and police. In the following days, there was more rioting as people gathered to protest the raids.

bing-47887.jpg.title: Chausey islands off the coast of Normandy, France
bing-47887.jpg.headline: Chausey Islands
bing-47887.jpg.description: The Chausey Islands, located north of Mont-Saint-Michel Bay, form a Norman archipelago known for its unique tidal landscape. At low tide, numerous islets and sandbanks become accessible. The largest island, known as the Big Island, features stone houses and a small fishing community. The fishermen prepare their boats there, while seagulls provide a soundtrack to the sunrise. The islands are rich in history and local legends, with many stories of sailors and hidden treasures. Visitors can explore walking trails, secret beaches and crystal-clear waters of this pristine paradise. The Chausey Islands are a natural spectacle that changes constantly with the tide, offering a dynamic isolated experience!

bing-47895.jpg.title: London Eye lit up with the rainbow colours during Pride Night
bing-47895.jpg.headline: From London Eye to London Pride. Pride in London
bing-47895.jpg.description:
Parades, parties and rainbows everywhere—Pride in London is back for another colourful celebration of love and diversity! This annual event's history traces back to 1972, just three years after the Stonewall riots galvanised the fight for LGBTQIA+ rights. Over the decades, it's been a voice of protest against injustices like Section 28—a series of now-repealed laws prohibiting the 'promotion of homosexuality'—and a stage for joyous celebration. In 1992, London first held EuroPride and bewitched a crowd of 100,000 with the message of love and equality. Fast forward to 2024, and Pride in London stands as the largest pride festival in the UK, with an incredible 1.5 million visitors estimated to have attended in recent years.

From the activism of several gay liberation groups to the powerful statement made by the Lesbians and Gays Support the Miners in 1985, every step taken in the parade echoes the footsteps of those who marched before. So, whether you're spinning on the London Eye, dancing in Soho or cheering along the parade route, here's to inspiring change.

bing-47898.jpg.title: Cyclists in the 2013 Tour de France, Corsica, France
bing-47898.jpg.headline: Saddle up for Le Tour!. Tour de France 2024 begins
bing-47898.jpg.description: It's time to get pedaling. The Tour de France, the world's most famous bike race, is starting today. Beginning in Florence, Italy, the 2024 Tour will cover 2,170 miles and will be a little different from previous years. The final finish line has always been in Paris; however, this year the French capital will be busy getting ready for the Olympic Games so the race will end in Nice, on France's Mediterranean coast.

bing-47899.jpg.title: A beech forest in Nienhagen, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Germany
bing-47899.jpg.headline: Beech forest in Nienhagen, Germany
bing-47899.jpg.description: In Nienhagen, in the north of Germany's Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, lies a unique treasure: the Ghost Forest, a mixed forest of beech, oak and ash trees on the Baltic Sea. Summer comes to life between its mysterious trees, which seem like watchful ghosts. The small rolling hills and the sound of the sea form the backdrop for this magical scenery. Here, where the air is salty and earthy, the season unfolds in all its splendour. The gnarled beech trees stretch their branches towards the sky as if celebrating the change of time. Their leaves dance in the gentle breeze and fill the air with mysticism. Between moss-covered paths, the trees whisper past stories while the waves of the sea sing a song of renewal. Welcome to the Ghost Forest of Nienhagen, where summer spreads its fingers over the earth and envelops the soul in the infinite beauty of nature.

bing-47905.jpg.title: Mole Antonelliana, Torino, Piemonte
bing-47905.jpg.headline: Orgoglio infinito
bing-47905.jpg.description: Il mese di giugno, dedicato all’orgoglio LGBTQIA+, sta volgendo al termine. Il nostro impegno per l’uguaglianza e l’inclusività però, non finisce oggi. A Torino, la Mole Antonelliana illuminata con i colori dell’arcobaleno rappresenta un potente simbolo d’amore, rispetto e solidarietà. Rendiamo onore a questo mese, ma la diversità andrebbe festeggiata e difesa costantemente e quotidianamente. Ricordiamo le lotte passate e rinnoviamo il nostro impegno per un futuro più giusto per tutti. Mentre il Pride Month sta finendo, continuiamo a promuovere con passione e dedizione i valori di accettazione e rispetto ogni giorno dell’anno. La luce dell’arcobaleno non si spegne mai, e Torino come tutto il mondo, resta unito nella speranza, nell’orgoglio e nella determinazione di costruire un futuro dove tutti possano vivere liberamente e autenticamente.

bing-47910.jpg.title: Stone carving at a temple in Ubud, Bali, Indonesia
bing-47910.jpg.headline: You won't forget 'Ubud' it!. Ubud, Bali, Indonesia
bing-47910.jpg.description: Among untamed rainforests, rice paddies, and steep ravines lies the village of Ubud, the cultural heart of Bali, Indonesia. According to legend, a Hindu priest, Rsi Markandaya, arrived at the island of Bali in the 8th century, discovering an area abundant in medicinal herbs and plants. The village's name derives from the word 'ubad,' meaning medicine. Nestled within the verdant landscape, the village is rich in Hindu temples and local mythology. The mythical character seen in today’s image is Barong, a panther-like creature, the king of spirits, and a symbol of good fortune and prosperity. The Barong dance, performed in a decorated animal mask, is native to Bali.

bing-47916.jpg.title: Schloss Heidelberg, Heidelberg, Baden-Württemberg
bing-47916.jpg.headline: Ein fränkisches Märchenschloss. Schloss Heidelberg
bing-47916.jpg.description:
Das Heidelberger Schloss ist eine der berühmtesten Ruinen Deutschlands und ein bedeutendes Wahrzeichen der Stadt Heidelberg. Es thront malerisch über dem Neckartal und bietet einen atemberaubenden Blick auf die Altstadt und den Fluss. Erbaut im 13. Jahrhundert, erlebte das Schloss seine Blütezeit im 16. und 17. Jahrhundert, als es zur Residenz der Kurfürsten von der Pfalz wurde. Der Renaissancebau beeindruckt durch seine prachtvollen Fassaden und die weitläufigen Gärten.

Im Laufe der Jahrhunderte wurde das Schloss mehrmals zerstört, insbesondere während des Dreißigjährigen Krieges (1618-1648) und des Pfälzischen Erbfolgekrieges (1688-1697).  Heute sind die Ruinen ein beliebtes Touristenziel und ein Symbol romantischer Architektur. Highlights sind der große Fasskeller mit dem riesigen Weinfass und der Königssaal, der für verschiedene Veranstaltungen genutzt wird. Das Schloss ist auch Schauplatz des jährlichen Heidelberger Schlossfestspiels, das zahlreiche Besucher anzieht.

bing-47921.jpg.title: Canada Day firework show behind the National Gallery of Canada, Ottawa
bing-47921.jpg.headline: Cheers to Canada!. Canada Day
bing-47921.jpg.description:
As the sky darkens on Canada Day, a sense of anticipation fills the air over the country. Behind the National Gallery of Canada, Ottawa, crowds start to gather. Eyes lift toward the sky, waiting for the annual firework show, like the one in today's image, that celebrates the birth of a nation. July 1 commemorates the passing of the British North America Act, 1867, which joined together three British colonies, the Union of Canada, New Brunswick and Nova Scotia, under the self-governing country of Canada. The anniversary of the Confederation was called Dominion Day until 1982, when Canada became fully independent of the Parliament of the United Kingdom and the celebration was officially renamed Canada Day.

The National Gallery of Canada, founded in 1880, covers 46,621 square metres, making it one of the largest museums in North America. Within its glass and granite façade, the gallery houses a collection of over 93,000 artworks, including masterpieces of Canadian and Indigenous art, European classics and more. As you wander through the grand halls, you'll come across the 'Voice of Fire' by Barnett Newman and the Group of Seven's captivating landscapes. So, if you are an art lover celebrate here, where art and sky unite in an ode to Canada’s splendid legacy.

bing-47922.jpg.title: Fisgard Lighthouse, Esquimalt Harbor, Colwood, British Columbia, Canada
bing-47922.jpg.headline: Cheers to Canada!. Canada Day
bing-47922.jpg.description: Today, Canada celebrates its national day. It commemorates the passing of the Constitution Act of 1867, which joined three British colonies, the Province of Canada (later Quebec and Ontario), New Brunswick, and Nova Scotia, to become the self-governing country of Canada.

bing-47929.jpg.title: Paesaggio di Siena al tramonto, con Piazza del Campo e Torre del Mangia
bing-47929.jpg.headline: Cosa c’è in palio?
bing-47929.jpg.description:
Siena è una città affascinante, nota oltre che per la sua storia e cultura, per un evento unico al mondo: il Palio di Siena. Questo avvincente torneo equestre si svolge nella pittoresca cittadina toscana due volte l’anno. La prima corsa ha luogo il 2 luglio, in onore della Madonna di Provenzano, mentre il secondo Palio si corre il 15 agosto, in onore della Madonna Assunta. Entrambi gli eventi si svolgono nella suggestiva Piazza del Campo. Risalente al Medioevo, il Palio vede contrapposte le 17 contrade della città in una corsa mozzafiato per la vittoria del drappo.

È affascinante come questa tradizione antica abbia resistito al passare dei secoli, mantenendo gran parte dei rituali che la contraddistinguono. Durante il Corteo Storico, le vie di Siena si trasformano in un viaggio nel tempo.  Ogni contrada sfila con costumi rinascimentali sfarzosi, sventolando i propri vessilli al ritmo trionfante dei tamburi. Sapevate che prima della corsa, i cavalli vengono benedetti alle parole di un sacerdote: “Vai e torna vincitore”? In questa festa si uniscono storia, tradizione, competizione e mistica, il tutto nella cornice di una delle più belle piazze d’Italia.

bing-47931.jpg.title: The World Vision Garden at The Hampton Court Palace Flower Show 2016
bing-47931.jpg.headline: 'Sow' much to see and do. Hampton Court Palace Garden Festival
bing-47931.jpg.description: As the summer gets underway, the Hampton Court Palace Garden Festival blooms into life, transforming the regal grounds into a floricultural wonderland. Starting today, until July 9, green-thumbed enthusiasts and nature lovers can join a celebration that's as enchanting as it is enlightening. Emerging from the seed of an idea by consultant Adrian Boyd, the event first unfurled its petals to the public in 1990, captivating crowds with a parade of porters wearing carnation-adorned hats. Over the years, the festival has rooted itself deeply in the hearts of garden lovers. Covering a sprawling 31 acres (12 hectares), it draws in a crowd of 130,000 nature enthusiasts each year. The festival thrives on its relaxed atmosphere, where visitors can savour the sights of Show Gardens and Roses, accompanied by the clink of Champagne glasses and the sweet notes of live music. So, are you ready for a blooming good time?

bing-47934.jpg.title: The Roman amphitheater of Italica, near Seville, Spain
bing-47934.jpg.headline: Ghosts of cities past. The ruins of Italica, Andalusia, Spain
bing-47934.jpg.description: It was the year 206 BCE. In the wake of the decisive Roman victory against the Carthaginians at the Battle of Ilipa, General Publius Cornelius Scipio built a settlement for veterans on the banks of the Guadalquivir River, in modern-day Spain. It was named Italica and was the first Roman settlement on the Iberian Peninsula. The city flourished in the following centuries and was the birthplace of two Roman emperors, Trajan and Hadrian.

bing-47946.jpg.title: Meerkat family
bing-47946.jpg.headline: Heads up!. World Meerkat Day
bing-47946.jpg.description: It is World Meerkat Day, a celebration of these adorably upstanding creatures. Despite the name, they are not related to cats. They're small carnivores of the mongoose family, native to the deserts and grasslands of southwestern Africa. Meerkats live in mobs, tight-knit groups of up to 30 individuals that forage together, groom each other, and take turns watching for predators. These critters create huge burrows where they spend the night and retreat to escape the midday heat.

bing-47954.jpg.title: Abbaye Notre-Dame de Sénanque, Gordes, Provence
bing-47954.jpg.headline: Entre Histoire, lavande et tradition. Abbaye Notre-Dame de Sénanque
bing-47954.jpg.description:
Au cœur de la Provence, l’abbaye de Sénanque se dresse comme un témoin silencieux de l’histoire et de la tradition. Entourée de champs de lavande ondulant sous le soleil estival, l’abbaye offre un spectacle visuel et olfactif inoubliable. Dans ce vallon isolé, les moines cisterciens cultivent la lavande pour sa beauté et son huile essentielle. Cette culture, commencée au milieu du XXe siècle, remplace les anciennes cultures vivrières. Aujourd’hui, la lavande de Sénanque est réputée pour sa qualité et aide à financer la communauté monastique.

La floraison de la lavande débute avec les premiers bourgeons du printemps jusqu’à la récolte estivale. Les visiteurs peuvent se promener parmi les rangées de fleurs, découvrir les secrets de sa distillation et emporter un peu de cette essence provençale chez eux.

L’abbaye de Sénanque et ses champs de lavande sont plus qu’une simple attraction touristique ; ils incarnent le cœur vivant d’une communauté qui a trouvé un équilibre entre travail et prière, tradition et modernité.

bing-47958.jpg.title: Fireworks over the Hudson River on the Fourth of July, New York
bing-47958.jpg.headline: Happy Independence Day!. Independence Day
bing-47958.jpg.description: Today the sky sparkles with shades of patriotism as our nation celebrates its Independence Day! The Declaration of Independence was adopted by delegates from the 13 colonies on July 4, 1776. The Founding Fathers proclaimed that the colonies were now unified, independent, and sovereign states, no longer under the authority of Britain's King George III.

bing-47959.jpg.title: Zahara de la Sierra, Andalusia, Spain
bing-47959.jpg.headline: Zahara de la Sierra, Andalusia, Spain
bing-47959.jpg.description:
In the heart of the Sierra de Grazalema Natural Park lies a picturesque mosaic of white houses in Zahara de la Sierra, Cadiz, Spain. This village is perched high in the Sierra de Jaral, offering stunning views of the turquoise waters of the Zahara-el Gastor reservoir. It also features a beautiful network of cobbled streets that retain their Nasrid layout. This landscape was shaped during the Al-Andalus period, serving as a strategic location between kingdoms for commercial exchanges and political meetings. Its long history and evolution into a modern town date back to the 16th century.

This rich heritage can be appreciated in emblematic places such as the viewpoint of Zahara de la Sierra, Lepanto Square, Ronda Street and Plaza del Rey, from where you can enjoy fantastic views of the reservoir.

bing-47970.jpg.title: Noah Beach in Daintree Rainforest, Queensland, Australia
bing-47970.jpg.headline: A coastal encounter. Daintree Rainforest and Noah Beach, Queensland, Australia
bing-47970.jpg.description: Welcome to a land where greenery meets the endless blue. On the North Queensland coast of Australia, encircled by dense foliage, is Noah Beach. A fascinating blend of two ecosystems, here the Daintree Rainforest seamlessly meets the azure waters of the Coral Sea. This secluded area of the Daintree National Park boasts a stretch of soft, golden sands while elsewhere there are towering trees, lush ferns, and other plant species unique to the area. The Daintree is believed to have been around for up to 180 million years, making it the oldest tropical rainforest in the world. It is also Australia's largest uninterrupted stretch of tropical rainforest and home to rare species like Bennett's tree-kangaroo, found nowhere else on our planet.

bing-47982.jpg.title: Conwy Castle looking over the River Conwy, Wales
bing-47982.jpg.headline: Built to last. Conwy, Wales
bing-47982.jpg.description: Welcome to walled town of Conwy, on the north coast of Wales, UK, and its spectacular medieval castle. Conwy Castle was built between 1283 and 1287 on the orders of English King Edward I, during his conquest of Wales. Designed by James of St. George, one of the greatest architects of the time, the castle is a UNESCO World Heritage Site which draws visitors from across the world.

bing-47984.jpg.title: 越中おわら節の踊り, 東京
bing-47984.jpg.headline: 今日は七夕
bing-47984.jpg.description:
今日 7 月 7 日は七夕。全国各地で、七夕飾りの豪華さを競う七夕まつりが行われます。東京、下町七夕まつりでは、七夕飾りの展示だけでなく、地元商店の出店や、音楽、踊りなどのパフォーマンスが通りを盛り上げます。そして越中おわら節など、地方色豊かな伝統芸能も披露されます…

越中おわら節は、富山県富山市八尾地区で毎年 9 月に開催される「おわら風の盆」という祭りの踊りに使用される民謡です。祭りの踊りは、哀愁を帯びた旋律に合わせた洗練された動きが特徴で、艶やかで優雅な女性の踊りと、勇壮で力強い男性の踊りがあります。

bing-47994.jpg.title: Rice terraces of Mù Cang Chải, Yên Bái province, Vietnam
bing-47994.jpg.headline: Rice and shine. Rice terraces of Mù Cang Chải, Yên Bái province, Vietnam
bing-47994.jpg.description: Amid the rolling hills of northern Vietnam's Yên Bái province, the rice terraces of Mù Cang Chải district are a mosaic of agricultural excellence. The Hmong people, an ethnic minority who migrated here from China in the 19th century, have meticulously carved these cascading hills for generations. Mù Cang Chải boasts approximately 5,500 acres of terraced rice fields, which flood with water between September and October, reflecting the surrounding mountains and sky. Visitors can also indulge in Vietnamese dishes and colorful souvenirs at the local markets or climb to the peak of La Pan Tan village to enjoy views of this stunning landscape.

bing-48004.jpg.title: A bela cidade de Ouro Preto, em Minas Gerais, Brasil Getty Images
bing-48004.jpg.headline: Charme mineiro
bing-48004.jpg.description:
Hoje a cidade mineira de Ouro Preto celebra seu 313º aniversário! Fundada em 1711, Ouro Preto chegou a ser uma das maiores cidades de todo o continente americano, com aproximadamente 80 mil pessoas em meados do século XVIII. Para se ter uma ideia, a cidade de Nova York nesse mesmo período contava com menos da metade desse número de habitantes. Ouro Preto foi um importante ponto no ciclo de ouro entre Brasil e Portugal, além de contar com esse material na ornamentação das suas igrejas.

Aliás, a cidade foi batizada com o nome de Ouro Preto graças a presença do metal na região, que era encontrado coberto de óxido de ferro que o deixava preto. Essa cidade mineira se tornou conhecida graças a presença de esculturas e obras arquitetônicas de inspiração barroca, além de ter sido declarada Patrimônio Cultural da Humanidade pela UNESCO em 1980 devido sua importância histórica.

bing-48006.jpg.title: Blueberries growing in the wild
bing-48006.jpg.headline: Berry beautiful. National Blueberry Day
bing-48006.jpg.description: Celebrate National Blueberry Day by indulging in the sweet, tangy flavors of this beloved fruit. Wild blueberries are native to North America and have been around for over 13,000 years. However, they weren't commercially farmed until the early 20th century, when the first domesticated variety was bred in New Jersey by Elizabeth Coleman White, an agricultural specialist, and botanist Frederick Coville.

bing-48018.jpg.title: Talampaya National Park, La Rioja province, Argentina
bing-48018.jpg.headline: Towering Talampaya. Talampaya National Park, Argentina
bing-48018.jpg.description: As Argentina celebrates Independence Day, Talampaya National Park invites us to venture into the country's ancient heart. Here, towering red rock formations reach skyward, and cliffs and caves feature petroglyphs created by the Ciénaga, Diaguita, and other Indigenous cultures more than 1,000 years ago. This 830-square-mile park in La Rioja province is also home to some of the oldest dinosaur remains ever found. Moreover, nature's beauty is shown in the local flora, like xeric shrubs and cactus, and fauna. Guanacos, hares, and foxes roam free, while condors, white-throated cacholotes, and sandy gallitos grace the skies above this UNESCO World Heritage Site.

bing-48020.jpg.title: 浅草寺のほおずき市, 東京
bing-48020.jpg.headline: 今日は四万六千日
bing-48020.jpg.description:
毎年 7 月 9 , 10 日は浅草寺の本尊である観世音菩薩の縁日のうち、特に多くの功徳が得られるとされる功徳日にあたり、四万六千日と呼ばれます。この日に参詣すると、46000 日参詣した分の功徳があるとされています。一説にはお米一升が約 46000 粒であることから、「一升 ＝ 一生」とかけたとも…

浅草寺では四万六千日にちなんでほおずき市が立ちます。厄除けとしてのほおずきの他に風鈴も売られ、特別な黄色の掛け紙の祈祷札「黄札」や雷除けのお守りとしての「雷除札」も授与されます。多くの食べ物の屋台が出ており、夜遅くまで賑わいは続きます。

bing-48030.jpg.title: Collared aracari, Costa Rica
bing-48030.jpg.headline: A 'toucan' of appreciation. Collared aracari in Costa Rica
bing-48030.jpg.description: Black and yellow plumage, bright eyes, and an oversized bill—meet the collared aracari, a fascinating tropical bird. Gracing the forests from Mexico through Costa Rica, where today's image was taken, to Colombia and Venezuela, this toucan gets its name from the red marking on the back of the neck. These birds circle through the air in groups of up to 15, and at night, snuggle together in tree cavities. Their song is as unique as their look—a high squeaky note that sounds like 'seek,' sometimes a 'purr' or even a raspy 'grhhrr.' Although deforestation and hunting pose threats to these birds, they are not endangered. For now, collared aracaris remain a captivating sight, a splash of color, and a burst of life amid the sprawling branches.

bing-48042.jpg.title: Gangi, Sicily, Italy
bing-48042.jpg.headline: You are one in 8.1 billion. World Population Day
bing-48042.jpg.description: In 1987, sometime around July 11, the world population reached the 5-billion mark. The United Nations recognized the need to address issues like family planning, infrastructure, waste, and pollution and established World Population Day in 1989. It is estimated that we hit 8 billion people in November 2022 and the UN expects the world to reach 9.7 billion people in 2050. But not everywhere faces the same challenges. While some areas struggle with overcrowding, others grapple with decreasing populations. The Italian town of Gangi, Sicily, seen in today's image, had about 16,000 residents in the 1950s. Today, it is home to little more than 6,000. Keen on revitalization, Gangi attracts new residents by giving away abandoned houses, on the condition that the properties are then restored.

bing-48049.jpg.title: Umbria International Jazz Festival, Perugia, Umbria, Italia
bing-48049.jpg.headline: Armonie cromatiche e musicali
bing-48049.jpg.description:
Ieri è cominciato uno degli eventi musicali più importanti in Italia, tenuto ogni estate nella storica città di Perugia: l’Umbria Jazz Festival, che quest’anno festeggia la sua 51. edizione. Nel corso degli anni, il festival è diventato un punto di riferimento per gli amanti del jazz, attirando artisti di fama internazionale e nuovi talenti emergenti. Qui potrete assistere agli spettacoli musicali in vari luoghi affascinanti, tra cui il Teatro Morlacchi e l’Arena Santa Giuliana, e respirare un’atmosfera magica e coinvolgente.

Vedrete le piazze e le strade di Perugia piene di artisti che si animano in concerti gratuiti, jam session e performance di strada, offrendo a tutti la possibilità d’immergersi nel mondo del jazz. Il programma è ricco e variegato, spaziando dal jazz tradizionale a nuovi esperimenti di fusion, passando per il blues e il soul. Se siete amanti della musica, della storia e della buona cucina, segnatevi sul calendario questa data, perché sarà un’esperienza indimenticabile.

bing-48054.jpg.title: Wildflowers in Mount Rainier National Park, Washington
bing-48054.jpg.headline: Come Rainier or shine. Mount Rainier National Park
bing-48054.jpg.description: In the shadow of Mount Rainier, a carpet of wildflowers bursts into life. Every summer, the meadows around this mountain are colored with vivid shades of blooming subalpine flowers: purple asters, pink coralroot, and yellow tiger lilies, and more. Also known as Tahoma, at over 14,400 feet, Mount Rainier is the tallest mountain in the state of Washington. It is covered by 36 square miles of glaciers and permanent snowfields, the highest glacier ice cover of any mountain in the lower 48 states.

bing-48066.jpg.title: Fairy chimneys and cave dwellings in Cappadocia, Türkiye
bing-48066.jpg.headline: Türkiye's stony spires. International Rock Day
bing-48066.jpg.description: Are you ready to make some noise? Wait, not that sort of rock. Today, we're all about granite, limestone, and slate. There are three types of rock: igneous rocks formed from magma and lava; sedimentary rocks made from a mixture of particles like sand and mud; and metamorphic rocks that are the result of heat and pressure on other kinds of rock.

bing-48070.jpg.title: Silky shark at Jardines de la Reina, Cuba
bing-48070.jpg.headline: A fin-tastic day. Shark Awareness Day
bing-48070.jpg.description:
Ready to take the plunge? Today we're diving into the oceans to celebrate Shark Awareness Day. These misunderstood predators have been roaming the Seven Seas for millennia. The first sharks evolved some 439 million years ago—200 million years before the dinosaurs appeared. Today, there are over 500 species of shark, a third of which are now endangered. For many years, sharks suffered from a reputation as dangerous to humans. They've also been hunted for their skin, fins and meat. But this is starting to change. Many organisations around the world are working to change attitudes, helping people recognise the important role sharks play in ocean life and how they need to be protected.

In today's image, we can see a silky shark in the waters off Cuba. Found in tropical waters around the world, these predators feed on bony fish and will work in groups to trap and eat tuna. They're one of the most common sharks in the ocean, but their numbers are now rapidly declining. This situation is a clear reminder of why events like Shark Awareness Day are so important.

bing-48072.jpg.title: Münchner Opernfestspiele, München
bing-48072.jpg.headline: Die Kunst der großen Emotionen. Münchner Opernfestspiele, München
bing-48072.jpg.description:
Die Münchner Opernfestspiele blicken auf eine stolze Geschichte seit 1875 zurück und zählen heute zu den bedeutendsten Opernfestivals weltweit. Unter der Leitung von Serge Dorny setzen sie auch 2024 mit dem Thema „Ein Brunnen, der in den Himmel schaut“ neue künstlerische Maßstäbe. Jahr für Jahr locken die Festspiele Opernliebhaber aus aller Welt in die renommierten Spielstätten wie die Bayerische Staatsoper und das Nationaltheater München. Dabei vereinen sie traditionelle Opernklassiker mit innovativen Neuinszenierungen und zeitgenössischen Werken, die das Musiktheater in seiner ganzen Vielfalt präsentieren. Neben den Aufführungen bieten die Festspiele eine Plattform für junge Talente und ermöglichen durch Workshops und Meisterklassen einen Einblick hinter die Kulissen des Opernbetriebs. Die Münchner Opernfestspiele stehen somit nicht nur für musikalische Exzellenz, sondern auch für kulturelle Vielfalt und eine lebendige Tradition im Herzen der bayerischen Landeshauptstadt.

Haben Sie Lust auf einen Opernbesuch bekommen?

bing-48074.jpg.title: La Patrouille de France au-dessus de la pyramide du Louvre pendant la cérémonie du 14 juillet, Paris
bing-48074.jpg.headline: Le jour de gloire est arrivé !. Fête nationale française
bing-48074.jpg.description:
Chaque 14 juillet, la France se pare de bleu, blanc et rouge pour célébrer sa fête nationale, un événement emblématique marqué par des défilés, des feux d'artifice et des festivités à travers tout le pays. Ce jour commémore la prise de la Bastille en 1789, symbole de la Révolution française et de la liberté.

Au cœur de cette célébration, la pyramide du Louvre se dresse majestueusement dans la cour Napoléon du célèbre musée parisien. Imaginée par l’architecte Ieoh Ming Pei et inaugurée en 1989 pour le bicentenaire de la Révolution, elle symbolise l’ouverture du musée sur le monde. Sa structure de verre et d’acier, audacieuse et transparente, incarne l’alliance entre tradition et modernité.

La pyramide du Louvre, telle une sentinelle du temps, nous rappelle la mission fondamentale du musée : être un lieu ouvert à tous, où l’art et l’histoire se rencontrent. En ce 14 juillet, levons nos verres à la France, à la culture et à l’éternelle beauté de la pyramide du Louvre ! Bon 14 juillet !

bing-48078.jpg.title: Volcanic vineyard in the La Geria wine region of Lanzarote, Canary Islands, Spain
bing-48078.jpg.headline: Sip, sip, hooray!. La Geria wine region, Lanzarote, Canary Islands
bing-48078.jpg.description: Surrounded by rugged, dark landscapes, La Geria is a marvel of viticulture. Most of the Spanish island of Lanzarote is treeless and covered with black-gray soil. This thick blanket of volcanic gravel is the result of a series of eruptions in the 1700s. By 1775, farmers started growing crops in the new layer of nutrient-rich soil. Volcanic soil absorbs and retains moisture, and the ash keeps its temperature favorable for growing grapes. The holes surrounded by stones you see in our image were dug to protect young grape plants from strong winds. La Geria's innovative approach to cultivation in an arid climate has been rewarded with its abundance of fine wine, fermented from Malvasia grapes.

bing-48090.jpg.title: Tateishi Park, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan
bing-48090.jpg.headline: Seas the day. Marine Day, Japan
bing-48090.jpg.description: Today, we're floating across the waves, following the ocean currents to Japan. Marine Day—海の日, Umi no Hi in Japanese—is celebrated on the third Monday in July. Japan has 14,125 islands and has over 18,400 miles of coastline, so it's no wonder the sea plays such a key role in its culture. It provides much of the country's food and is vital for trading and communicating with other nations.

bing-48101.jpg.title: Summer Milky Way over the badlands formations at Dinosaur Provincial Park, Alberta, Canada
bing-48101.jpg.headline: Cause you're a sky full of stars. Dinosaur Provincial Park
bing-48101.jpg.description:
Amidst the rugged badlands of Alberta, Dinosaur Provincial Park attracts researchers and tourists from around the world. Established in 1955, the park spans over 72 square kilometres of badlands terrain characterised by eroded sedimentary rocks. This landscape houses a treasure trove of fossils dating back over 75 million years, offering scientists and visitors a glimpse into the Late Cretaceous period.

The first fossil discovered in this park was of an Albertosaurus in 1884, which led to an excavation that uncovered approximately 500 species, including the fossils of Tyrannosaurus rex and Centrosaurus. The sediments exposed in the badlands, seen in today's image, have been around for over 1.5 million years. In the shadow of these fossils and under the glow of the Milky Way, the park welcomes all to witness the remnants of an era lost in time.

bing-48102.jpg.title: The Neolithic settlement of Skara Brae, Orkney, Scotland
bing-48102.jpg.headline: Digging into the past. Festival of British Archaeology
bing-48102.jpg.description: Archaeology might not be the first thing that comes to mind when you think of festivals, but the Festival of British Archaeology, July 13-28, is here to change that. Since its inception in 1990, it has evolved into a two-week event. A clever shift from September to July has made it easier for archaeological buffs to explore summer digs and heritage wonders. This year's theme of 'Archaeology and Community' invites enthusiasts across the United Kingdom for an array of in-person and virtual events. Imagine standing amid Skara Brae's ancient stone houses on Scotland's Orkney archipelago, pictured here, where Neolithic settlers thrived over 5,000 years ago. Exposed by an 1850 storm, this prehistoric marvel is dubbed the 'Scottish Pompeii' due to its astonishing preservation—older than Stonehenge and even the Great Pyramids. So, grab your trowel, and get ready to dig deep into the incredible, storied past. Who knows what you'll discover!

bing-48104.jpg.title: 提灯で飾られた山鉾, 京都府 京都市
bing-48104.jpg.headline: 今日は祇園祭、前祭の山鉾巡行
bing-48104.jpg.description:
今日は祇園祭、前祭の山鉾巡行が行われます。豪華な装飾が施された山鉾が京都の町を練り歩きます。これらの山鉾は、釘を一本も使わず縄だけで固定する「縄がらみ」という伝統技法で組み立てられており、山鉾行事は日本の重要有形民俗文化財に指定されています…

山鉾巡行の前夜祭である宵山の期間は、日が暮れると、駒形提灯に灯りがともり、祇園囃子の音色が空に響き渡ります。山鉾の御神体や懸装品が飾られた町会所では、子どもたちがわらべ唄を歌いながらお守りを販売する姿も見られます。

bing-48112.jpg.title: Vista de um barco na Amazônia
bing-48112.jpg.headline: No interior das matas
bing-48112.jpg.description:
Hoje é o dia Curupira! Retratado algumas vezes como um personagem simpático e outras vezes como uma assustadora criatura, o Curupira é conhecido por todos os brasileiros de norte ao sul do país. Embora existam pequenas diferenças na descrição desse personagem do folclore brasileiro, em geral ele é descrito como um protetor das matas, vivendo no interior profundo das florestas e confundindo aqueles que cruzam o seu caminho.

O Curupira é a primeira figura folclórica do Brasil a ser documentada, chegando a ser descrita pelo jesuíta José de Anchieta em 1560 como uma criatura perigosa que atacava índios e jesuítas. Em 1970 o Estado de São Paulo declarou o Curupira como símbolo guardião das florestas e dos animais que aí vivem, além de abrigar uma estátua em sua homenagem. E você, como imagina que o Curupira é?

bing-48114.jpg.title: Medieval city of Rothenburg ob der Tauber, Germany
bing-48114.jpg.headline: Towering with history. Rothenburg ob der Tauber, Bavaria, Germany
bing-48114.jpg.description: Welcome to Rothenburg ob der Tauber, or 'Red Fortress above the Tauber River,' where medieval charm is around every cobbled corner. A self-ruling city in the Middle Ages, this walled Bavarian town once flourished with 6,000 inhabitants, the Holy Roman Empire's second-largest city at the time. The growth of Rothenburg ob der Tauber slowed in the 17th century, preserving its original character.

bing-48126.jpg.title: Coral reef in the Indian Ocean, Mayotte, France
bing-48126.jpg.headline: Deep and meaningful. Coral Reef Awareness Week
bing-48126.jpg.description: Blooming pillar corals, green sea turtles, and colorful reef fishes—welcome to the underwater universe of coral reefs. They are formed by tiny marine organisms called coral polyps, which create vast colonies housing many species. As we celebrate their beauty and benefits, it's vital to recognize the lurking threats of climate change, pollution, and harmful human activities.

bing-48136.jpg.title: Arena da Amazônia, Brasil
bing-48136.jpg.headline: O jogo vai começar!
bing-48136.jpg.description:
Você tem um time do coração? Hoje é o Dia Nacional do Futebol! Conhecido como nossa paixão nacional, o futebol está presente na vida cotidiana de milhões de brasileiros, seja em uma partida com os amigos, no futebol de salão, nos vídeos games ou acompanhando os campeonatos estaduais, nacionais e internacionais! Na imagem de hoje, vemos a Arena da Amazônia, em Manaus, inspirada na floresta que batizou seu nome. A semelhança com as tramas de uma cesta indígena também não é por acaso: foi pensada para reduzir o uso de energia e permitir maior ventilação natural, o que, entre outras coisas, contribuiu para a certificação ambiental de construções sustentáveis que o estádio tem.

O dia de hoje foi escolhido em 1976 como a data para marcar a celebração graças a data de fundação do Sport Rio Club Rio Grande, o clube de futebol mais antigo em atividade no país. Seja você um fã de Pelé, Ronaldinho, Marta, Falcão ou Amandinha, hoje é dia de celebrar!

bing-48138.jpg.title: A young jaguar on a riverbank, Pantanal, Brazil
bing-48138.jpg.headline: Clever camouflage. A young jaguar on a riverbank, Pantanal, Brazil
bing-48138.jpg.description: Spot the wildlife star in today's image. The jaguar is the largest cat in the Americas and is seen here in the world's largest tropical wetland, the Pantanal in Brazil. Jaguars arrived in the Americas some 2 million years ago, migrating from Eurasia through the Bering Strait. Today, they live in various habitats from the woodlands of the southwestern US to the rainforests of northern Argentina. Brazil is home to about half of the world's wild jaguars.

bing-48150.jpg.title: The moon
bing-48150.jpg.headline: To the moon and back. International Moon Day
bing-48150.jpg.description: Today we're celebrating small steps and giant leaps—it's International Moon Day. This day honors the legacy of the Apollo 11 mission. Initially celebrated as National Moon Day, it was recognized by the United Nations in 2021. Human civilizations have gazed at the sky for millennia, contemplating the origins and mysteries of the moon. The advent of space exploration transformed it into the target of numerous missions.

bing-48157.jpg.title: Festa del Redentore, Isola di San Giorgio, Venezia, Veneto, Italia
bing-48157.jpg.headline: Onde di gratitudine
bing-48157.jpg.description:
Che splendore, che città affascinante Venezia. Il nostro viaggio odierno ci porta nel capoluogo del Veneto. Il richiamo di questa città è sempre forte e visitarla è sempre qualcosa di unico. Oggi però abbiamo un motivo specifico per recarci alla Serenissima. Dal 1577 la terza domenica di luglio si festeggia una delle tradizioni più amate dai veneziani: la Festa del Redentore, vale a dire la festa di ringraziamento per la fine della peste. Il momento clou è la notte del sabato, quando il bacino di San Marco si riempie di barche addobbate a festa.

I veneziani si riuniscono per cene sotto le stelle, aspettando lo spettacolo pirotecnico che comincia alle 23:30. Venezia, famosa per i fuochi d’artificio di Capodanno, oggi si illumina con colori e forme spettacolari simili, creando un’atmosfera magica. La domenica, la celebrazione continua con la messa solenne nella Chiesa del Redentore, situata sull’isola della Giudecca. Un ponte votivo di barche collega l’isola, permettendo ai fedeli di partecipare alla processione. Visitare Venezia è sempre un piacere, ma visitarla per la Festa del Redentore è qualcosa di indimenticabile!

bing-48162.jpg.title: Wooden fishing boats at Kendwa, Zanzibar, Tanzania
bing-48162.jpg.headline: Smooth sailing. Kendwa village, Zanzibar, Tanzania
bing-48162.jpg.description: Off the coast of East Africa in the archipelago of Zanzibar is the village of Kendwa. This serene village plays a modest role in the islands' fishing industry, with traditional wooden boats, known as dhows, etching patterns across the waters. The local dhow builders offer a glimpse into an artisanal craft that has sailed through generations. Venture deeper and you'll find lush spice farms where the air tingles with the scent of nutmeg and black pepper. Here, traditional Swahili dishes, including nyama choma, a roasted meat dish, and samaki wa kaupaka, fish with coconut sauce, blend spices with the bounty of the sea and land. As the sun sets, bonfires flicker into life and the island pulses with Taarab, a fusion of African, Arabic, and Indian music. With so much to see, Zanzibar proves that variety really is the spice of life.

bing-48165.jpg.title: 树上的中国小熊猫, 成都, 四川省, 中国
bing-48165.jpg.headline: 和我一起避暑吧！
bing-48165.jpg.description:
今天是大暑节气，既是夏季的最后一个节气，也是一年中阳光最猛烈、最炎热的日子。图中那只在树枝上看向我们的小可爱是大名鼎鼎的中华小熊猫。夏日炎炎，我们也需要放松一下，挑个绿荫密布的地方避暑吧！

中国小熊猫（学名：Ailurus styani）全身呈深红褐色，臀部和背部没有鲜艳的橙色毛尖。中国小熊猫主要分布在云南省和四川省，生活在海拔3000米以下的针阔叶混交林或常绿阔叶林竹丛中。喜食竹笋、箭竹笋叶、各种野果、树叶、苔藓，也捕食小鸟或鸟蛋及其他小动物、昆虫等，尤其喜欢吃有甜味的食物。它们的外形与喜马拉雅小熊猫相似，但比喜马拉雅小熊猫稍大。

bing-48166.jpg.title: Ellora Caves near Aurangabad, Maharashtra
bing-48166.jpg.headline: 'Heart' of stone. Ellora Caves, Maharashtra
bing-48166.jpg.description:
If you love the serenity of ancient temples, Ellora in Aurangabad district, Maharashtra, is where you need to be. The site is home to over 100 caves carved from the basalt cliffs of the Charanandri Hills, out of which 34 are accessible to the public.

The excavation of rock-cut caves at this location occurred in three distinct phases from the 6th to the 12th centuries. The initial phase, from the 5th to the 8th centuries CE, features caves that emphasise Mahayana Buddhist teachings. The Brahmanical caves, including the Kailasa Temple, were carved between the 7th and 10th centuries. From the 9th to the 12th centuries, the final phase, produced the Jain caves. The caves here exemplify the harmonious coexistence of three major religions—Buddhism, Brahmanism and Jainism—showcasing ancient India's spirit of tolerance. While the caves functioned as temples and a resting place for pilgrims, their strategic position along an ancient South Asian trade route also established them as a significant commercial hub in the Deccan region. So, are you ready to step into the past?

bing-48167.jpg.title: Perseidas, Extremadura, España
bing-48167.jpg.headline: No hay estrellas sin oscuridad. Perseidas
bing-48167.jpg.description:
Las Perseidas, también llamadas lágrimas de San Lorenzo, se encuentran en la constelación de Perseo, de ahí su nombre. Son lluvias de meteoros que ocurren cuando la Tierra atraviesa el rastro de partículas de polvo y fragmentos de roca del cometa Swift-Tuttle. Este fenómeno se puede contemplar todos los veranos entre mediados de julio y finales de agosto.

La Organización Internacional de Meteoros estima que este año se podrá ver el número máximo de meteoros el 12 de agosto y coincidirá con la Luna en Cuarto Creciente, pero no obstaculizará la vista. En este día, las Perseidas pueden generar hasta 100 meteoros por hora, lo que las convierte en una de las lluvias de meteoros más prolíficas. Busca cielos oscuros y despejados, lejos de la contaminación lumínica de las ciudades, y disfruta de esta maravilla estelar.

bing-48168.jpg.title: Strandkörbe auf der Insel Rügen, Deutschland
bing-48168.jpg.headline: Ein Wohnzimmer am Meer. Strandkörbe auf der Insel Rügen
bing-48168.jpg.description:
Rügen, die größte Insel Deutschlands, ist nicht nur für ihre natürliche Schönheit bekannt, sondern auch für ihre reiche Geschichte und vielfältigen Sehenswürdigkeiten. Die Insel, die in der Ostsee liegt, war bereits in der Jungsteinzeit besiedelt und hat im Laufe der Jahrhunderte zahlreiche historische Epochen erlebt. Rügen war einst ein Zentrum slawischer Kultur, bevor es im 12. Jahrhundert unter dänische Herrschaft kam und später Teil des Herzogtums Pommern wurde.

Besonders bekannt ist Rügen für seine malerischen Kreidefelsen im Nationalpark Jasmund, die von Künstlern wie Caspar David Friedrich verewigt wurden. Die berühmte Kreideküste bietet atemberaubende Ausblicke und ist ein beliebtes Ziel für Wanderer. Die Seebäder Binz, Sellin und Göhren mit ihrer prächtigen Bäderarchitektur laden zum Flanieren und Verweilen ein. Ein weiteres Highlight sind die historischen Seebrücken, die sich ideal für einen romantischen Spaziergang eignen. Die ikonischen Strandkörbe auf unserem heutigen Bild, die gemütlichen Rückzugsorte an den Stränden, bieten Erholung und Schutz vor Wind und Sonne, perfekt für einen entspannten Tag am Meer mit der ganzen Familie.

bing-48171.jpg.title: Buckingham Palace, London
bing-48171.jpg.headline: Keeping it regal. The summer opening of Buckingham Palace
bing-48171.jpg.description:
Since 1993, Buckingham Palace—the King's official London residence—has been welcoming visitors during the summer months. This is because the monarch is usually away, making it the perfect time to get a glimpse into the regal lifestyle. The tours, which started this year on July 11 and will end on September 29, include access to 19 State Rooms that are used for official functions and events. The Throne Room, where numerous ceremonies have taken place—like investitures and formal wedding photographs—and the Grand Staircase are also on the list. These rooms are decorated with treasures from the Royal Collection, which boasts works by some of the most celebrated artists in history, including Rembrandt, Rubens and Canaletto.

Beyond the palace walls lies a 42-acre (17 hectares) garden that is home to more than 350 types of wildflowers, a beautiful lake and even a tennis court. But this year, visitors will get a chance to visit somewhere they've never been before—the palace's East Wing has been opened for the very first time. So, are you ready for a royal adventure?

bing-48174.jpg.title: Hammock camping on a lake in Central Florida
bing-48174.jpg.headline: Just hanging out. Hammock Day
bing-48174.jpg.description: Imagine swaying gently under a canopy of leaves, a soft breeze coaxing you into a serene slumber while you gaze at the stars above. Observed every July 22, Hammock Day is not just a nod to the lazy lull of summer days, but an homage to an ancient tradition. Invented by the Indigenous peoples of Central and South America, hammocks were called 'hamacas' and were originally woven for sleep and relaxation.

bing-48186.jpg.title: Methoni Castle, Messenia, Greece
bing-48186.jpg.headline: Echoes of history. Methoni Castle, Messenia, Greece
bing-48186.jpg.description: Perched on a rocky headland is Methoni Castle, a symbol of medieval might on the shores of the Ionian Sea. The fortress, on the Peloponnese peninsula in southern Greece, was built by the Venetians in the early 13th century as a trading post and defensive bastion, protecting the coastline from invaders. Its Bourtzi tower, an extension of the fortress standing on a small islet, was once connected to the main castle by a stone bridge.

bing-48188.jpg.title: 川越氷川神社, 埼玉県 川越市
bing-48188.jpg.headline: 「縁結び風鈴」開催中
bing-48188.jpg.description:
蒸し暑い夏のさなか、埼玉県川越市にある氷川神社で「縁結び風鈴」が開催されています。境内に飾られた約 2000 個の色鮮やかな江戸風鈴は、夜にはライトアップされ、幻想的な光を放ちながら涼やかな音色を響かせます…

この神社は、古墳時代に創建された「結びの神様」が祀られている神社で、縁結びにご利益があることで知られています。風鈴には願い事を書いた短冊を結び付けることができ、風に揺れるたびに願いが神様に届くとされています。また、特別な良縁祈願祭や限定のお守りの頒布も行われ、多くの人々が良縁を願って訪れます。

bing-48191.jpg.title: Fiesta de Santiago Apóstol en Galicia, España
bing-48191.jpg.headline: Fiesta de Santiago Apóstol
bing-48191.jpg.description:
Esta medianoche empieza la Fiesta de Santiago Apóstol, también conocido como Santiago el Mayor, patrón de España y de la comunidad autónoma de Galicia. En esta festividad, los fieles se reúnen y realizan el peregrinaje en el Camino de Santiago, Patrimonio de la Humanidad. En Galicia, de donde es la foto de hoy, las fiestas empiezan unos días antes, con un programa de actividades que incluye espectáculos culturales, representaciones teatrales, música de gaitas y danzas regionales.

Hoy, a las doce en punto, las campanas de la catedral anunciarán el comienzo de un increíble espectáculo con fuegos artificiales, conocidos como los Fuegos del Apóstol, que llenarán la plaza del Obradoiro de luz y de color. Además, en la catedral se realizará la Ofrenda al Santo y el Botafumeiro, un inmenso incensario que recorre a gran velocidad el crucero menor del templo, llenándolo todo de incienso. ¡No te pierdas esta experiencia llena de tradición y magia!

bing-48198.jpg.title: Flock of Swaledale sheep in North Yorkshire, England
bing-48198.jpg.headline: Baa-utiful family. Cousins Day
bing-48198.jpg.description: Family gatherings wouldn't be the same without them. Today, we are celebrating the unique bond between cousins. Cousins Day offers the perfect opportunity to reminisce about those shared adventures, secrets, and the countless memories that have brought you closer together. First cousins share about 12.5% of their DNA; this could explain why you often have so much love and understanding with them. So, go ahead and make some plans with your cousins, whether it is a picnic or a shared meal at your favorite local haunt. And while you are at it, don't forget to pose for a photo, much like this group of Swaledale sheep in the North Yorkshire dales of England. Chances are, there are at least a few cousins in this flock.

bing-48210.jpg.title: Forest path in Great Smoky Mountains National Park, Tennessee
bing-48210.jpg.headline: Into the thick of it. Great Smoky Mountains National Park, Tennessee
bing-48210.jpg.description: Fancy a walk through the Smokies in Tennessee, seen in today's image? Spanning over 522,000 acres between North Carolina and Tennessee, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is a treasure trove of natural beauty and biodiversity. Home to more than 19,000 documented species, scientists estimate that tens of thousands more remain undiscovered. Miles of hiking trails wind through the dense woodlands, leading adventurers to cascading waterfalls and scenic overlooks. The park also boasts some of the highest mountains in the eastern United States, including Clingmans Dome, which rises to 6,643 feet. Visitors are often enchanted by the mist that blankets the peaks each morning, giving the park its mystical name. The park is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and an International Biosphere Reserve.

bing-48214.jpg.title: Defence personnel pay tribute to Kargil martyrs
bing-48214.jpg.headline: Valour in stone. Kargil Vijay Diwas
bing-48214.jpg.description:
Every July 26, India comes together in pride and remembrance, honouring the heroes of the Kargil War. The day commemorates our country's major military success against Pakistan during the war. After the 1971 Indo-Pakistani War, direct armed conflicts were rare until the 1990s when tensions rose due to separatist activities in Kashmir and nuclear tests by both nations in 1998. Despite the Lahore Declaration in 1999, Pakistan initiated the covert Operation Badri, leading to the Kargil War that lasted for almost 3 months.

In response to Operation Badri, India launched Operation Vijay, which involved intense combat in high-altitude mountainous terrain, presenting significant challenges for the Indian troops. Nevertheless, their bravery, determination and superior military strategy enabled them to achieve victory on July 26, 1999, a date now celebrated as Kargil Vijay Diwas. On this day, the Prime Minister of India pays homage at Amar Jawan Jyoti, India Gate, to the soldiers who sacrificed their lives for the country. Various functions and events are organised nationwide to commemorate the contributions of the Indian Armed Forces.

bing-48218.jpg.title: Coucher de soleil sur la Seine avec la Conciergerie, Paris
bing-48218.jpg.headline: « Ouvrons grand les Jeux ». Cérémonie d’ouverture des Jeux Olympiques de Paris
bing-48218.jpg.description:
Le grand jour est arrivé ! La cérémonie d’ouverture des Jeux Olympiques se déroule aujourd’hui, mais cette fois-ci, elle ne se tiendra pas dans un stade traditionnel. Non, elle prendra place sur la Seine, au cœur de Paris. Ce qui rend ces Jeux particulièrement uniques.

Imaginez des milliers d’athlètes défilant à bord de bateaux, sous les regards émerveillés de centaines de milliers de spectateurs massés sur les rives. Les monuments emblématiques de Paris – le pont Neuf, la tour Eiffel, Notre-Dame – serviront de toile de fond à ce spectacle grandiose. Les sportifs, mêlés aux performances artistiques, incarneront l’esprit des Jeux : la passion, la compétition, la fraternité. Pendant seize jours, de nombreux monuments et sites de la ville deviendront leur terrain de jeu, magnifiant leurs prouesses.

Cerise sur le gâteau : cette cérémonie sera ouverte au plus grand nombre, avec des accès gratuits pour les spectateurs sur les quais hauts. Une première dans l’histoire des Jeux Olympiques ! Souhaitons bonne chance à tous les athlètes et de bons Jeux !

bing-48222.jpg.title: Pont Neuf over the Seine, Paris, France
bing-48222.jpg.headline: Let the Games begin!. Summer Olympics begin in Paris
bing-48222.jpg.description: Welcome to Paris, the City of Light, which is hosting the Summer Olympics for the third time. What makes these Games unique is the opening ceremony, which will be held outside a stadium for the first time. Participants will parade along the Seine on a flotilla of boats, passing under the Pont Neuf, pictured here, and cheered by spectators lining both banks. Paris is no stranger to historic firsts; the 1900 Games included women competing for the first time, although they made up only 22 of 997 athletes.

bing-48229.jpg.title: Foro Romano, Roma, Lazio, Italia
bing-48229.jpg.headline: Rovine gloriose
bing-48229.jpg.description:
Ecco a voi, il cuore pulsante della Città Eterna, uno dei siti archeologici più affascinanti del mondo. Ubicato tra il Palatino e il Campidoglio, il Foro Romano era il centro politico, religioso e commerciale nell’antica Roma. Passeggiando tra le rovine, tra resti di archi trionfali, templi antichi e basiliche, potrete sentire l’eco delle orazioni dei senatori e le vibranti discussioni dei cittadini. Approfittate delle piacevoli mattinate romane di agosto. Se scegliete il momento giusto, non solo potrete godere di un clima mite, ma anche evitare la massa turistica e godere così a pieno questa meravigliosa città.

Dopo una giornata trascorsa tra le meraviglie di Roma, lasciatevi incantare dalla magia dell’Estate Romana lungo il fiume Tevere. Potrete, venendo dal rione Campitelli, scendere per l’isola Tiberina e catapultarvi in un vibrante epicentro di divertimento. Durante l’estate le rive del fiume si animano con festival, concerti, cinema all’aperto e mercatini. Le note di una melodia lontana si mescolano con il brusio della gente, creando un’atmosfera indimenticabile. Un gelato o un aperitivo lungo il “Biondo Tevere”, è un momento perfetto per vivere Roma sotto una luce nuova e coinvolgente!

bing-48231.jpg.title: Cowes Harbour, Cowes, Isle of Wight, England
bing-48231.jpg.headline: A sail-ebration. Cowes Week
bing-48231.jpg.description:
Ahoy, sailing enthusiasts and landlubbers alike! Cowes Week is here, promising a wave of excitement from July 27 to August 2. Held annually since 1826, this regatta takes place on the Solent, the strait separating the Isle of Wight from the mainland. The event was started by the Royal Yacht Squadron, and it has grown over the years. Today, Cowes Week sees around 7,000 competitors in some 750 boats. From Olympic champions to weekend sailors, everyone is here to show off their sailing skills. There are as many as 40 races a day, catering to different classes of boats, from high-tech racing yachts to classic wooden sailboats.

Even if you're not into sailing, Cowes Week offers plenty to keep you entertained. The town of Cowes comes alive with a festival atmosphere. Expect live music, food stalls and a wide range of activities for all ages. The Red Arrows, the Royal Air Force Aerobatic Team, often perform dazzling displays that leave the crowds in awe. So, hoist your sails, plot your course to Cowes and join the fun.

bing-48234.jpg.title: Vineyards in the Mosel Valley, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
bing-48234.jpg.headline: 'Riesling' to perfection. Vineyards in the Mosel Valley, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
bing-48234.jpg.description: Welcome to the Palatinate, a wine lover's dream come true. This wine-growing region in western Germany has rolling hills, fertile soils, and a warm climate, allowing the cultivation of a diverse variety of grapes. While riesling reigns supreme, other notable varieties include chardonnay, sauvignon blanc, pinot blanc, Müller-Thurgau, and Dornfelder. The Palatinate is the largest red wine-producing region in the country, with over 40% of the vineyards devoted to it.

bing-48246.jpg.title: Bathing huts on the beach in Skåne County, Sweden
bing-48246.jpg.headline: Chromatic coastline. Bathing huts in Skåne County, Sweden
bing-48246.jpg.description: When it comes to vibrant beach scenes, Skåne County in Sweden, doesn't disappoint. Today's image features pastel huts in Skanörs Havsbad, a sandy beach section in the town of Skanör. This is one of the most popular parts of the beach, which stretches for over 6 miles, on the western side of the Falsterbonäset peninsula. Located near the Skanör marina, this part of the beach is a favorite spot for bathers in the summer months.

bing-48256.jpg.title: Imagem aérea de uma plantação de café, Brasil
bing-48256.jpg.headline: Plantando para poder colher
bing-48256.jpg.description:
Hoje celebramos o Dia do Agricultor, uma homenagem àqueles que semeiam o progresso em cada parcela de solo brasileiro. Desde o alvorecer de nossa história, a agricultura tem sido o alicerce que sustenta e nutre a nação. Na vastidão verde-amarela, onde um dia reinaram as monoculturas do café e da cana, brotam agora uma incrível variedade de cultivos que enriquecem nossas mesas e economia.

Por meio do mosaico verde que vemos na imagem de hoje, podemos ter uma ideia da tapeçaria agrícola que cobre nosso território. Você sabia que o Brasil é o maior produtor de café do mundo há mais de 150 anos? Assim como nosso café, cada grão plantado aqui carrega uma história de resiliência e prosperidade. Feliz Dia do Agricultor!

bing-48258.jpg.title: Tiger siblings in Jim Corbett National Park, Uttarakhand, India
bing-48258.jpg.headline: Roar and explore. International Tiger Day
bing-48258.jpg.description: We're off to a roaring start today: It's International Tiger Day, which aims to protect these magnificent big cats amid threats such as poaching and habitat loss. At the end of the 19th century, there were thought to be around 100,000 tigers in the wild; these days, there are fewer than 6,000.

bing-48264.jpg.title: Spielende Wolfswelpen in Deutschland
bing-48264.jpg.headline: Ein Fest der Verbundenheit. Internationaler Tag der Freundschaft
bing-48264.jpg.description:
Der Internationale Tag der Freundschaft, der weltweit am 30. Juli gefeiert wird, gewinnt auch in Deutschland zunehmend an Bedeutung. Dieser Tag bietet eine besondere Gelegenheit, die wichtigen Beziehungen zu würdigen, die unser Leben bereichern. Deutschland hat eine lange Tradition von Städtepartnerschaften, die den kulturellen Austausch und das Verständnis zwischen verschiedenen Ländern und Kulturen fördern. Städte wie Berlin und Paris oder München und Edinburgh sind Beispiele für solche Verbindungen.

Eine passende Beschreibung für wahre Freundschaft ist die Beziehung zwischen Wölfen und ihren Welpen, wie auf unserem heutigen Bild. In einem Wolfsrudel herrscht ein starkes Gemeinschaftsgefühl, das auf Vertrauen, Loyalität und Zusammenarbeit basiert. Wolfswelpen wachsen in einem Umfeld auf, das von Fürsorge und Schutz geprägt ist, ähnlich einer engen Freundschaft, in der man sich gegenseitig unterstützt und füreinander da ist. Diese enge Bindung stärkt das Vertrauen und die Sicherheit der einzelnen Mitglieder. Wölfe waren in Deutschland fast 150 Jahre lang ausgestorben, bevor sie Ende der 1990er Jahre aus Polen zurückkehrten. Heute leben laut BMUV über 184 Wolfsrudel in Deutschland. Auch wenn der Wolf heute in Teilen Deutschlands wieder heimisch ist, ist er nach wie vor eine gefährdete Tierart.

bing-48270.jpg.title: San Gimignano, Siena, Tuscany, Italy
bing-48270.jpg.headline: A medieval Manhattan. San Gimignano, Siena Tuscany, Italy
bing-48270.jpg.description: These medieval towers stand tall over San Gimignano, a small town near Siena in north central Italy. In the Middle Ages, a town grew up around a church dedicated to St. Geminianus (San Gimignano in Italian). As well as being a popular stop for pilgrims on their way to Rome, the town prospered thanks to its trade in local Vernaccia wine and in saffron, which is grown in the nearby hills. However, when the Black Death struck in 1348, half the population was lost, slowing the town's development and preserving its medieval character to this day.

bing-48282.jpg.title: Hoodoos, Sunset Point, Bryce Canyon National Park, Utah
bing-48282.jpg.headline: 'Hoodoo' we have here?. Hoodoos, Sunset Point, Bryce Canyon National Park, Utah
bing-48282.jpg.description: Let's take a trip to a forest of stones. Sunset Point, seen in today's image, offers sweeping views of the hoodoos of Utah's Bryce Canyon National Park. These rock formations are created by frost weathering and stream erosion, which shape the stone into an otherworldly landscape. Perched at 8,000 to 9,000 feet, this overlook offers a panoramic view of rocky spires in red, orange, and white. The most iconic of them is Thor's Hammer, a hoodoo that overlooks a part of the park known as the 'Silent City.' The Queen's Garden Trail, which leads from Sunset Point to Sunrise Point, offers even more vistas and rock formations, including the Queen Victoria hoodoo. According to the legend told by the Paiute Indigenous people who inhabited this area, hoodoos are people who have been turned to stone for their misdeeds by the trickster Coyote. Whether you're a hiker, a photographer, or simply a traveler, the hoodoos are waiting.

bing-48284.jpg.title: 豪華絢爛なねぷた, 青森県 弘前市
bing-48284.jpg.headline: 今日から弘前ねぷたまつり
bing-48284.jpg.description:
今日 8 月 1 日から 7 日まで、青森県弘前市では、色と光の祭典である「弘前ねぷたまつり」が開催されます。太鼓や笛の音色が響き渡り、「ヤーヤドー」の掛け声とともに、大小約 80 台のねぷたが夜の町を練り歩きます…

ねぷたには、扇型の「扇ねぷた」と人形型の「組ねぷた」の 2 種類があり、特に大型のねぷたは高さ 9m を超えるものもあります。題材には中国の三国志や水滸伝、和物では源平盛衰記、津軽為信などが多く用いられます。

bing-48294.jpg.title: Floating market, Kaptai Lake, Rangamati, Bangladesh
bing-48294.jpg.headline: There's a boatload of bargains here. Floating market, Kaptai Lake, Bangladesh
bing-48294.jpg.description: Every Saturday, the largest artificial lake in Bangladesh comes to life with colors and flavors. Kaptai Lake in Rangamati District is home to the floating market of seasonal fruit seen in today's image. The lake was created in the early 1960s to generate hydropower, submerging not just land and the palace of the king of the Chakmas, Bangladesh's largest ethnic minority group, but a way of life, displacing 100,000 people. Sixty years on and the landscape has changed. This buoyant bazaar has become a livelihood, as farmers navigate their wooden vessels along the bank to engage with eager buyers. You leave with a bag full of fresh fruit or just a bunch of unforgettable memories, whatever floats your boat.

bing-48305.jpg.title: A family of Canadian geese swimming in a lake in Banff National Park, Alberta
bing-48305.jpg.headline: Feathered friends. Banff National Park, Alberta
bing-48305.jpg.description:
Amidst the Rocky Mountains in Banff National Park, Alberta, a family of Canadian geese glides across the lake in today’s image. Established in 1885 as Canada's first national park, its history is intertwined with that of the Canadian Pacific Railway. The park's discovery was fuelled by workers laying tracks through the wilderness when they came across a hot water spring, which is now a part of the park. These lands were once walked by Indigenous peoples including the Stoney Nakoda, Tsuut'ina, Cree and Kainaiwa, and later by European explorers. It now offers refuge to diverse wildlife, like the mountain bluebird, elk, mule deer, white-tailed deer and Canadian goose. The park covers an area of 6,641 square kilometres.

The Canadian geese can be recognised by their black heads and white cheek patches, which are also known as 'chinstraps.' They are resilient travellers, enduring thousands of kilometres of migration, flying in a V-shaped formation. While in Banff National Park, you might come across geese teaching their goslings to navigate the waters. It is not just a park; it's a theatre where nature is on display.

bing-48306.jpg.title: Trunk Bay, St. John, Virgin Islands National Park
bing-48306.jpg.headline: Somewhere under the rainbow. Virgin Islands National Park established
bing-48306.jpg.description: In 1956, businessman and conservationist Laurance Rockefeller saw the beauty of St. John, one of the US Virgin Islands in the Caribbean, and knew it had to be preserved. He donated more than 5,000 acres of land to the National Park Service, and today we're marking the 68th anniversary of Virgin Islands National Park. Covering about 60% of St. John and 5,650 acres of submerged lands, the park boasts stunning white-sand beaches, coral reefs, and historic sites.

bing-48307.jpg.title: Sunset over Anse Champagne beach in Saint-François, Guadeloupe, Caribbean
bing-48307.jpg.headline: Saint-François, Guadeloupe, Caribbean
bing-48307.jpg.description:
Saint-François, located on the southeastern coast of Grande-Terre in Guadeloupe, is an idyllic Caribbean destination. Famous for its white-sand beaches and crystal-clear waters, it attracts lovers of the sea and the sun. The Saint-François marina is a central point, offering boat trips to neighbouring islands, such as Marie-Galante and Les Saintes.

The local market is a must-see, where the stalls are full of tropical fruits, spices and local crafts, offering a true immersion in Guadeloupean culture. Golf enthusiasts will enjoy the 18-hole course with ocean views, while history buffs can visit the former prison converted into a museum. Saint-François is also known for its relaxed and friendly atmosphere. The seaside restaurants serve Creole specialities and the evenings are livened up by local music. A true jewel of the Caribbean, Saint-François is a real tropical paradise!

bing-48311.jpg.title: Atardecer en Ribadesella, Asturias, España
bing-48311.jpg.headline: ¡Que empiece el descenso!. Ribadesella, Asturias, España
bing-48311.jpg.description:
¡Atención piragüistas, aficionados y espectadores! ¡Han llegado las Fiestas de las Piraguas! También conocidas como el Descenso Internacional del Río Sella, este evento emblemático implica un emocionante recorrido de 20 kilómetros en piraguas o kayaks a lo largo del majestuoso río Sella, culminando en el icónico Puente Emilio Llamedo. Desde Arriondas hasta Ribadesella, Asturias, las calles rebosan de desfiles que acompañan y alientan a todos los participantes. Esta competición, una de las más antiguas en el mundo del piragüismo, se ha convertido en una de las celebraciones más populares y concurridas de España, atrayendo anualmente a unas 300.000 personas.

Más allá de la competencia deportiva, las festividades incluyen desfiles, música, bailes y una vibrante celebración en ambas localidades. Además de los piragüistas, están los romeros que participan en los desfiles fluviales, llenando el ambiente con cánticos y una contagiosa alegría. Luego, por la noche, la fiesta continúa con música en vivo, impresionantes fuegos artificiales, eventos culturales y, como dice el refrán, "sidra y buen yantar, ¡asturianos a berrar!".

bing-48314.jpg.title: Faon chevreuil, Normandie
bing-48314.jpg.headline: Rencontre avec les faons chevreuils. Le chevreuil faon
bing-48314.jpg.description:
Lorsque les journées s’allongent et que les forêts se parent de verdure, les faons chevreuils font leur apparition. Ces petits cervidés, agiles et discrets, égayent nos bois et prairies pendant la saison estivale.
