As you walk through its streets, you'll notice façades adorned with azulejos—painted tin-glazed ceramic tilework found in Portugal and Spain—historic churches like São Francisco, and the iconic Dom Luís I Bridge spanning the Douro River, which runs through the city.

bing-50424.jpg.title: India Gate, New Delhi
bing-50424.jpg.headline: Three shades, one spirit. Republic Day
bing-50424.jpg.description:
Republic Day isn't just any other occasion—it's an emotion. Every year on this day, the country wakes up to patriotic anthems, flag hoistings and a sense of unity. In 1950, on this day, India adopted its Constitution, officially becoming a sovereign republic. The President of India delivers an address to the nation on the eve of Republic Day. On the day itself, he raises the national flag in New Delhi, while Governors and Lieutenant Governors perform flag-hoisting ceremonies in their respective states and union territories.

The grandest celebration unfolds along the Kartavya Path in New Delhi, a ceremonial boulevard stretching from the majestic Rashtrapati Bhavan on Raisina Hill to the India Gate. The President, serving as the Commander-in-Chief of the Indian Armed Forces, presides over the Republic Day celebrations with grand parades and vibrant cultural performances. Organised by the Ministry of Defence, the highlight of the event is the Delhi Republic Day parade, where the President takes the ceremonial salute from marching contingents of the army, navy, air force, paramilitary and police forces.

bing-50432.jpg.title: European beech forest in Belgium
bing-50432.jpg.headline: Aging gracefully. European beech forest, Belgium
bing-50432.jpg.description: Beech trees are pretty amazing. There are several species worldwide, but the European beech steals the spotlight in much of Europe. With its smooth gray bark, short trunk, and sweeping branches, this tree is a standout in Belgium's forests, as shown in today's image. It grows in temperate regions and prefers well-drained, fertile soils, taking up to 30 years to mature. Not only do these 160-foot-tall trees dominate the landscape, but their wood is also used to make some of the sturdiest furniture, flooring, and even kitchen tools.

bing-50440.jpg.title: La tour Eiffel sous la neige, Paris
bing-50440.jpg.headline: Flocons sur la Ville Lumière. La tour Eiffel
bing-50440.jpg.description:
Saviez-vous que la tour Eiffel, cette icône parisienne, a été construite en seulement 2 ans, 2 mois et 5 jours pour l’Exposition universelle de 1889 qui célébrait le centenaire de la Révolution Française ? Ce monument n’a pas toujours été adoré : à ses débuts, des artistes célèbres la qualifiaient de « monstruosité ». Aujourd’hui, elle est incontournable.

Mais la Dame de fer cache bien des secrets. Pendant la Première Guerre mondiale, elle a servi de station radio pour intercepter les communications ennemies, jouant un rôle décisif. Et saviez-vous qu’elle est repeinte tous les 7 ans, nécessitant 60 tonnes de peinture pour préserver son éclat ?

En hiver, lorsqu’elle se couvre de neige, la tour Eiffel dévoile une magie particulière, rappelant que Paris reste la capitale de la beauté et de la surprise. Une légende vivante, à la fois monument historique et témoin des avancées techniques de son époque, qui continue de fasciner les visiteurs du monde entier.

bing-50444.jpg.title: Zoroaster Temple, Grand Canyon National Park, Arizona
bing-50444.jpg.headline: Peaked your curiosity. Zoroaster Temple, Grand Canyon National Park, Arizona
bing-50444.jpg.description: Carved by the Colorado River, nearly 2 billion years of Earth's history are exposed in the layers of the Grand Canyon. While geologists continue to debate parts of the formation story of the canyon, recent studies suggest the river carved its path through the region about 5 to 6 million years ago. Since then, the river has been deepening and widening the canyon while sculpting its dramatic geographic features.

bing-50447.jpg.title: 夜空中的烟花表演，长沙，湖南省，中国
bing-50447.jpg.headline: 祝您阖家欢乐，万事如意！
bing-50447.jpg.description:
今天是除夕夜，中国农历"龙年"的最后一天。“年”称为“岁除”，那天晚上叫“除夕”。它与新年首尾相连，是除旧迎新的重要时间交界点。岁除之日，民间尤为重视，家家户户忙忙碌碌或清扫庭舍，除旧布新，张灯结彩，家人相聚，共同来迎接新的一年。

吃年夜饭是除夕夜一家人最热闹最开心的时刻。除夕夜，丰盛的年菜摆上一桌，一家人团聚在一起吃团圆饭，幸福美满。

bing-50456.jpg.title: Short-eared owl hunting in heavy snow
bing-50456.jpg.headline: Snow-way you'll miss it. Short-eared owl
bing-50456.jpg.description: The short-eared owl, featured in today's image, is a grassland-dwelling member of the owl family. Found on all continents except Antarctica and Australia, it's one of the most widely distributed bird species. This raptor belongs to the genus Asio, whose members are characterized by feather tufts ('ears') on their head. The short-eared owl only reveals its tufts when feeling defensive.

bing-50459.jpg.title: 南京夫子庙的春节许愿牌，江苏省，中国
bing-50459.jpg.headline: 春节快乐！
bing-50459.jpg.description:
春节，是中国民间最隆重也最富有特色的传统节日之一。春节期间的民俗众多，活动内容也是丰富多彩，且具有重要的历史、艺术和文化价值。其中逛庙会、赏灯会，更是春节最具特色的民俗活动之一。

今天的照片是南京夫子庙的一块红色木匾，上面写着“福”字。南京夫子庙是中国四大文庙之一，是中国最大的传统古集市之一，也是中国著名的对外开放的国家5A级旅游景区和国际旅游度假区。每年春节至元宵节期间，人们不仅到夫子庙祈福，还会来这里赏灯、看画舫。

南京夫子庙灯会又称“金陵灯会”，是南京地区流行的一种独特的民间文化活动，早在南朝时期就有，其盛况为全国之最。如今这里也是民间重要的文化活动场所，长期以来，这里已经成为秦淮文化的重要组成部分。春节期间，如果想感受秦淮地区的文化，一定要来这里。

bing-50468.jpg.title: Dragon dance, Wuhan, China
bing-50468.jpg.headline: Happy Chinese New Year!. Chinese New Year
bing-50468.jpg.description: The streets come alive today with a symphony of firecrackers, red lanterns, and cheerful chatter—it's Chinese New Year. Steeped in thousands of years of tradition, this holiday marks the start of the lunisolar Chinese calendar. One of the most captivating images associated with this festival is the dragon dance, pictured here. Skilled dancers manipulate a long, flexible dragon puppet, bringing it to life with sinuous, undulating movements. The dragon, a symbol of power, dignity, and good fortune, is believed to bring luck to the community, with longer dragons bringing even more prosperity.
bing-50468.jpg.copyright: © Miao Jian/Wuhan Morning Post/Visual China Group via Getty Image

bing-50469.jpg.title: Prioro, Castile and León, Spain
bing-50469.jpg.headline: Prioro, Castile and León, Spain
bing-50469.jpg.description:
In the heart of Castile and León, Spain, Prioro is a picturesque and charming village, surrounded by majestic mountains and lush forests. It has a serene beauty that makes it the perfect refuge for those seeking an escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. The nearby mountains become an ideal setting for outdoor activities such as hiking or skiing, while the crisp mountain air fills the lungs with purity and tranquility.

The irresistible aroma of homemade stews drifts through the air, inviting visitors to savour the warmth and comfort of home. Both locals and guests gather around cosy fireplaces, sharing stories and creating moments of connection in an atmosphere filled with charm and hospitality. It's a place that enchants the senses and leaves an unforgettable mark on the soul.

bing-50478.jpg.title: Vista de Baía dos Porcos em Fernando de Noronha
bing-50478.jpg.headline: Um banho verde esmeralda
bing-50478.jpg.description:
A imagem do dia desperta uma vontade de estar na natureza? A Baía dos Porcos, localizada em Fernando de Noronha, é um verdadeiro tesouro natural! O nome curioso não tem relação com animais terrestres, mas sim com porcos-marinhos, um termo antigo para focas ou leões-marinhos que habitavam a região no passado. Além de uma vista relaxante em terra, este local é um dos melhores pontos para snorkeling no Brasil, com águas cristalinas que permitem a observação de tartarugas marinhas, peixes coloridos e até tubarões-lixa.

Mas para chegar nesse pequeno paraíso, é preciso de um pouco de espírito de aventura: o acesso à Baía dos Porcos é feito por uma trilha que parte da Praia Cacimba do Padre, passando por pedras vulcânicas. Embora o caminho exija esforço, a vista deslumbrante compensa. As cores do mar variam entre tons de azul e verde esmeralda, criando um espetáculo visual que muda conforme a luz do sol e a maré e falam por si só: merece ou não a pena?

bing-50479.jpg.title: Granville Island in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada
bing-50479.jpg.headline: Anchored in beauty. Vancouver International Boat Show
bing-50479.jpg.description:
Boats, gadgets and good vibes—sound like your kind of scene? Welcome to the 62nd edition of Vancouver International Boat Show, held from January 29 to February 2! Over time this event has grown into the country's largest boat show, attracting tens of thousands each year. Held across two venues—BC Place and the Granville Island, as seen in today's image, it is the ultimate hub for all things boating. This is one of the few shows with a floating venue. Granville Island's docks offer an up-close experience with large vessels, letting you step aboard and imagine your next adventure.

Explore an incredible range of watercraft, from sleek powerboats and luxurious yachts to paddleboards and fishing vessels. The show also doubles as an educational hub. Visitors can attend seminars by marine experts, get hands-on-training or learn about the latest technologies. There's something for everyone, whether you're looking to upgrade your current boat, dreaming of owning one or simply soaking in the waterfront vibes.

bing-50480.jpg.title: La Brecha de Rolando, Ordesa y Monte Perdido National Park, Spain
bing-50480.jpg.headline: Once more unto the breach. La Brecha de Rolando (Roland's Breach), Spain
bing-50480.jpg.description: High up in the Pyrenees, there is a gap in the mountains. More than 300 feet tall and 131 feet across, La Brecha de Rolando (Roland's Breach), featured here today, is a sight to behold. But who was Roland? Count Roland was a Frankish military leader during Charlemagne's reign in the 8th century. Legend has it that, after being defeated in battle, Roland cut a gap in the mountains—either to destroy his sword or to catch one last glimpse of France.
bing-50480.jpg.copyright: © Inaki Relanzon/Nature Picture Library/Alamy Stock Phot

bing-50485.jpg.title: Reina del Carnaval de Santa Cruz de Tenerife, España
bing-50485.jpg.headline: ¡Una fiesta única!. Santa Cruz de Tenerife, España
bing-50485.jpg.description:
¿Estás listo para la fiesta más grande del año? El Carnaval de Santa Cruz de Tenerife es pura magia, color y diversión sin límites. Durante semanas, esta ciudad se transforma en un espectáculo único, donde las calles se llenan de música, disfraces increíbles y el ritmo contagioso de las comparsas.

Aquí, la rutina desaparece y da paso a la alegría. Desde la elección de la Reina del Carnaval, un desfile que quita el aliento, hasta la gran apoteosis del Coso, cada momento es inolvidable. ¿Y qué decir del Entierro de la Sardina? Un cierre lleno de risas y tradición.

Pero no te preocupes si no tienes disfraz: lo importante es venir con ganas de pasarlo bien y dejarte llevar por el ambiente. En cada rincón encontrarás algo para disfrutar: conciertos, bailes, y gente que sabe cómo celebrar a lo grande. ¡No te lo pierdas! Ven y siente el Carnaval de Santa Cruz de Tenerife, donde la fiesta nunca se detiene. ¿Te atreves a vivirlo?

bing-50492.jpg.title: Plains zebras at sunrise, Mokala National Park, South Africa
bing-50492.jpg.headline: Anything but plain. Happy International Zebra Day!
bing-50492.jpg.description: Celebrate the beauty of zebras on International Zebra Day! These striking animals, known for their unique black and white patterns, are mostly found in the African savanna, stretching from Kenya to South Africa. Of the three zebra species, Grévy's zebra, plains zebra, and mountain zebra, the Grévy's zebra is the most endangered, with more than half its population lost in only three decades. While plains zebras are thriving, mountain zebras face significant threats, such as poaching and habitat encroachment. Zebras play an essential role in the ecosystems they live in, coexisting with predators like lions and hyenas while shaping the grasslands they call home.

bing-50500.jpg.title: Cerf élaphe, forêt de Rambouillet,  Île-de-France
bing-50500.jpg.headline: La noblesse du cerf. Cerf élaphe, forêt de Rambouillet
bing-50500.jpg.description:
Majestueux et silencieux, le cerf élaphe règne en maître sur la forêt de Rambouillet. Avec sa silhouette imposante et ses bois pouvant atteindre jusqu’à un mètre de large, il symbolise la puissance et l’élégance de la faune sauvage française. La forêt, située à une cinquantaine de kilomètres de Paris, abrite une population significative de cerfs élaphes, notamment dans les zones protégées.

Ce cervidé, pouvant peser jusqu’à 200 kg, est particulièrement actif à l’automne, lors du brame. Ce cri rauque et puissant marque la saison des amours et résonne comme un chant ancestral à travers les chênes et les hêtres centenaires. Observé avec respect, le cerf incarne aussi une biodiversité fragile, nécessitant une gestion attentive des habitats naturels.

La forêt de Rambouillet, véritable havre pour cette espèce emblématique, offre aux passionnés de nature un cadre enchanteur pour découvrir la richesse de l’écosystème français.

bing-50501.jpg.title: Königstein Fortress, Saxon Switzerland, Germany
bing-50501.jpg.headline: Snow and stone. Königstein Fortress, Saxon Switzerland, Germany
bing-50501.jpg.description:
Königstein Fortress, one of the largest mountain fortresses in Europe, rises high in the Elbe Sandstone Mountains of Saxon Switzerland. The 'Burgrave Gebhard vom Stein' is first mentioned in a document of King Wenceslas I of Bohemia in 1233, presumably referring to Königstein. At that time the area belonged to the Kingdom of Bohemia. In the 16th century, the castle underwent significant expansion to become a Saxon state fortress, with the start of construction of the imposing 152.5-metre-deep castle well between 1566 and 1569 being an important milestone. It is still one of the deepest historic wells in Germany.

During the Dresden May Uprising in 1849, Königstein once again offered refuge to the Saxon royal family, and after the uprising was crushed, the arrested revolutionaries were brought to the fortress's state prison. During the First and Second World Wars, the fortress also served as a large prisoner of war camp. Until 1955 it was used as a youth work centre for the rehabilitation of young offenders, before being opened as a museum and attracting many visitors. In the winter months, Königstein Fortress is transformed into a fairytale winter wonderland, with frost turning the old walls into glistening works of art. No wonder this natural gem inspired Caspar David Friedrich to paint his 'Wanderer above the Sea of Fog.'

bing-50504.jpg.title: National Museum of African American History & Culture, Washington, DC
bing-50504.jpg.headline: Roots of freedom. Black History Month
bing-50504.jpg.description: Today, the United States begins an annual, monthlong celebration of African Americans and their contributions to the country's history and culture. The forerunner of Black History Month was created in 1926 by historian Carter Woodson and minister Jesse Moorland to study and promote the legacy of Black Americans. The weeklong celebration was observed in the second week of February to coincide with the birthdays of President Abraham Lincoln and African American abolitionist Frederick Douglass. Its popularity grew over the next 50 years in large part because of the civil rights movement, and President Gerald Ford expanded it to a full month in 1976. Other countries honor their own Black histories, including Canada, which also celebrates Black History Month throughout February.

bing-50508.jpg.title: Alappuzha, Kerala
bing-50508.jpg.headline: Azure highlights. Alappuzha, Kerala
bing-50508.jpg.description:
Tucked away in the state of Kerala, Alappuzha offers stunning backwater views, rustic village vibes and unforgettable sunsets. The city's landscape is mostly flat, with no major mountains or hills, though there are a few small hillocks scattered between the Bharanikkavu and Chengannur blocks in the eastern part. The area is also free from forests. This city holds a special place in the state's cultural calendar as a key site for the annual Nehru Trophy Boat Race, which takes place during Onam. On the western side, Alappuzha is bordered by the Laccadive Sea, and the town is crisscrossed by an intricate network of lakes, lagoons and freshwater rivers.

Every year, the coastal waters of Alappuzha come alive with a phenomenon known as 'Chakara,' where a large quantity of fish and prawns are deposited along the coast. After the monsoon bids farewell, this transformation takes place as sandbanks shift and reshape the coastal landscape. This natural phenomenon plays a vital role in boosting the local economy and marks a festive season for the people. The annual floods breathe new life into the soil and water, cleansing and rejuvenating them. As a result, the sea thrives with an abundance of marine treasures, including prawns, lobsters, fish, turtles and diverse aquatic flora.

bing-50511.jpg.title: Portofino, Liguria, Italia
bing-50511.jpg.headline: Pronti, partenza, via!
bing-50511.jpg.description:
Tutti conosciamo le origini della maratona. La sua nascita risale alla Grecia del 490 a.C. Secondo la leggenda, un messaggero greco di nome Filippide corse dalla città di Maratona ad Atene per annunciare la vittoria dei Greci sui Persiani nella famosa Battaglia di Maratona. Dopo aver percorso circa 42 km, Filippide arrivò ad Atene, annunciò la vittoria con le parole "Nenikékamen!" ("Abbiamo vinto!") e morì esausto. Sebbene la veridicità storica di questo evento sia ancora oggetto di dibattito, la figura di Filippide è diventata un simbolo di resistenza e sacrificio, ispirando la nascita della maratona come disciplina sportiva.

Vi chiederete cosa c'entri la maratona con Portofino. Quest’anno debutterà per la prima volta la "Maratona di Portofino". La gara partirà da Santa Margherita Ligure e attraverserà alcune delle località più pittoresche della regione, tra cui Portofino e Rapallo. Partecipare a questa gara non è solo una sfida sportiva, ma anche un viaggio attraverso la storia e la cultura di una delle regioni più affascinanti d'Italia. Preparatevi a vivere un'esperienza indimenticabile, un cammino verso la bellezza e la magia della Liguria, culminante in un meritato piatto di trofie al pesto!

bing-50516.jpg.title: Young alpine marmot
bing-50516.jpg.headline: Weather or not. Groundhog Day
bing-50516.jpg.description: It's Groundhog Day … again. Today, Americans and Canadians rely on the prognostication skills of Punxsutawney Phil to determine if winter will hang on. Phil is a famous groundhog, also known as a woodchuck, and legend has it that if he emerges from his burrow February 2 and sees his own shadow, he'll go back to sleep for another six weeks of winter. If he doesn't, it will be an early spring. German immigrants brought the custom to America, where it was first celebrated in Punxsutawney, Pennsylvania, in 1887. Historically, Europeans celebrated February 2 as the first day of spring, and Germans originally watched badgers and other small animals for signs of seasonal change important to farmers. The Germans who settled in Pennsylvania in the 18th and 19th centuries chose the area's native groundhog for this task.

bing-50518.jpg.title: 梅の花で吸蜜するメジロ
bing-50518.jpg.headline: 今日は立春
bing-50518.jpg.description:
今日は 2 月 3 日立春。二十四節気では春の始まりです。七十二候では「黄鶯睍睆（うぐいすなく）」とされ、ウグイスが山里で鳴き始める時期と言われています。「梅に鶯」は古来より春の兆しとして愛されてきましたが、実際にはなかなか見られません…

梅の花の蜜を吸いにやってくるのは、ウグイスではなく、鮮やかな緑色で目の回りが白いメジロです。メジロは鳴き声がとても可愛らしく、人気がある鳥です。花の蜜が好きなメジロは食べ物を探すのに夢中で警戒心が弱くなるため、観察する絶好のチャンスと言えます。

bing-50519.jpg.title: 盛开的樱花树上的红头长尾山雀
bing-50519.jpg.headline: 春光明媚的日子
bing-50519.jpg.description:
立春到啦，新的四季轮回已经开启。虽然我们已经开始步入了春天，但中国幅员辽阔，南北跨度大，很多地区都是只是刚刚进入春天的前奏阶段。

今年的立春正值春节假期中， 看着图中这两只樱花树上的可爱的红头长尾山雀，颇有一番春日里喜上枝头的意境。让我们一起期待吧，期待温暖的春天快快到来，期待新的一年花开富贵，事事如意！

bing-50528.jpg.title: Ribblehead Viaduct and Ingleborough mountain, North Yorkshire, England
bing-50528.jpg.headline: Bridging history, one arch at a time. Ribblehead Viaduct, North Yorkshire, England
bing-50528.jpg.description: Part engineering genius, part daredevil stunt—that's the Ribblehead Viaduct in North Yorkshire, England. This Victorian structure, also known as Batty Moss Viaduct, has been carrying trains and turning heads since the 1870s. Built by the Midland Railway, it's the longest and third tallest on the Settle–Carlisle railway line. Stretching 440 yards across the Ribble Valley, its 24 stone arches reach a height of 104 feet.

bing-50530.jpg.title: 犬山城の大雪像, 北海道 札幌市
bing-50530.jpg.headline: 今日からさっぽろ雪まつり
bing-50530.jpg.description:
今日、2 月 4 日から第 75 回さっぽろ雪まつりが開催されます。1950 年に札幌の中・高校生が大通公園で雪像を展示したことから始まったこの祭典は、現在では国内外から 200 万人以上が訪れる世界的に有名な冬のイベントとなっています…

祭りは「大通会場」「すすきの会場」「つどーむ会場」の 3 つのメイン会場で行われ、大小の雪像や氷像が展示されます。大雪像のテーマは毎年異なり、歴史的な建造物や有名なキャラクターなどが題材となります。画像は第 59 回の大雪像、国宝の犬山城です。今年の祭りでは 5 基の大雪像が展示される予定です。

bing-50533.jpg.title: Siurana de Tarragona, Cataluña, España
bing-50533.jpg.headline: ¡Unas vistas que te dejarán helado!. Siurana de Tarragona, Cataluña, España
bing-50533.jpg.description:
Imagina un pueblo mágico cubierto de nieve, donde el frío se convierte en el aliado perfecto para disfrutar de la calma y belleza invernal. Siurana, en invierno, es un destino único: el blanco manto de nieve cubre sus calles empedradas y las montañas que lo rodean, creando un paisaje de postal.

Recorrer el casco antiguo, con sus casas de piedra cubiertas de escarcha, es una experiencia de otro mundo. La iglesia de Santa María, vestida de blanco, te transporta al pasado mientras el silencio solo es interrumpido por el crujir de la nieve bajo tus pies.

Los aficionados a la naturaleza encontrarán en sus alrededores rutas de senderismo ideales para disfrutar de la nieve y el aire puro. Además, el embalse, con el agua helada, ofrece una vista impresionante.

bing-50540.jpg.title: Golden Bridge, Bà Nà Hills, Da Nang, Vietnam
bing-50540.jpg.headline: A walk among the clouds. Golden Bridge, Bà Nà Hills, Da Nang, Vietnam
bing-50540.jpg.description: Two colossal stone hands cradle a shimmering, golden walkway, as though the mountains themselves are offering it to the sky. This is Cầu Vàng, or the Golden Bridge, a pedestrian bridge in the misty mountains near Da Nang in central Vietnam. Opened in 2018, the bridge quickly became a global sensation, captivating travelers with its unique design and awe-inspiring setting.

bing-50552.jpg.title: Scottish Blackface sheep, Aberdeenshire, Scotland
bing-50552.jpg.headline: Baa, baa, black sheep? No.. Scottish Blackface sheep, Aberdeenshire, Scotland
bing-50552.jpg.description: Being the 'black sheep' isn't always a bad thing—just ask the Scottish Blackface, seen here in Aberdeenshire, Scotland. With its striking dark features and a knack for thriving in places where others wouldn't, this British breed has turned the idiom on its head. Far from an outcast, it's the backbone of Scotland's rural life and a true champion of the hills and moors. Interestingly, the Blackface sheep didn't originate in Scotland but south of the Anglo-Scottish border.

bing-50564.jpg.title: Archway Islands, Wharariki Beach, South Island, New Zealand
bing-50564.jpg.headline: Reflections of a nation's legacy. Waitangi Day in New Zealand
bing-50564.jpg.description: What do you get when you bring together more than 500 Māori chiefs, representatives of the British Crown, and a treaty signed in 1840? A day that New Zealanders still commemorate: Waitangi Day. On this date, the Treaty of Waitangi was signed, establishing the principles for how the two cultures would coexist. Ceremonies are held at Waitangi Treaty Grounds—where the document was signed—featuring traditional Māori performances, speeches, and the ever-dramatic waka (canoe) races. From festivals and concerts in cities like Auckland and Wellington to low-key community gatherings, the spirit of the day is about connection and culture.

bing-50572.jpg.title: Pyramide du Louvre, Paris, France
bing-50572.jpg.headline: Passé et présent en miroir. Pyramide du Louvre, Paris
bing-50572.jpg.description:
En 1989, la Pyramide du Louvre fut dévoilée au public, transformant totalement le paysage du musée le plus célèbre du monde.

Conçue par l'architecte sino-américain Ieoh Ming Pei, cette structure de verre et d’acier, haute de 21,6 mètres, a d’abord suscité des controverses. Pourtant, elle est devenue une icône de Paris, symbolisant l’équilibre entre tradition et modernité. Inspirée des pyramides égyptiennes, sa géométrie audacieuse cache une prouesse technique : les 673 losanges et triangles de verre trempé, assemblés sans armature visible, offrent une lumière naturelle exceptionnelle aux espaces souterrains.

Aujourd’hui, la Pyramide accueille près de 10 millions de visiteurs par an, contribuant à faire du Louvre le musée le plus visité au monde. Fascinante rencontre entre passé et futur, elle est le parfait reflet de l’esprit d’innovation français.

bing-50576.jpg.title: Blue hour in Trondheim, Norway
bing-50576.jpg.headline: Stuck in a blue moment. Blue hour in Trondheim, Norway
bing-50576.jpg.description: In Norway, winter isn't just a season—it's an experience. In the north of the country, nights stretch for 20 hours, and there are entire weeks when the sun remains hidden below the horizon. It might sound bleak, but it's a unique time of the year. Why? Because around early afternoon, usually between 1 and 2 PM, a soft, lingering light reflects off the snow-covered ground and the deep blue sea. This forms a breathtaking, glassy blue glow that settles over the landscape. Each day, the blue hour arrives just a little later, a gentle reminder that the sun is slowly preparing to reclaim the sky.

bing-50581.jpg.title: La Alhambra vista desde el Albaicín, Granada, Andalucía, España
bing-50581.jpg.headline: ¡Una fortaleza de cine!. La Alhambra, Granada, Andalucía, España
bing-50581.jpg.description:
¡Granada se viste de gala para recibir los Premios Goya 2025! Este año, la prestigiosa ceremonia del cine español se celebrará en esta encantadora ciudad, llena de historia y belleza. La ciudad, famosa por su impresionante patrimonio cultural, será el escenario de un evento muy esperado. A los pies de Sierra Nevada se encuentra la majestuosa Alhambra, una fortaleza de origen islámico que data del siglo XIII, destaca por su arquitectura única, con jardines, palacios y patios cargados de historia.

Además de ser el epicentro de la gala, Granada ofrece a los visitantes una gran variedad de atractivos turísticos. Desde el encantador barrio del Albaicín hasta la vibrante Plaza Nueva, sin olvidar su deliciosa gastronomía local, con tapas y dulces típicos como los piononos.

Ven a disfrutar de los Premios Goya y aprovecha para conocer la belleza de la Alhambra y otros tesoros de esta maravillosa ciudad. ¡Granada te espera con los brazos abiertos!

bing-50588.jpg.title: Medieval towers in Mestia, Upper Svaneti, Georgia
bing-50588.jpg.headline: Frozen in time. Medieval towers in Mestia, Upper Svaneti, Georgia
bing-50588.jpg.description: Winter turns Mestia's medieval towers into icy fortresses. Perched 4,921 feet up in the Caucasus Mountains, Mestia is a charming highland town in northwest Georgia. The town is home to the Svans, a cultural and linguistic subgroup of Georgians. Despite its modest size, Mestia has been an essential hub of Georgian culture for centuries, dotted with the Svan defensive towers, seen in today's image. Most of these towers were constructed between the 9th and 12th centuries, a period often referred to as Georgia's Golden Age. However, their roots are believed to stretch even further back, possibly into prehistoric times. Built for both protection and shelter, these towers were not just fortresses but also integral parts of family homes, reflecting the region's history of resilience and self-sufficiency. Therefore, it isn't just a town; it's a living museum where history rises from these towers and echoes through the mountains.

bing-50594.jpg.title: Leonardo Glass Cube, Bad Driburg, Nordrhein-Westfalen
bing-50594.jpg.headline: Design und Avantgarde. Leonardo Glass Cube, Bad Driburg, Nordrhein-Westfalen
bing-50594.jpg.description:
Architektur und Design sind faszinierende Disziplinen, die unsere gebaute Umwelt prägen und unser tägliches Leben beeinflussen. Ein herausragendes Beispiel moderner Architektur ist der auf dem heutigen Bild abgebildete Leonardo Glass Cube in Bad Driburg, Nordrhein-Westfalen. Dieses beeindruckende Gebäude, entworfen von dem renommierten Architekten 3deluxe, besticht durch seine klare, kubische Form und die Verwendung von Glas als Hauptmaterial. Der Glass Cube ist nicht nur ein architektonisches Meisterwerk, sondern auch ein Symbol für Transparenz und Offenheit.

Die minimalistische Ästhetik dieses Kunstwerks harmoniert perfekt mit der umgebenden Landschaft und dank der gläsernen Wände ist der Kontakt zur visuellen Außenwelt immer präsent. Im Inneren des Gebäudes finden sich moderne Designelemente, die Funktionalität und Ästhetik perfekt vereinen. Insgesamt zeigt der Leonardo Glass Cube, wie innovative Architektur und durchdachtes Design zusammenkommen können, um inspirierende Räume zu schaffen, die sowohl ästhetisch ansprechend als auch funktional sind.

bing-50600.jpg.title: Alstrom Point, Lake Powell, Utah
bing-50600.jpg.headline: A point worth pondering. Alstrom Point, Lake Powell, Utah
bing-50600.jpg.description: If you're chasing sunsets and jaw-dropping views, come to Alstrom Point. Located in southern Utah's Kane County, this spot in the Glen Canyon National Recreation Area stands at an impressive height of 4,685 feet. Made mostly of Entrada Sandstone, it has the same geological roots as nearby sites like Romana Mesa, its parent peak, and Gunsight Butte, another sandstone summit to the east.

bing-50610.jpg.title: Oracle Red Bull Racing em São Paulo
bing-50610.jpg.headline: Desafios em alta velocidade
bing-50610.jpg.description:
Hoje celebramos o Dia do Atleta Profissional! A data marca a regulamentação da profissão no Brasil em 1988, quando a Lei Pelé trouxe importantes direitos trabalhistas e proteção social para os atletas. O Brasil é lar de grandes nomes do esporte, como Ayrton Senna, tricampeão de Fórmula 1, famoso por seus reflexos rápidos. Esse esporte pode levar seus pilotos a uma velocidade superior aos 200 km/h, dependendo do tipo de circuito, e os desafia com forças de até 6G durante as corridas - seis vezes a força da gravidade. Além disso, a temperatura dentro dos carros pode ultrapassar os 50°C, fazendo com que eles percam entre 2 e 4 litros de suor por corrida.

Os (muitos) atletas brasileiros que se destacaram nacional e internacionalmente são provas vivas de que dedicação, talento e resiliência são fundamentais para o êxito. O esporte demanda disciplina, equilíbrio e perseverança – qualidades que podemos aplicar em nosso cotidiano, seja nos estudos, no trabalho ou na vida pessoal. Que tal se inspirar hoje? Pratique um esporte, conheça a trajetória de um atleta brasileiro e vamos juntos celebrar essa data.

bing-50611.jpg.title: Banff National Park in winter, Alberta, Canada
bing-50611.jpg.headline: Chill out in one of the coolest spots. Banff National Park, Alberta
bing-50611.jpg.description:
If you're looking for a destination where epic mountain views and outdoor adventure collide, Banff National Park in Alberta is the place to be. Established in 1885, it's the oldest national park in Canada and offers a blend of towering peaks, glacial lakes and wide open spaces. In winter, the park is transformed into a snowy paradise, as seen in today's image. Frozen lakes like Lake Louise turn into skating rinks, and skiers flock to the slopes of Sunshine Village and Lake Louise Ski Resort.

Beyond outdoor activities, the region's wildlife offers much for those keen to observe animals in their natural habitat. Alongside the more familiar moose and mountain goats, you'll find red deer, cougars, lynxe, wolverines, red foxes, weasels, river otters, coyotes and many more. And don't forget birdwatching, as the park is home to over 250 species of birds like mountain bluebird, American three-toed woodpecker, mountain chickadee, Canada jay and pipit.  Whether you're hiking, skiing, or simply enjoying the stunning scenery, Banff offers an unforgettable experience.

bing-50612.jpg.title: Art installation of umbrellas at Borough Market in London, England
bing-50612.jpg.headline: Under my umbrella. National Umbrella Day
bing-50612.jpg.description: It's National Umbrella Day today, a quirky celebration that honors one of the simplest yet most essential inventions in human history: the umbrella, or parasol. Over 4,000 years ago, in ancient Egypt, Assyria, and China, these foldable canopies were first used to shield people from the sun. It wasn't until the 17th century that the umbrella, as we know it today, gained popularity in Europe, initially as a luxury item primarily for women. Fast-forward a few centuries, and these weather shields have become a staple in pop culture, too. Remember Mary Poppins with her iconic umbrella that helped her fly, or Rihanna's hit song 'Umbrella'?

bing-50614.jpg.title: 春の訪れを告げる梅の花, 茨城県 水戸市
bing-50614.jpg.headline: 今日から水戸の梅まつり
bing-50614.jpg.description:
金沢の兼六園、岡山の後楽園とともに日本三名園のひとつに数えられている偕楽園。その名は、「古の人は民と偕に楽しむ、故に能く楽しむなり」という中国の古典「孟子」の一節から名づけられており、「領民と偕に楽しむ」という水戸藩第 9 代藩主、徳川斉昭公の願いが込められています…

そして、今日 2 月 11 日から、偕楽園で水戸の梅まつりが始まりました。約 100 品種、3000 本もの梅が、春の訪れを告げるかのように可憐に咲き誇ります。また、梅をライトアップする夜梅祭や茶会、梅酒の飲み比べなどのイベントも行われます。

bing-50619.jpg.title: Porto di Sanremo, Imperia, Liguria
bing-50619.jpg.headline: Voci tra le onde
bing-50619.jpg.description:
Il Festival di Sanremo, noto anche come Festival della canzone italiana, è uno degli eventi musicali più prestigiosi e longevi al mondo. Fondato nel 1951 da Angelo Nicola Amato, Angelo Nizza e Pier Busseti, si tiene ogni anno a Sanremo, in Liguria. Il festival ha visto la partecipazione di molti dei più grandi nomi della musica leggera italiana come Battisti, Mina e Modugno, per citarne solo alcuni, e ha ispirato la creazione dell'Eurovision Song Contest. Il formato del Festival prevede una gara tra brani inediti, scritti da autori italiani e selezionati da commissioni apposite.

Tra i cantanti che hanno vinto più volte il Festival di Sanremo, spiccano Claudio Villa e Domenico Modugno, entrambi con quattro vittorie ciascuno. Recentemente, artisti come Mahmood, Måneskin e Blanco hanno anche lasciato un'impronta significativa nel festival. La 75° edizione del Festival di Sanremo è attesa con grande entusiasmo, con molti nuovi talenti e ospiti internazionali previsti. E voi, siete pronti? Preparate i popcorn e sintonizzatevi per vivere un'altra emozionante edizione di questo iconico evento musicale!

bing-50624.jpg.title: Yungang Grottoes, Datong, Shanxi province, China
bing-50624.jpg.headline: The watchful eyes of history. Yungang Grottoes, Shanxi, China
bing-50624.jpg.description: What do 51,000 ancient statues have in common? They all call the Yungang Grottoes in China home! This collection of early Buddhist art is near Datong in Shanxi province, northeastern China. Carved into sandstone cliffs over 1,500 years ago during the Northern Wei dynasty, the grottoes comprise 254 caves. The highlight is the massive Buddha in Cave 5, which is a jaw-dropping 56 feet tall. But don't stop there—each cave offers something unique. Some are like ancient storyboards, depicting tales from Buddhist scriptures, while others showcase detailed carvings of monks, deities, musicians, and even scenes of daily life under Wei rule. These caves blend influences from Indian, Central Asian, and local Chinese Buddhist art. Whether you're a history lover or simply appreciate unique art, the Yungang Grottoes offer an unforgettable experience.

bing-50627.jpg.title: 上海豫园的灯会，元宵节，上海市，中国
bing-50627.jpg.headline: 喜气洋洋的元宵节
bing-50627.jpg.description:
元宵节（Lantern Festival），是新年第一个月圆之夜，又可以称为“闹元宵”，是中国春节年俗活动的“压轴戏”。人们在这一天可以出门赏月、燃灯放焰、喜猜灯谜、共吃元宵、汤圆，合家团聚、同庆佳节，其乐融融。观赏花灯是中国人在这一天一项重大活动。上海豫园的灯会尤其精彩。

2025年豫园灯会是于2025年1月1日至2月12日期间举办的活动。今年灯会的主题是奇妙的 “山川众生”。它展现了丛林中包罗万象、生机勃勃的神奇景象。

bing-50628.jpg.title: Ashoka pillar, Kutagarasala Vihara, Vaishali, Bihar
bing-50628.jpg.headline: Rising high, rooted deep. Ashoka pillar, Kutagarasala Vihara, Vaishali, Bihar
bing-50628.jpg.description:
Today, we are in the ancient city of Vaishali—one of the world's earliest republics.Now an archaeological wonder nestled in the Vaishali district of Bihar, this site holds layers of history waiting to be explored. It served as the capital of the Vajjika League of Vrijji mahajanapada, dating all the way back to the 6th century BCE. Vaishali also played a starring role in Buddhism, as it was here that Gautama Buddha delivered his final sermon before attaining parinirvana around 483 BCE.

That's not all—Vaishali is also home to one of the most beautifully preserved Ashokan pillars, featured in today's image. Through stylistic and technical analysis, experts have pieced together a tentative timeline for the Ashokan pillars. The Vaishali pillar is believed to be one of the earliest, recognised by its short, sturdy column, the simplistic design of its rigid lion and the plain, undecorated square abacus. This pillar features a single lion capital and stands near the site of an ancient Buddhist monastery and a sacred coronation tank. Interestingly, the lion atop the pillar faces north, symbolising the direction Buddha took on his final journey. While more pillars are scattered across the region, they lack their original capitals, making this one a rare and remarkable find.

bing-50636.jpg.title: Marine iguanas, Galápagos Islands, Ecuador
bing-50636.jpg.headline: Darwin's blueprint. Celebrating Charles Darwin
bing-50636.jpg.description: Today, we celebrate Darwin Day—a shout-out to Charles Darwin and his game-changing ideas about life on Earth. As an English naturalist, geologist, and biologist, his theory of natural selection revolutionized our understanding of species, evolution, and our role in the natural world. His work, 'On the Origin of Species,' published in 1859, laid the foundation for modern evolutionary biology. This day marks the birthday of Darwin and honors his genius while promoting curiosity, science, and critical thinking.

bing-50642.jpg.title: Kino Zoo Palast, Berlin
bing-50642.jpg.headline: Film ab!. Eröffnung Berlinale 2025
bing-50642.jpg.description:
Die 1951 gegründete Berlinale hat sich zu einem der wichtigsten Filmfestivals der Welt entwickelt und zieht jedes Jahr Tausende von Filmemachern, Schauspielern und Filmfans aus aller Welt an. Mit dem heutigen Beginn der Berlinale können sich Filmfans auf eine spannende Woche voller Premieren und glanzvoller Momente freuen. Der amerikanische Regisseur, Drehbuchautor und Produzent Todd Haynes übernimmt den Vorsitz der Internationalen Jury der 75. Berlinale.

Eine besondere Ehre wird der schottischen Schauspielerin Tilda Swinton zuteil, die für ihr Lebenswerk mit dem Goldenen Ehrenbären ausgezeichnet wird. Swinton, die der Berlinale seit Jahrzehnten verbunden ist, wird die Auszeichnung im Rahmen der Eröffnungsgala im Berlinale Palast entgegennehmen. Darüber hinaus bietet das Festival zahlreiche Veranstaltungen, die das kulturelle Leben der Stadt bereichern. Wie jedes Jahr verspricht dieses Ereignis ein glanzvoller Höhepunkt im Kalender der Filmwelt zu werden. Also: Gemütlich zurücklehnen, Popcorn bereithalten und Film ab!

bing-50648.jpg.title: Lake Tyrrell, Victoria, Australia
bing-50648.jpg.headline: Salt of the earth. Lake Tyrrell, Victoria, Australia
bing-50648.jpg.description: At Lake Tyrrell, in southern Australia, the sky meets the Earth in a dazzling display. The state of Victoria's largest salt lake was formed around 120,000 years ago. Over time, climate changes caused water levels to drop; these days, the lake is normally dry, except in winter when it's covered in about 2 inches of water. The name 'Tyrrell' comes from the local Wergaia word for 'sky,' a nod to the Boorong Aboriginal People's interest in astronomy. Spanning more than 70 square miles, Lake Tyrrell is a haven for wildlife, including kangaroos, emus, and various reptiles.

bing-50655.jpg.title: Maschera veneziana con gondole sul retro, Venezia, Veneto
bing-50655.jpg.headline: Che la Festa abbia inizio!
bing-50655.jpg.description:
Il Carnevale è una celebrazione dalle radici antiche, profondamente legata alla storia e alla cultura delle società umane. Originariamente, era un periodo di festa in cui le persone potevano indossare maschere e costumi per nascondere la propria identità e comportarsi in modi che normalmente non sarebbero stati accettabili. Questa tradizione, le cui origini risalgono, secondo alcune fonti, al 1094 e che affonderebbe le proprie radici nelle Saturnali romane, ha permesso alle comunità di esprimere la propria creatività e di affrontare le tensioni sociali in un contesto di festa.

Durante il Carnevale, Venezia si trasforma in un palcoscenico vivente, con maschere elaborate e costumi sontuosi che riempiono le strade e i canali. Ai tempi di Marco Polo, il Carnevale aveva fama internazionale e, dopo la caduta di Venezia, perse popolarità per poi riprenderla nella seconda metà del XX secolo. Eventi iconici come il "Volo dell'Angelo", in cui un angelo vola su una zip-line sopra Piazza San Marco, e le sfilate in costume, attirano visitatori da tutto il mondo. Il Carnevale della Serenissima non è solo una festa per gli occhi, ma anche un'opportunità per immergersi nella storia e nella cultura di una delle città più affascinanti del mondo.

bing-50658.jpg.title: Centro histórico do Pelourinho, Salvador
bing-50658.jpg.headline: Um passeio colorido
bing-50658.jpg.description:
O Pelourinho, visto na imagem de hoje, é um exemplo fascinante de como a história e a cultura podem se entrelaçar para criar um lugar único. Com suas ruas de paralelepípedos e edifícios coloridos, o Pelourinho é um verdadeiro espetáculo de Salvador e do Brasil. Em 1985, foi declarado Patrimônio Mundial pela UNESCO devido à sua riqueza histórica e arquitetônica, representando um dos mais bem preservados conjuntos de arquitetura colonial das Américas.

Além disso, o Pelourinho é um dos maiores símbolos da cultura afro-brasileira, com forte influência africana na música, dança, gastronomia e religiosidade, especialmente ligada ao candomblé. Para quem se interessa em história e cultura, visitar o Pelourinho pode ser uma oportunidade única de aprendizado. Venha descobrir o Pelourinho e transforme sua viagem em uma aula prática inesquecível sobre as belezas culturais do Brasil!

bing-50660.jpg.title: Magellanic penguins in the Falkland Islands
bing-50660.jpg.headline: Look at these lovebirds. Happy Valentine's Day!
bing-50660.jpg.description: Love is in the air today: it's Valentine's Day! Across the globe, millions of flowers will be sent, and romantic restaurants will be fully booked. This holiday has its origins in the story of Saint Valentine, a 3rd-century Roman priest who, according to legend, secretly married couples to spare the husbands from conscription into the Roman army.
bing-50660.jpg.copyright: © Vicki Jauron, Babylon and Beyond Photography/Getty Image

bing-50668.jpg.title: Défilé du Carnaval de Nice, le Roi sur la Promenade des Anglais
bing-50668.jpg.headline: C'est toute une parade !. Défilé du Carnaval de Nice, Promenade des Anglais
bing-50668.jpg.description:
Imaginez-vous, le visage tourné vers le ciel bleu azur de Nice, les rues envahies de couleurs vives et de rires, alors que le Carnaval bat son plein. Un des plus anciens d'Europe, ce carnaval rassemble petits et grands pendant deux semaines, autour de la tradition festive de la ville. Chaque année, le défilé du Roi de Carnaval, majestueux et exubérant, ouvre la voie à des moments inoubliables. La bataille de fleurs, quant à elle, transforme la ville en un véritable jardin flottant, où les spectateurs sont les heureux récipiendaires de gerbes de fleurs multicolores.

Le carnaval ne se limite pas à un événement festif, c'est aussi une formidable vitrine de la culture niçoise. Entre musique, danse et costumes flamboyants, il incarne l'âme d’une région qui aime partager son héritage avec le monde entier. Si vous cherchez à vivre une expérience joyeuse et authentique, le Carnaval de Nice est un must absolu !

bing-50669.jpg.title: A kingfisher perched on a branch
bing-50669.jpg.headline: Winter's brightest catch. Kingfisher
bing-50669.jpg.description:
Don't be fooled by its tropical look, this bird has a wide range and adapts to various climates—meet kingfisher. With over 100 species spread across the globe, kingfishers are found in a variety of habitats, from dense forests to coastal regions. Most species, like the common kingfisher, prefer freshwater environments across Europe, Asia and Africa, while others, such as the belted kingfisher, are found in North and South America. These birds are instantly recognisable by their vibrant plumage, often featuring a striking mix of blues, greens and oranges.

True to their name, kingfishers are masters of the art of fishing. Perched patiently above water, they spot their prey with exceptional vision. Once a fish comes into view, they dive with precision, snatching their meal with a quick snap of their long, pointed beak. Unlike most birds, kingfishers don't build nests in trees. Instead, they dig burrows into riverbanks, creating tunnels that lead to cosy chambers where they lay their eggs. Kingfishers have been celebrated in myths and folklore for centuries. In many cultures, they are symbols of prosperity, peace and sharp intuition.

bing-50672.jpg.title: Icicles of Misotsuchi, Chichibu, Japan
bing-50672.jpg.headline: These are so nice-icle. The natural ice wall of Misotsuchi, Chichibu, Japan
bing-50672.jpg.description: Behold the magic of the Misotsuchi no Tsurara (Misotsuchi Icicles) in Chichibu, Japan. This breathtaking natural ice wall, nearly 100 feet wide and 35 feet tall, is formed by spring water freezing as it trickles down a rock face. The attraction is only open from mid-January through mid-February. Colored lights after dark create a scene that feels straight out of a winter fairy tale.

bing-50684.jpg.title: Humpback whale mother and calf, Tonga
bing-50684.jpg.headline: Protecting the giants of the sea. Happy World Whale Day!
bing-50684.jpg.description: On the third Sunday of February, World Whale Day highlights the beauty of whales and the challenges they face. This year, on February 16, we honor these majestic creatures, like the humpback whale pictured in today's image, known for its enchanting songs and dramatic breaches. World Whale Day began in 1980 in Maui, Hawaii, led by Greg Kauffman of the Pacific Whale Foundation, to protect humpbacks from extinction. Today, it urges global action on threats like ocean pollution, climate change, and habitat loss.

bing-50688.jpg.title: Fatehpur Sikri, Agra, Uttar Pradesh
bing-50688.jpg.headline: City of vision and faith. Fatehpur Sikri, Agra, Uttar Pradesh
bing-50688.jpg.description:
Featured in today's image is Fatehpur Sikri, the red sandstone city in the Agra district of Uttar Pradesh. Established by Emperor Akbar in 1571 to honour the revered Sufi saint Sheikh Salim Chishti, it served as the capital of the Mughal Empire from 1571 to 1585. It was named Fatehpur Sikri, meaning 'City of Victory,' in 1573, following his victorious campaign in Gujarat. Beyond being a military stronghold, it flourished as a hub for scholars, poets and artists, reflecting emperor's vision of cultural and intellectual excellence. The city was entirely abandoned in 1610, marking the end of its role in Mughal history.

Fatehpur Sikri showcases Akbar's genius in combining Islamic and Hindu architectural styles. The building style of the city draws inspiration from Timurid forms and designs, reflecting the grandeur typical of the Mughal Empire. Additionally, Gujarati influences can be observed in the intricate details and decor of the palaces, adding another layer of cultural richness. Encircled by an 11-kilometre-long fortification wall with majestic gateways, its highlights include the Imperial Palace Complex, the intricately designed marble tomb of Sheikh Salim Chishti and the grand mosque. Together, they stand as timeless symbols of Mughal grandeur—second only to the Taj Mahal.

bing-50693.jpg.title: Fireworks at Clifford's Tower during the Jorvik Viking Festival
bing-50693.jpg.headline: A week of Viking wonders. Jorvik Viking Festival
bing-50693.jpg.description:
Every February, York in England transforms into a Viking stronghold for the Jorvik Viking Festival, celebrating the city's Norse roots with lively events and immersive history. Once called Jorvik, York was a major Viking settlement, and this festival, which is taking place from 17 to 23 February this year, brings that era to life with battle reenactments, storytelling and hands-on activities. The highlight? Epic clashes of costumed warriors in dramatic, historically accurate battles. For a more peaceful experience, visitors can try axe-throwing, learn rune writing, or explore Viking markets brimming with crafts and treats. Traditional Scandinavian foods and mead-tasting sessions let you feast like a Viking chieftain.

Pictured here is Clifford's Tower, the largest remaining building of York Castle. Built on the site of an earlier wooden structure, Clifford's Tower has its own dramatic history, from its Norman roots to its storied survival through centuries of conflict. While it wasn't a Viking creation, its commanding view over York makes it the perfect place to reflect on the city's Nordic legacy.

bing-50696.jpg.title: The Washington Monument seen from the Lincoln Memorial, Washington, DC
bing-50696.jpg.headline: Honoring our presidents. Presidents' Day
bing-50696.jpg.description: Presidents' Day, celebrated on the third Monday in February, is a time for Americans to reflect on the legacies of those who have served in the country's highest office. The day is officially Washington's Birthday at the federal level, but it has evolved into a celebration that recognizes the achievements of all US presidents. Parades and patriotic displays are held across the country, and many people take the opportunity to learn about presidential history.

bing-50697.jpg.title: Coll d'Ares, Catalan Pyrenees
bing-50697.jpg.headline: Coll d'Ares, Catalan Pyrenees
bing-50697.jpg.description:
For those who appreciate quiet escapes and unspoiled nature, Coll d'Ares in the Catalan Pyrenees is a perfect place to visit. Located between Molló in Catalonia's Ripollès region and Prats-de-Mollo-la-Preste in Occitania, this pass offers a breathtaking natural spectacle, especially in winter when its landscapes are blanketed in snow. This mountain pass has served as a key route for centuries, linking the regions of Catalonia and France. Historically, it was used by traders and travellers crossing the Pyrenees, adding to its charm as a place rich in stories.

Today, the area offers serene hiking trails with stunning panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and valleys. Whether you're exploring ancient paths or simply soaking in the tranquil atmosphere, you'll feel connected to both the land and its past. The local flora and fauna are an added bonus and for cyclists, the challenging routes provide an exhilarating ride. If you prefer a slower pace, the fresh mountain air and sense of history make Coll d'Ares the perfect place to unwind and enjoy the Catalan Pyrenees in its most natural state.

bing-50708.jpg.title: Great Blue Hole, Belize
bing-50708.jpg.headline: Endless blue. The Great Blue Hole, Belize
bing-50708.jpg.description: The Great Blue Hole, found near the center of Lighthouse Reef off the coast of Belize, is one of nature's most incredible creations. The massive marine sinkhole, 1,043 feet across and 407 feet deep, was formed during the last ice age when a limestone cave system collapsed and rising sea levels flooded the area, leaving behind a striking natural wonder.

bing-50720.jpg.title: European river otter, Lelystad, Netherlands
bing-50720.jpg.headline: The 'otter' side of life. European river otter, Netherlands
bing-50720.jpg.description: The European river otter is more than just an adorable face in the wild. Found across Europe, Asia, and parts of northern Africa, these otters thrive in clean rivers, lakes, and wetlands, serving as an important indicator of environmental health. They are built for agility, with streamlined bodies, webbed feet, and dense fur that keeps them warm even in icy waters. A single square inch of their fur can hold more than 400,000 hairs, making it one of nature's most effective insulators. River otters were once endangered due to pollution and habitat loss. Thanks to conservation efforts, their populations are rebounding in many regions across Europe.

bing-50729.jpg.title: Red deer, Canada
bing-50729.jpg.headline: A regal duo. Red deer, Canada
bing-50729.jpg.description:
Throughout history, red deer have captured humanity's awe and respect. These creatures can be found across Europe, Asia, parts of North Africa and a few other regions. In Canada, these animals are primarily found in Alberta, with the prairies and parklands around the city of Red Deer offering an ideal habitat for them.

The stags have antlers that grow larger each year until maturity and are usually over 70 centimetres long, weighing around 1 kilogram. These antlers have long been a symbol of power and are the only mammal organ capable of complete regeneration. Females, or hinds, are slightly smaller and antler-free, as seen in today's image. Breeding season, known as the rut, is a time of dramatic display as males compete fiercely for mates through roaring and antler clashes. The cultural significance of red deer represents the natural cycle of life. Artistic depictions, from medieval manuscripts to modern sculptures, frequently highlight their grace and strength.

bing-50732.jpg.title: Alpenglow on Half Dome, Yosemite National Park, California
bing-50732.jpg.headline: Celebrating Ansel Adams. Ansel Adams' birthday
bing-50732.jpg.description: Born on this day in 1902, Ansel Adams remains one of the most celebrated photographers in history, renowned for his striking black-and-white images of the American wilderness. His work immortalized the grandeur of national parks like California's Yosemite, pictured here, showcasing the raw beauty of nature with depth and clarity. A pioneer of 'pure photography,' Adams believed in capturing a scene's natural essence without manipulation, a principle he championed through his development of the Zone System—a technique to control exposure and contrast.

bing-50739.jpg.title: Castello di Mornico Losana, Mornico Losana, Provincia di Pavia, Lombardia
bing-50739.jpg.headline: Castelli, Neve e Cavalieri?
bing-50739.jpg.description:
Il Castello di Mornico Losana, situato nel cuore della provincia di Pavia, in Lombardia, è una gemma storica risalente al Medioevo. Questo affascinante monumento si erge maestoso tra le colline dell'Oltrepò Pavese, una regione nota per i suoi pittoreschi paesaggi e i suoi vigneti rigogliosi. In inverno, il castello assume un'aria fiabesca, avvolto in un manto di neve che lo trasforma in un luogo incantato. Le sue antiche mura evocano racconti di un'epoca lontana, di eroiche battaglie e nobili cavalieri, offrendo ai visitatori uno spettacolo intriso di suggestiva magia.

Passeggiando tra i cortili e i giardini innevati, si può udire l'eco delle storie e delle leggende che hanno attraversato i secoli. Il Castello di Mornico Losana non è solo una testimonianza del passato, ma anche un'oasi di pace e serenità, perfetto per chi desidera immergersi in un'atmosfera unica e suggestiva. La vista delle colline innevate che lo avvolgono offre un panorama da cartolina. Vivere un'esperienza invernale al Castello di Mornico Losana è come intraprendere un viaggio nel tempo, scoprendo la bellezza incontaminata della natura.

bing-50740.jpg.title: Fête du citron, Menton, Alpes-Maritimes
bing-50740.jpg.headline: Si on vous donne des citrons.... Fête du citron, Menton
bing-50740.jpg.description:
Chaque année, la ville de Menton se transforme en un royaume d’agrumes pour la célèbre Fête du Citron. Depuis 1934, cet événement unique au monde célèbre l’excellence des citrons de Menton, réputés pour leur parfum intense et leur qualité exceptionnelle.

Avec plus de 140 tonnes de citrons et d’oranges, des sculptures géantes prennent vie dans les jardins Biovès, illustrant des thèmes spectaculaires renouvelés à chaque édition. Parades, corsi illuminés et expositions florales attirent plus de 200 000 visiteurs, venus admirer ce spectacle haut en couleurs.

L’histoire de cette fête remonte à la Belle-Époque lorsqu’un hôtelier eut l’idée d’organiser une exposition de fleurs et d’agrumes pour dynamiser l’hiver mentonnais. Aujourd’hui, la Fête du Citron est un symbole du patrimoine et du savoir-faire. Un rendez-vous incontournable pour découvrir l’âme ensoleillée de Menton !

bing-50744.jpg.title: Champaka Sarasi pond near Shivamogga, Karnataka, India
bing-50744.jpg.headline: A tale of still waters. Champaka Sarasi, Shivamogga, Karnataka, India
bing-50744.jpg.description: From waterfalls to temples, Shivamogga, in the South Indian state of Karnataka, offers experiences waiting to be discovered. Steeped in timeless lore, the city is mentioned in the Ramayana and the Mahabharata, epics composed as poems and set in the ancient Hindu kingdoms of India. The region's name itself holds a spiritual significance, derived from the Sanskrit words 'Shiva-Mukha,' meaning the 'face of Shiva,' the Hindu god. It is home to several temples, including the Sharavati Temple, dedicated to Shiva, and a temple in the Kodachadri hills that offers vistas of the Western Ghats mountain range.

bing-50749.jpg.title: Estación de esquí Baqueira Beret, Alto Arán, Lérida, Cataluña, España
bing-50749.jpg.headline: Un viaje con altura. Baqueira Beret, Alto Arán, Lérida, Cataluña, España
bing-50749.jpg.description:
Febrero es un mes ideal para disfrutar de la nieve en España, y pocos lugares son tan espectaculares como Baqueira Beret, en el Alto Arán, Cataluña. Conocida por sus impresionantes paisajes y excelentes pistas, esta estación de esquí es la más grande del país y un destino favorito para los amantes de los deportes de invierno.

Aquí se pueden practicar esquí alpino, snowboard y rutas con raquetas de nieve. Además, la zona ofrece experiencias únicas, como paseos en trineo o motos de nieve. Pero Baqueira Beret no es solo nieve y deporte. En el Valle de Arán, la cultura y la gastronomía juegan un papel fundamental. La olla aranesa, un guiso tradicional con carne y legumbres, es perfecta para reponer fuerzas tras un día en la montaña.

En la imagen de hoy vemos Baqueira Beret en plena temporada de esquí. Su entorno natural, rodeado de picos nevados, la convierte en un destino único. Un dato curioso es que su nombre proviene del occitano, la lengua tradicional del valle, y significa "prado bonito". ¡Un paraíso para los amantes del invierno!

bing-50754.jpg.title: Atardecer no Jardim Botânico de Curitiba, Paraná
bing-50754.jpg.headline: Uma arquitetura cristalina
bing-50754.jpg.description:
Entre com a gente nessa delicada preciosidade da arquitetura! O Palácio de Cristal de Curitiba, visto na imagem de hoje, foi inspirado no famoso Palácio de Cristal de Londres, Reino Unido, e é uma joia ao ar livre que encanta não só curitibanos, mas visitantes de todo o país. Construído no estilo Art Nouveau, um movimento artístico e arquitetônico popular durante o final do século XIX e começo do século XX, o palácio é caracterizado por suas linhas curvas e formas inspiradas na natureza. No interior, abriga uma coleção de plantas tropicais, com espécies nativas da Mata Atlântica, funcionando como uma estufa para pesquisa e conservação.

E, além de sua estrutura e funcionalidade, o Palácio também reluz ainda mais sua beleza graças a paisagem que o cerca. Os jardins geométricos que vemos na imagem foram inspirados no estilo francês, o que completa o clima de beleza e tranquilidade. Este espaço não só preserva a biodiversidade, mas também proporciona um refúgio para quem busca contato com a natureza. Venha conhecer o Palácio de Cristal de Curitiba e se encantar com sua beleza e história!

bing-50756.jpg.title: The Gateway Arch in St. Louis, Missouri
bing-50756.jpg.headline: Bending towards brilliance. Gateway Arch in St. Louis, Missouri
bing-50756.jpg.description: Today we are celebrating the anniversary of Gateway National Park, which was established on February 22, 2018, in St. Louis, Missouri. The park, which lies along a picturesque stretch of the Mississippi River, commemorates Thomas Jefferson’s idea of a continental nation. At its heart stands the Gateway Arch, a breathtaking 630-foot-tall structure that has become the ultimate symbol of St. Louis. Constructed of stainless steel, it holds the distinction of being the world's tallest arch and Missouri's tallest accessible structure. Finnish American architect Eero Saarinen dreamed up the design back in 1947, and by October 28, 1965, his vision had been brought to life. The arch's futuristic design has long been viewed as a symbol of the automobile era, representing the modern, urban landscape, and the promise of a technologically advanced future.

bing-50768.jpg.title: Mount Fuji at sunrise, Lake Kawaguchi, Japan
bing-50768.jpg.headline: Wind of Fuji, my souvenir from Edo. Mount Fuji Day
bing-50768.jpg.description: Around 60 miles southwest of Tokyo stands one of Japan's cultural icons: Mount Fuji. The country's tallest mountain rises 12,000 feet above the surrounding landscape, with its near-symmetrical cone covered in snow for nearly five months each year. For centuries, Fujisan—as it is known in Japanese—has been worshiped as a sacred mountain. In the Shinto faith, Fuji is deified as Asama no Okami, and shrines dedicated to it are built within sight of the mountain.

bing-50780.jpg.title: Group of giant cuttlefish in Spencer Gulf, off Whyalla, South Australia
bing-50780.jpg.headline: Inked and undercover. Group of giant cuttlefish, Whyalla, South Australia
bing-50780.jpg.description: Prepare to be amazed by the giant cuttlefish, known for its mesmerizing ability to transform its appearance in the blink of an eye. This cuttlefish is found in the temperate and subtropical waters of Australia, ranging from Brisbane in Queensland and Shark Bay in Western Australia to as far south as Tasmania.

bing-50787.jpg.title: Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II al tramonto, Milano, Lombardia
bing-50787.jpg.headline: La Capitale della Moda
bing-50787.jpg.description:
Da oggi fino al 3 marzo sarà in corso la Milano Fashion Week, uno degli eventi più attesi nel panorama della moda, attirando stilisti, modelle, celebrità e appassionati da tutto il mondo. Ogni anno, la capitale lombarda si trasforma in un vivace palcoscenico dove vengono presentate le collezioni più affascinanti e innovative. Le sfilate si svolgono in luoghi iconici come la Villa Clerici, dove l'eleganza senza tempo si fonde con l'arte e la storia, creando un'atmosfera senza eguali. Durante questa settimana, i principali marchi italiani e internazionali presentano le loro creazioni, mettendo in risalto l'artigianalità e la creatività che caratterizzano il settore.

Le passerelle sono animate da modelli che indossano abiti spettacolari, accessori di lusso e calzature all'avanguardia, offrendo uno spettacolo visivo che incanta e ispira. Oltre alle sfilate, la settimana della moda comprende eventi esclusivi, presentazioni private e feste glamour, dove i professionisti del settore possono incontrarsi, scambiarsi idee e creare nuove collaborazioni. Questo evento non solo celebra la moda, ma promuove anche l'innovazione e la diversità, confermando Milano come capitale mondiale della moda. E per chi volesse fare shopping, la Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II è un luogo imperdibile, come potete ammirare nella foto di oggi.

bing-50788.jpg.title: Viaduc de Millau, Aveyron, France
bing-50788.jpg.headline: Un géant dans les nuages. Le viaduc de Millau
bing-50788.jpg.description:
Majestueux, audacieux, le viaduc de Millau est une prouesse d’ingénierie qui défie les lois de la nature. Saviez-vous qu’il était plus haut que la tour Eiffel ? Avec ses 343 mètres au sommet de son pylône le plus élevé, il détient le record du pont routier le plus haut du monde ! Inauguré en 2004 après seulement trois ans de construction, cet ouvrage d’exception enjambe majestueusement la vallée du Tarn sur 2 460 mètres.

Imaginé par l’ingénieur français Michel Virlogeux et dessiné par l’architecte britannique Norman Foster, il allie finesse et robustesse. Son tablier, assemblé par une technique inédite de poussage progressif, semble flotter dans les airs.

Chaque année, des millions de véhicules traversent ce géant de béton et d’acier, réduisant le temps de trajet entre Paris et l’Espagne tout en offrant une vue à couper le souffle. Plus qu’un simple pont, le viaduc de Millau est un symbole du génie humain, attirant visiteurs et passionnés d’architecture du monde entier. Une véritable icône du patrimoine français moderne.

bing-50792.jpg.title: Sandstone hoodoos, Bryce Canyon National Park, Utah
bing-50792.jpg.headline: Hoodoo you do?. Anniversary of Bryce Canyon National Park
bing-50792.jpg.description: A breathtaking maze of sandstone formations and awe-inspiring views awaits you at Bryce Canyon National Park in Utah. People have lived in this area for at least 10,000 years, including the Anasazi, Pueblo, and Paiute Peoples. The hoodoos—tall, thin spires of rock formed by erosion—in the park inspired Paiute mythology: they believed them to be the Legend People turned to stone by the trickster Coyote.

bing-50796.jpg.title: Tungnath Temple, Uttarakhand
bing-50796.jpg.headline: Honouring Shiva. Maha Shivaratri
bing-50796.jpg.description: Today is Maha Shivaratri, a festival marked by fasting, meditation and an all-night vigil in honour of Lord Shiva. Celebrated between February and March, it falls on the fourteenth night of the waning moon in the Hindu month of Phalguna. But what makes this festival truly special? It marks the union of Shiva and Parvati and the powerful Tandava dance performed by Shiva. What would be a better place to experience the divine presence of Shiva than Tungnath, featured here? One of the highest Shiva temples in the world, Tungnath is perched high in the Himalayas at 3,680 metres. This sacred site, in Uttarakhand's Rudraprayag district, is the loftiest of the five Panch Kedar temples, and sits just below the majestic Chandrashila peak.

bing-50804.jpg.title: Castle Stalker on Loch Laich, Argyll, Scotland
bing-50804.jpg.headline: Scottish strategy at its finest. Castle Stalker, Argyll, Scotland
bing-50804.jpg.description: Perched dramatically on a tidal islet in Loch Laich, Argyll, Castle Stalker is one of Scotland's most picturesque and well-preserved medieval tower houses. Built around the 1440s by the Stewarts of Appin, its history includes royal visits and even a drunken wager that briefly transferred ownership to Clan Campbell. After falling into disrepair by the 19th century, it was lovingly restored in the mid-20th century and is still privately owned today. Visitors can explore this historic site on selected guided tours during the summer.

bing-50810.jpg.title: Hohenzollernbrücke mit dem Kölner Dom und dem Rhein bei Sonnenuntergang in Köln
bing-50810.jpg.headline: Kölle Alaaf!. Weiberfastnacht, Köln
bing-50810.jpg.description:
Der Straßenkarneval ist ein bekanntes rheinisches Volksfest mit langjähriger Tradition. Besonders die auf unserem heutigen Bild abgebildete Rheinmetropole Köln, die bekannt für ihren beeindruckenden Dom ist, gilt als wahre Hochburg der Narrenzeit. Mit der Weiberfastnacht fällt in Köln der offizielle Startschuss für den Höhepunkt des Karnevals - ein Fest, das die Straßen in ein Meer aus Farben, Musik und vor allem Lebensfreude verwandelt. Jedes Jahr am Donnerstag vor Rosenmontag erobern die Frauen die Straßen und schneiden den Männern symbolisch die Krawatten ab - ein Zeichen von Macht und Spaß. Die Straßen der Karnevalshochburg füllen sich mit farbenfrohen Kostümen, Gesang und Gelächter.

Von den Altstadtgassen bis hin zu den großen Plätzen - überall wird ausgelassen gefeiert und getanzt. Weiberfastnacht ist jedoch nicht nur ein fröhliches Fest, sondern auch ein Stück kölsches Brauchtum, das die Gemeinschaft stärkt. Die Karnevalssaison, die sogenannte „fünfte Jahreszeit“, begeistert nicht nur Einheimische, sondern lockt jährlich Millionen Menschen in die Domstadt, die mit den kölschen Jecken bis in die späte Nacht hinein feiern. Kölle Alaaf!

bing-50816.jpg.title: Polar bear cub, Churchill, Manitoba, Canada
bing-50816.jpg.headline: Polar care. International Polar Bear Day
bing-50816.jpg.description: Today we're heading north for International Polar Bear Day. This event is the perfect time to learn more about the world's largest bear species and the threats they face. Polar bears are native to the Arctic and can be found in Alaska, Russia, Greenland, and Svalbard. They're also found in Canada—like the cub in today's image, photographed in Churchill, Manitoba.

bing-50821.jpg.title: Iznájar, Andalucía, España
bing-50821.jpg.headline: ¡Un verde y blanco vibrante!. Día de Andalucía
bing-50821.jpg.description:
Cada 28 de febrero, Andalucía celebra su identidad con orgullo. En esta fecha, se conmemora el referéndum de 1980, cuando los andaluces votaron por su autonomía, marcando un hito en la historia de la región. El Día de Andalucía se vive con himnos, banderas verde y blanca ondeando en balcones y plazas, y una gastronomía que rinde homenaje a la tierra. Es tradición en los colegios compartir pan con aceite de oliva, símbolo de la riqueza agrícola andaluza.

Las ciudades y pueblos se llenan de actividades culturales: conciertos de flamenco, recitales de poesía y mercados artesanales. En cada rincón, la alegría andaluza se siente en el aire.

En la imagen de hoy vemos Iznájar, un pintoresco pueblo de la provincia de Córdoba. El nombre "Iznájar" proviene del árabe y significa "castillo alegre". Sus calles blancas, adornadas con flores, hoy se llenan de música, gastronomía y tradición. El embalse de Iznájar es el mayor de Andalucía, el cual se convierte en un lugar ideal para pasear y disfrutar de las vistas en un día como hoy. ¡Feliz Día de Andalucía!

bing-50828.jpg.title: Paro Taktsang, a Buddhist monastery in Bhutan
bing-50828.jpg.headline: Have a rest at the Tiger's Nest. Tibetan New Year
bing-50828.jpg.description: Welcome to the year 2152. That is, in the Tibetan calendar at least. Today marks the start of Losar, the new year festival celebrated in Tibetan Buddhism, which is observed in Tibet, Bhutan, Nepal, and parts of India. Losar celebrations run for 15 days, beginning the night before with a meal of guthuk—a traditional dumpling soup. The new year is rung in with an incense burning ceremony and visits to holy places to pray for good fortune in the year ahead.

bing-50837.jpg.title: St Davids Cathedral, St Davids, Pembrokeshire, Wales
bing-50837.jpg.headline: A timeless celebration. Saint David's Day
bing-50837.jpg.description:
A leek, a daffodil and a day to remember: Happy Saint David's Day! Today, Wales celebrates its patron saint and all things Welsh. Saint David was a 6th-century monk, bishop and preacher who played a key role in spreading Christianity across the country. He founded several religious communities known for their simple, disciplined lifestyles. One of his most famous sayings, 'Gwnewch y pethau bychain,' still resonates today as a reminder that small acts of kindness and faith matter. But why do people wear leeks and daffodils? Legend has it that the saint advised Welsh soldiers to wear leeks on their helmets to distinguish themselves from the enemy in battle against the Saxons. The daffodil, meanwhile, became popular later as a more visually appealing national emblem, especially during the 19th century.

So, what better place to visit today than St Davids Cathedral in St Davids, Britain's smallest city. Built on the site of Saint David's original monastic settlement, the cathedral has been a focal point of worship and pilgrimage for over a thousand years. With its sturdy Romanesque architecture and centuries-old traditions, it remains a testament to the saint's enduring legacy.

bing-50840.jpg.title: Dr. Anna Howard Shaw leading a suffrage parade in 1910s New York City
bing-50840.jpg.headline: Women's History Month
bing-50840.jpg.description: Every March, as we celebrate Women's History Month, we honor the trailblazing women who've shaped our world. Central to this legacy is the suffrage movement—a courageous fight for women's right to vote.

bing-50841.jpg.title: The aurora borealis over Spirit Island on Maligne Lake, Jasper National Park, Canada
bing-50841.jpg.headline: Aurora borealis over Spirit Island on Maligne Lake, Canada
bing-50841.jpg.description:
Some places feel almost untouched by time. In Canada, one such place sits deep in Jasper National Park, Alberta, where the 22-kilometre-long, winding Maligne Lake cuts through the mountains. It is the largest natural lake in the Canadian Rockies, where towering peaks, glacial waters and endless sky come together.

Early Indigenous communities, including the Dane-zaa, Nakoda and Cree, have long used the area surrounding the lake for hunting and travel, and their connection to the land continues to this day. In 1907, guide Mary Schäffer mapped the lake, bringing it to wider attention. Spirit Island, a small tree-covered island in the lake, became a well-known landmark after photographers captured its striking reflection in the water. Now, it's a favourite for paddlers, hikers and those chasing the northern lights. The best time to catch the auroras? Fall through spring, when the nights are longer and geomagnetic activity is strong. When conditions line up, the aurora borealis sweeps across the sky in shades of greens, pinks and purples, as seen in today's image. It occurs when solar particles hit the Earth's magnetic field, creating light that flickers across the atmosphere. A clear sky and a bit of patience can turn an ordinary night into something unforgettable.

bing-50852.jpg.title: Eucalyptus trees, Megalong Valley, Blue Mountains National Park, NSW, Australia
bing-50852.jpg.headline: A eucalyp-tastic view. Megalong Valley, Blue Mountains National Park, Australia
bing-50852.jpg.description: Today, we are in New South Wales, Australia, amid the Blue Mountains National Park. Known for its dramatic cliffs, dense rainforests, and cascading waterfalls, this UNESCO World Heritage Site is a treasure trove of natural beauty and biodiversity. Among the most iconic features of the Blue Mountains region are the eucalyptus trees, pictured here. Home to 92 species of eucalyptus, this area offers visitors a chance to marvel at these resilient trees, which are central to Australian wildlife. Their aromatic leaves provide food for koalas, while their bark and canopy create habitats for countless birds and insects.

bing-50854.jpg.title: かぐやびな, 兵庫県 上郡町
bing-50854.jpg.headline: 今日はひな祭り
bing-50854.jpg.description:
今日、 3 月 3 日はひな祭り。ひな人形に桃の花やひなあられを飾り、女の子の成長を祝う日です。ひな祭りの歴史は古く、平安時代まで遡ります。三月初めの巳の日に行われていた上巳の節句という行事で、紙で作ったひな人形を川に流す「流しびな」がその起源といわれています…

そして今日の画像は、兵庫県上郡町で制作された「かぐやびな」。高さ 20cm の竹筒の中に、友禅和紙の着物をまとった「女びな」と「男びな」が飾られています。これらは全て職人の手作りで、柔和な表情が描かれています。

bing-50862.jpg.title: Desfile de Carnaval no Sambódromo, Rio de Janeiro
bing-50862.jpg.headline: Dia de folia na avenida
bing-50862.jpg.description:
Esta segunda-feira marca o início do Carnaval! Na imagem de hoje vemos o Sambódromo do Rio de Janeiro, oficialmente chamado de Passarela do Samba Prof. Darcy Ribeiro, que é um dos principais palcos dessa festa nacional. Projetado pelo renomado arquiteto Oscar Niemeyer e inaugurado em 1984, o Sambódromo tem 700 metros de extensão e é conhecido como a "Avenida", por onde desfilam as escolas de samba.

Com capacidade para mais de 70 mil pessoas, distribuídas entre arquibancadas, camarotes e frisas, o Sambódromo se transforma em um mar de cores e alegria. O samba-enredo, que surgiu nos anos 1930, evoluiu do samba tradicional para contar histórias temáticas durante os desfiles, com cada escola criando um samba específico para o enredo do ano. O Carnaval do Rio é considerado o maior espetáculo ao ar livre do mundo, atraindo milhões de turistas de diversos países. Vamos celebrar essa tradição e nos encantar com a magia do Carnaval!

bing-50864.jpg.title: Southern yellow-billed hornbills in Kruger National Park, South Africa
bing-50864.jpg.headline: Wild about wildlife. World Wildlife Day
bing-50864.jpg.description: What better time to shine a spotlight on nature than on World Wildlife Day? This day serves as a reminder that wildlife conservation is a shared responsibility. This year's theme is 'Wildlife Conservation Finance: Investing in People and Planet.' The events emphasize exchanging ideas, presenting solutions, and diving into how innovative finance can help stop biodiversity loss and create a more sustainable future. Schools, conservation groups, and wildlife parks host events such as nature walks, workshops, art contests, wildlife photography competitions, and conservation talks to raise awareness.

bing-50868.jpg.title: Interior of the Charminar, Hyderabad, Telangana
bing-50868.jpg.headline: Inside the ancient stone walls. Charminar, Hyderabad, Telangana
bing-50868.jpg.description:
Standing tall in the heart of Hyderabad, Telangana, is the Charminar, meaning 'Four Minarets,' each honouring the first four caliphs of Islam. This monument is on the eastern bank of the Musi River, with the famous Laad Bazaar to the west and the Makkah Masjid to the southwest. Built in 1591 by Sultan Mohammed Quli Qutb Shah, the Charminar is an architectural marvel shrouded in legend.

What does the Charminar symbolise? The true purpose behind its creation remains a mystery. It is commonly believed that this grand square-shaped structure was constructed in honour of Qutb Shah's wife, Bhagmati. Another widely accepted belief is that the Charminar was built to mark the end of a devastating plague that had gripped the city. It is said that the Sultan fervently prayed for his people's relief, and when the epidemic subsided, he commissioned this monument as an expression of gratitude to Allah. The site is a focal point of major celebrations, especially during Eid-ul-Adha and Eid al-Fitr, given its proximity to the revered Makkah Masjid.

bing-50876.jpg.title: Jackson Square, New Orleans, Louisiana
bing-50876.jpg.headline: Not your ordinary Tuesday. Happy Fat Tuesday!
bing-50876.jpg.description: Mardi Gras, or 'Fat Tuesday,' is a vibrant tradition that marks the last day of indulgence before the Christian season of Lent begins on Ash Wednesday. Rooted in ancient Roman celebrations like Saturnalia, Mardi Gras evolved as Christianity spread, blending local customs—most notably Carnival festivities—with religious observances. The name itself originates from French, with the word gras meaning 'fat,' referring to rich, fatty foods like meat, eggs, and cheese that are traditionally enjoyed before the fasting season begins.

bing-50888.jpg.title: Aerial view of Khao Sok National Park, Surat Thani, Thailand
bing-50888.jpg.headline: A jungle adventure. Khao Sok National Park in Thailand
bing-50888.jpg.description: Today we're in a wildlife-packed wonderland with rainforests older than the Amazon—Khao Sok National Park in Surat Thani province, southern Thailand.
